Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Season the pork with the chipotle peppers in adobo, garlic and lime juice. Braise or slow-cook the pork until very tender (at least 145°F, ideally much longer for shredding), then shred it. Drain and rinse the black beans, then warm them through in a pan. Build the bowls with the rice, beans, pork and romaine lettuce.

Recipe: Tofu Udon Stir-Fry with Carrots and Green Onions
Ingredients: Tofu, Udon Noodles, Soy Sauce, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking Oil, Carrots, Green Onions
Instructions: Cook the udon noodles according to package directions and drain. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides, then set aside. Stir-fry the carrots and green onions with the garlic and ginger until tender-crisp. Add the noodles, soy sauce and tofu and toss until heated through.

Recipe: Turkey Chili with Chili Powder and Cilantro
Ingredients: Ground Turkey, Kidney Beans, Diced Tomatoes, Chili Powder, Oregano, Cumin, Onion, Bell Pepper, Garlic, Cilantro
Instructions: Saute the onion, bell pepper and garlic with the spices. Brown the ground turkey in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (165°F). Add the remaining ingredients with a cup of water and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes. Serve topped with cilantro.

Recipe: Teriyaki Pork Stir-Fry with Cabbage and Carrots
Ingredients: Pork Tenderloin, White Rice, Cabbage, Carrots, Teriyaki Sauce, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Slice the pork into thin pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (145°F), then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the cabbage and carrots for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the pork to the pan, add the teriyaki sauce, garlic and ginger and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the white rice.

Recipe: Spicy Gochujang Chicken Stir-Fry with Bok Choy and Mushrooms
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Brown Rice, Bok Choy, Mushrooms, Gochujang, Soy Sauce, Garlic, Sesame Oil, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the bok choy and mushrooms for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the chicken to the pan, add the gochujang, soy sauce, garlic and sesame oil and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the brown rice.

Recipe: Coconut Lime Chicken Soup with Bell Pepper
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Bell Pepper, Coconut Milk, Fish Sauce, Lemongrass, Ginger, Lime Juice, Mushrooms, Cilantro, Chicken Broth
Instructions: Simmer the chicken broth with the lemongrass and ginger for 10 minutes. Add the coconut milk, mushrooms and bell pepper. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Season with the fish sauce and lime juice and finish with cilantro.

Recipe: Kimchi Egg Fried Rice
Ingredients: Eggs, Jasmine Rice, Kimchi, Soy Sauce, Sesame Oil, Green Onions
Instructions: Use day-old cold cooked jasmine rice for the best texture. Scramble the eggs and set aside. Heat the oil in a large pan and stir-fry the aromatics and vegetables for 2 minutes. Add the rice and the kimchi, soy sauce and sesame oil and stir-fry until the rice is hot and lightly toasted. Fold in the egg and eggs and cook until everything is heated through.

Recipe: Cauliflower Biryani-Style Rice with Peas
Ingredients: Cauliflower, Basmati Rice, Greek Yogurt, Onion, Garam Masala, Turmeric, Garlic, Ginger, Cilantro, Peas, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Marinate the cauliflower in the yogurt and half the spices for at least 30 minutes. Cook the onion in the oil until deep golden. Cut the cauliflower into florets and roast or saute until tender and lightly browned. Layer with the partly cooked basmati rice and the peas, cover tightly, and steam on low heat for 15 to 20 minutes. Fluff and top with cilantro.

Recipe: Cashew Tofu Stir-Fry with Green Beans and Red Onion
Ingredients: Tofu, White Rice, Green Beans, Red Onion, Soy Sauce, Cashews, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides, then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the green beans and red onion for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the tofu to the pan, add the soy sauce, cashews, garlic and ginger and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the white rice.

Recipe: Black Pepper Beef Stir-Fry with Snow Peas and Carrots
Ingredients: Beef Sirloin Strips, White Rice, Snow Peas, Carrots, Soy Sauce, Black Pepper, Garlic, Butter, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Sear the beef strips in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (at least 145°F), then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the snow peas and carrots for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the beef to the pan, add the soy sauce, black pepper, garlic and butter and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the white rice.

Recipe: Lemon Quinoa Salad with Chicken, Zucchini and Roasted Red Peppers
Ingredients: Quinoa, Chicken Breast, Zucchini, Roasted Red Peppers, Lemon Juice, Olive Oil, Parsley
Instructions: Cook the quinoa and let it cool. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Toss the quinoa with the zucchini, roasted red peppers and chicken. Dress with the lemon juice, olive oil and parsley.

Recipe: Miso-Glazed Cod Rice Bowl with Mango
Ingredients: Cod Fillet, Brown Rice, Miso Paste, Rice Vinegar, Honey, Ginger, Green Beans, Carrots, Mango
Instructions: Whisk the miso, rice vinegar, honey and ginger into a glaze. Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Cut the cod into chunks and gently cook in a pan until opaque and flaky (145°F), brushing with the glaze in the last few minutes. Steam the green beans and carrots until tender-crisp. Serve over the rice with mango.

Recipe: Orange Ginger Shrimp Stir-Fry with Broccoli and Carrots
Ingredients: Shrimp, Jasmine Rice, Broccoli, Carrots, Orange Juice, Soy Sauce, Ginger, Cornstarch, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the jasmine rice according to package directions. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque, then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the broccoli and carrots for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the shrimp to the pan, add the orange juice, soy sauce, ginger and cornstarch and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the jasmine rice.

Recipe: Smoky Paprika Shrimp Quinoa Bowl with Tzatziki
Ingredients: Shrimp, Quinoa, Red Onion, Olives, Smoked Paprika, Garlic, Lemon Juice, Olive Oil, Tzatziki
Instructions: Cook the quinoa according to package directions. Toss the shrimp with the smoked paprika, garlic and lemon juice and olive oil. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Fill the bowls with the quinoa, red onion and olives. Top with the shrimp and drizzle with the tzatziki.

Recipe: Banana Peanut Smoothie with Soy Milk
Ingredients: Soy Milk, Banana, Peanut Butter
Instructions: Blend the soy milk, banana and peanut butter with ice until smooth.

Recipe: Black Pepper Scallop Stir-Fry with Broccoli and Bell Pepper
Ingredients: Scallops, Jasmine Rice, Broccoli, Bell Pepper, Soy Sauce, Black Pepper, Garlic, Butter, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the jasmine rice according to package directions. Sear the scallops for 1 to 2 minutes per side until golden and opaque, then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the broccoli and bell pepper for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the scallops to the pan, add the soy sauce, black pepper, garlic and butter and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the jasmine rice.

Recipe: Tofu and Black Bean Burrito with Pico de Gallo
Ingredients: Tofu, Black Beans, Flour Tortillas, White Rice, Cheddar Cheese, Pico de Gallo
Instructions: Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Drain and rinse the black beans, then warm them through in a pan. Warm the flour tortilla so it folds without tearing. Fill with the rice, black beans, tofu, cheddar and pico de gallo. Fold in the sides and roll tightly, then toast seam-side down in a dry pan.

Recipe: Greek Yogurt Bowl with Pineapple and Walnuts
Ingredients: Greek Yogurt, Pineapple, Walnuts
Instructions: Spoon the greek yogurt into a bowl. Top with the pineapple and walnuts.

Recipe: Garlic Herb Lamb Gyro with Lemon Herb Vinaigrette
Ingredients: Ground Lamb, Pita Bread, Tomatoes, Red Onion, Garlic, Parsley, Thyme, Olive Oil, Lemon Olive Oil Dressing
Instructions: Toss the lamb with the garlic, parsley and thyme and olive oil. Mix the ground lamb with the spices, shape into patties or a loaf, and cook until browned and cooked through (160°F), then slice. Warm the pita bread. Stuff the pita with the lamb, tomatoes and red onion and spoon over the lemon herb vinaigrette.

Recipe: Sweet Potato and Pinto Bean Burrito with Salsa
Ingredients: Sweet Potatoes, Pinto Beans, Flour Tortillas, White Rice, Cheddar Cheese, Salsa
Instructions: Cube the sweet potatoes and roast at 425°F until tender and caramelized (about 25 minutes). Drain and rinse the pinto beans, then warm them through in a pan. Warm the flour tortilla so it folds without tearing. Fill with the rice, pinto beans, sweet potato, cheddar and salsa. Fold in the sides and roll tightly, then toast seam-side down in a dry pan.

Recipe: Tofu Breakfast Burrito with Monterey
Ingredients: Tofu, Eggs, Flour Tortillas, Potatoes, Salsa, Monterey Jack Cheese
Instructions: Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Cook the diced potatoes until crisp. Scramble the eggs until just set. Fill a warm tortilla with the eggs, tofu, potatoes and monterey jack cheese, then roll up and serve with salsa.

Recipe: Tikka Masala-Style Tofu Curry over Basmati Rice
Ingredients: Tofu, Basmati Rice, Crushed Tomatoes, Heavy Cream, Greek Yogurt, Garam Masala, Garlic, Ginger, Onion, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the basmati rice according to package directions. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides, then set aside. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil until soft, then stir in the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the crushed tomatoes, heavy cream and greek yogurt and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Return the tofu to the sauce and simmer until heated through, then serve over the rice.

Recipe: Chicken Udon Stir-Fry with Cabbage and Mushrooms
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Udon Noodles, Soy Sauce, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking Oil, Cabbage, Mushrooms
Instructions: Cook the udon noodles according to package directions and drain. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Stir-fry the cabbage and mushrooms with the garlic and ginger until tender-crisp. Add the noodles, soy sauce and chicken and toss until heated through.

Recipe: Strawberries Greek Parfait with Seed Granola and Almond Butter
Ingredients: Greek Yogurt, Strawberries, Seed Granola, Almond Butter
Instructions: Spoon the greek yogurt into a bowl. Top with the strawberries, granola and almond butter.

Recipe: Poke-Style Tofu Rice Bowl with Cucumber
Ingredients: Tofu, White Rice, Soy Sauce, Sesame Oil, Sesame Seeds, Rice Vinegar, Avocado, Cucumber, Edamame, Green Onions
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions and season with the rice vinegar. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides, then let cool slightly. Toss the tofu with the soy sauce and sesame oil. Top the rice with the tofu, avocado, cucumber, edamame, sesame seeds and cucumber.

Recipe: Roast Turkey Wrap with Hummus and Spinach and Cucumber
Ingredients: Turkey Breast, Flour Tortillas, Hummus, Spinach, Cucumber
Instructions: Season the turkey and roast or pan-sear until cooked through (165°F), then slice. Toast the bread or warm the tortilla. Spread with the hummus. Layer the roast turkey with the spinach and cucumber.

Recipe: Spicy Gochujang Tofu Stir-Fry with Asparagus and Mushrooms
Ingredients: Tofu, Jasmine Rice, Asparagus, Mushrooms, Gochujang, Soy Sauce, Garlic, Sesame Oil, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the jasmine rice according to package directions. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides, then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the asparagus and mushrooms for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the tofu to the pan, add the gochujang, soy sauce, garlic and sesame oil and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the jasmine rice.

Recipe: Hoisin Tofu Lettuce Cups with Bell Pepper
Ingredients: Tofu, Butter Lettuce, Hoisin Sauce, Water Chestnuts, Green Onions, Garlic, Rice Vinegar, Bell Pepper, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides, then set aside. Saute the garlic and bell pepper for 2 minutes. Return the tofu to the pan with the hoisin sauce, rice vinegar and water chestnuts and cook until glazed. Spoon into the lettuce leaves and top with green onions.

Recipe: Waffles with Apple and Maple Syrup
Ingredients: Flour, Eggs, Milk, Baking Powder, Butter, Apple, Maple Syrup
Instructions: Whisk the dry ingredients, then the eggs, milk and melted butter, and combine. Cook on a hot griddle until golden on both sides. Top with apple and maple syrup.

Recipe: Cumin Coriander Shrimp Couscous Bowl with Roasted Red Pepper Sauce
Ingredients: Shrimp, Couscous, Cucumber, Cherry Tomatoes, Cumin, Coriander, Paprika, Garlic, Olive Oil, Roasted Red Peppers
Instructions: Cook the couscous according to package directions. Toss the shrimp with the cumin, coriander, paprika and garlic and olive oil. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Fill the bowls with the couscous, cucumber and cherry tomatoes. Top with the shrimp and drizzle with the roasted red pepper sauce.

Recipe: Miso-Glazed Cod Rice Bowl with Pickled Onions
Ingredients: Cod Fillet, White Rice, Miso Paste, Rice Vinegar, Honey, Ginger, Green Beans, Carrots, Pickled Onions
Instructions: Whisk the miso, rice vinegar, honey and ginger into a glaze. Cook the white rice according to package directions. Cut the cod into chunks and gently cook in a pan until opaque and flaky (145°F), brushing with the glaze in the last few minutes. Steam the green beans and carrots until tender-crisp. Serve over the rice with pickled onions.

Recipe: Black Bean Tortilla Soup with Lime Crema
Ingredients: Black Beans, Vegetable Broth, Corn Tortillas, Diced Tomatoes, Onion, Garlic, Cumin, Chili Powder, Lime Juice, Cilantro, Lime Crema
Instructions: Bake or toast the corn tortilla strips until crisp. Saute the onion and garlic, then add the cumin, chili powder and diced tomatoes. Add the vegetable broth and simmer for 15 minutes. Drain and rinse the black beans, then warm them through in a pan. Ladle into bowls and top with the tortilla strips, lime crema, cilantro and lime juice.

Recipe: Cumin Coriander Halloumi Pita with Roasted Red Pepper Sauce
Ingredients: Halloumi, Pita Bread, Cucumber, Lettuce, Cumin, Coriander, Paprika, Garlic, Olive Oil, Roasted Red Peppers
Instructions: Toss the halloumi with the cumin, coriander, paprika and garlic and olive oil. Slice the halloumi and grill or pan-fry until golden on both sides. Warm the pita bread. Stuff the pita with the halloumi, cucumber and lettuce and spoon over the roasted red pepper sauce.

Recipe: Ginger Rice Soup with Tofu and Mushrooms
Ingredients: Tofu, Mushrooms, White Rice, Ginger, Soy Sauce, Green Onions, Vegetable Broth
Instructions: Simmer the rice in the vegetable broth with the ginger until very soft and thick. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Stir in the mushrooms and cook until tender. Season with soy sauce and top with green onions.

Recipe: Antipasto Salad with Chickpea and Italian Dressing
Ingredients: Chickpeas, Mixed Greens, Olives, Roasted Red Peppers, Mozzarella, Cherry Tomatoes, Italian Vinaigrette
Instructions: Drain and rinse the chickpeas. Toss the greens, olives, roasted red peppers, mozzarella and tomatoes. Top with the chickpeas and dress with the italian vinaigrette.

Recipe: Kung Pao-Style Scallop Stir-Fry with Zucchini and Bell Pepper
Ingredients: Scallops, White Rice, Zucchini, Bell Pepper, Soy Sauce, Peanuts, Dried Chilies, Rice Vinegar, Garlic, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Sear the scallops for 1 to 2 minutes per side until golden and opaque, then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the zucchini and bell pepper for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the scallops to the pan, add the soy sauce, peanuts, dried chilies, rice vinegar and garlic and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the white rice.

Recipe: Smoky Paprika Halloumi White Rice Bowl with Garlic Yogurt Sauce
Ingredients: Halloumi, White Rice, Cucumber, Cherry Tomatoes, Smoked Paprika, Garlic, Lemon Juice, Olive Oil, Garlic Yogurt Sauce
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Toss the halloumi with the smoked paprika, garlic and lemon juice and olive oil. Slice the halloumi and pan-fry until golden on both sides. Fill the bowls with the white rice, cucumber and cherry tomatoes. Top with the halloumi and drizzle with the garlic yogurt sauce.

Recipe: Cilantro-Lime Shrimp Burrito Bowl with Pinto Beans and Guacamole
Ingredients: Shrimp, Brown Rice, Pinto Beans, Guacamole, Lime Juice, Cilantro, Garlic, Olive Oil
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Season the shrimp with the lime juice, cilantro and garlic. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Drain and rinse the pinto beans, then warm them through in a pan. Build the bowls with the rice, beans, shrimp and guacamole.

Recipe: Chicken Vermicelli Bowl with Mixed Greens and Bean Sprouts
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Rice Noodles, Fish Sauce, Lime Juice, Brown Sugar, Garlic, Peanuts, Mint, Cilantro, Mixed Greens, Bean Sprouts
Instructions: Cook the rice noodles, drain, and rinse with cold water. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Whisk the fish sauce, lime juice, brown sugar and garlic into a dressing. Layer the noodles, mixed greens, bean sprouts and chicken in a bowl, drizzle with the dressing, and top with the peanuts, mint and cilantro.

Recipe: Dal Tadka with Lime Juice over Brown Rice
Ingredients: Lentils, Onion, Garlic, Ginger, Turmeric, Cumin, Cooking Oil, Cilantro, Brown Rice, Lime Juice
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger, then add the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the main ingredients, the lime juice and a splash of water and simmer until tender and saucy. Serve over the brown rice with cilantro.

Recipe: Sheet-Pan Lemon Herb Pork with Cauliflower and Red Onion
Ingredients: Pork Tenderloin, Cauliflower, Red Onion, Lemon Juice, Garlic, Thyme, Olive Oil
Instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the cauliflower and red onion with half of the lemon juice, garlic and thyme and olive oil on a sheet pan. Coat the pork with the remaining seasoning and add to the pan. Roast until the protein is cooked through (165°F for poultry, 145°F for pork and fish) and the vegetables are tender and browned.

Recipe: Beef Taco Salad with Cotija and Salsa
Ingredients: Ground Beef, Romaine Lettuce, Corn, Black Beans, Cherry Tomatoes, Cotija, Tortilla Chips, Taco Seasoning, Salsa
Instructions: Season the beef with the taco seasoning. Brown the ground beef in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (160°F). Toss the romaine, corn, black beans and tomatoes in a large bowl. Top with the beef, cotija and crushed tortilla chips and drizzle with the salsa.

Recipe: Bolognese-Style Beef Rigatoni
Ingredients: Ground Beef, Rigatoni, Crushed Tomatoes, Onion, Carrots, Celery, Garlic, Olive Oil, Tomato Paste
Instructions: Cook the rigatoni according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Brown the ground beef in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (160°F), then set aside. Simmer the crushed tomatoes, onion, carrots and celery in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and beef with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed.

Recipe: Chipotle Shrimp Tacos with Pico de Gallo and Avocado on Flour Tortillas
Ingredients: Shrimp, Flour Tortillas, Chipotle Peppers in Adobo, Garlic, Cumin, Lime Juice, Pico de Gallo, Avocado, Cilantro
Instructions: Season the shrimp with the chipotle peppers in adobo, garlic, cumin and lime juice. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the shrimp and top with pico de gallo, avocado and cilantro.

Recipe: Antipasto Salad with Turkey and Italian Dressing
Ingredients: Turkey Breast, Mixed Greens, Olives, Roasted Red Peppers, Mozzarella, Chickpeas, Cherry Tomatoes, Italian Vinaigrette
Instructions: Cut the turkey into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until cooked through (165°F). Toss the greens, olives, roasted red peppers, mozzarella and tomatoes. Top with the turkey and dress with the italian vinaigrette.

Recipe: Sheet-Pan Cajun Chicken with Broccoli and Carrots
Ingredients: Chicken Thighs, Broccoli, Carrots, Cajun Seasoning, Olive Oil
Instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the broccoli and carrots with half of the cajun seasoning and olive oil on a sheet pan. Coat the chicken with the remaining seasoning and add to the pan. Roast until the protein is cooked through (165°F for poultry, 145°F for pork and fish) and the vegetables are tender and browned.

Recipe: Carbonara-Style Asparagus Rigatoni
Ingredients: Bacon, Rigatoni, Eggs, Parmesan, Black Pepper, Asparagus
Instructions: Cook the rigatoni according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Cook the bacon until crisp. Saute the asparagus in the bacon fat until tender. Whisk the eggs with the parmesan and black pepper. Toss the hot pasta with the bacon and vegetables off the heat, then stir in the egg mixture with a splash of pasta water. Warm gently over low heat, stirring constantly, until the sauce thickens and reaches 160°F (do not let it scramble).

Recipe: Chana Masala with Spinach over Brown Rice
Ingredients: Chickpeas, Crushed Tomatoes, Onion, Garlic, Ginger, Garam Masala, Cumin, Cilantro, Brown Rice, Spinach
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger, then add the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the main ingredients, the spinach and a splash of water and simmer until tender and saucy. Serve over the brown rice with cilantro.

Recipe: Sesame Peanut Tofu Noodles with Cucumber and Bell Pepper
Ingredients: Tofu, Soba Noodles, Peanut Butter, Soy Sauce, Sesame Oil, Rice Vinegar, Garlic, Lime Juice, Cucumber, Bell Pepper
Instructions: Cook the soba noodles, drain, and rinse under cold water. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, garlic and lime juice with a splash of warm water until smooth. Toss the noodles with the sauce, the cucumber and the bell pepper, then top with the tofu.

Recipe: Sheet-Pan Rosemary Garlic Chicken with Sweet Potatoes and Brussels Sprouts
Ingredients: Chicken Thighs, Sweet Potatoes, Brussels Sprouts, Rosemary, Garlic, Olive Oil
Instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the sweet potatoes and brussels sprouts with half of the rosemary and garlic and olive oil on a sheet pan. Coat the chicken with the remaining seasoning and add to the pan. Roast until the protein is cooked through (165°F for poultry, 145°F for pork and fish) and the vegetables are tender and browned.

Recipe: Turkey Taco Salad with Cheddar and Avocado Lime Dressing
Ingredients: Ground Turkey, Romaine Lettuce, Corn, Black Beans, Cherry Tomatoes, Cheddar Cheese, Tortilla Chips, Taco Seasoning, Avocado Lime Dressing
Instructions: Season the turkey with the taco seasoning. Brown the ground turkey in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (165°F). Toss the romaine, corn, black beans and tomatoes in a large bowl. Top with the turkey, cheddar cheese and crushed tortilla chips and drizzle with the avocado lime dressing.

Recipe: Cauliflower Biryani-Style Rice with Carrots
Ingredients: Cauliflower, Basmati Rice, Greek Yogurt, Onion, Garam Masala, Turmeric, Garlic, Ginger, Cilantro, Carrots, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Marinate the cauliflower in the yogurt and half the spices for at least 30 minutes. Cook the onion in the oil until deep golden. Cut the cauliflower into florets and roast or saute until tender and lightly browned. Layer with the partly cooked basmati rice and the carrots, cover tightly, and steam on low heat for 15 to 20 minutes. Fluff and top with cilantro.

Ingredients: Pork Shoulder, Vegetable Broth, Hominy, Chili Powder, Garlic, Onion, Oregano, Lime Juice, Red Onion
Instructions: Saute the onion and garlic with the chili powder and oregano. Add the vegetable broth and hominy. Braise or slow-cook the pork until very tender (at least 145°F, ideally much longer for shredding), then shred it. Simmer until the flavors come together, about 30 minutes. Serve with lime juice and red onion.

Recipe: Pineapple Cashew Pork Fried Rice
Ingredients: Pork Tenderloin, Jasmine Rice, Pineapple, Cashews, Curry Powder, Soy Sauce, Eggs, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Use day-old cold cooked jasmine rice for the best texture. Slice the pork into thin pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (145°F), then set aside. Heat the oil in a large pan and stir-fry the aromatics and vegetables for 2 minutes. Add the rice and the curry powder and soy sauce and stir-fry until the rice is hot and lightly toasted. Fold in the pork and eggs and cook until everything is heated through.

Recipe: Ginger Rice Soup with Shrimp and Bok Choy
Ingredients: Shrimp, Bok Choy, White Rice, Ginger, Soy Sauce, Green Onions, Vegetable Broth
Instructions: Simmer the rice in the vegetable broth with the ginger until very soft and thick. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Stir in the bok choy and cook until tender. Season with soy sauce and top with green onions.

Recipe: Strawberries Sliced Almonds Overnight Oats with Soy Milk
Ingredients: Rolled Oats, Soy Milk, Strawberries, Sliced Almonds, Maple Syrup
Instructions: Stir the oats with the soy milk in a jar and refrigerate overnight. Top with the strawberries, sliced almonds and maple syrup.

Recipe: Chipotle Pork Tacos with Lettuce, Cheddar and Salsa on Flour Tortillas
Ingredients: Pork Shoulder, Flour Tortillas, Chipotle Peppers in Adobo, Garlic, Cumin, Lime Juice, Romaine Lettuce, Cheddar Cheese, Salsa
Instructions: Season the pork with the chipotle peppers in adobo, garlic, cumin and lime juice. Braise or slow-cook the pork until very tender (at least 145°F, ideally much longer for shredding), then shred it. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the pork and top with romaine lettuce, cheddar cheese and salsa.

Recipe: Hot and Sour Chicken Soup with Carrots
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Carrots, Soy Sauce, Rice Vinegar, Black Pepper, Cornstarch, Eggs, Mushrooms, Ginger, Chicken Broth
Instructions: Bring the chicken broth to a simmer with the ginger and mushrooms. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Stir in the soy sauce and rice vinegar, then thicken with the cornstarch mixed with water. Drizzle in the beaten eggs while stirring slowly to make ribbons. Finish with black pepper and the carrots.

Recipe: Miso-Glazed Salmon Rice Bowl with Pineapple
Ingredients: Salmon Fillet, White Rice, Miso Paste, Rice Vinegar, Honey, Ginger, Green Beans, Carrots, Pineapple
Instructions: Whisk the miso, rice vinegar, honey and ginger into a glaze. Cook the white rice according to package directions. Cut the salmon into chunks and gently cook in a pan until opaque and flaky (145°F), brushing with the glaze in the last few minutes. Steam the green beans and carrots until tender-crisp. Serve over the rice with pineapple.

Recipe: Turkey Chili with Chili Powder Spices and Cilantro
Ingredients: Ground Turkey, Kidney Beans, Diced Tomatoes, Chili Powder, Cumin, Onion, Bell Pepper, Garlic, Cilantro
Instructions: Saute the onion, bell pepper and garlic with the spices. Brown the ground turkey in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (165°F). Add the remaining ingredients with a cup of water and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes. Serve topped with cilantro.

Recipe: Tomato Basil Soup with White Bean (Dairy-Free)
Ingredients: Crushed Tomatoes, Vegetable Broth, Onion, Garlic, Basil, Coconut Milk, Olive Oil, White Beans
Instructions: Saute the onion and garlic in the olive oil. Add the crushed tomatoes and vegetable broth and simmer for 20 minutes. Blend until smooth. Stir in the coconut milk and basil. Drain and rinse the white beans, then warm them through in a pan and add to the soup.

Recipe: Chili-Lime Pork Tacos with Cabbage Slaw and Lime Crema
Ingredients: Pork Shoulder, Corn Tortillas, Chili Powder, Lime Juice, Garlic, Cumin, Coleslaw Mix, Lime Crema, Cilantro
Instructions: Season the pork with the chili powder, lime juice, garlic and cumin. Braise or slow-cook the pork until very tender (at least 145°F, ideally much longer for shredding), then shred it. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the pork and top with coleslaw mix, lime crema, cilantro and lime juice.

Recipe: Balsamic Steak Salad with Strawberries and Pecans on Spinach
Ingredients: Flank Steak, Spinach, Strawberries, Pecans, Balsamic Vinaigrette
Instructions: Season the steak and grill or sear to at least 145°F, rest for 5 minutes, then slice against the grain. Toss the spinach with the strawberries and pecans. Top with the steak and drizzle with the balsamic vinaigrette.

Recipe: Aloo Gobi with Green Beans over Brown Rice
Ingredients: Potatoes, Cauliflower, Onion, Garlic, Ginger, Turmeric, Cumin, Cooking Oil, Brown Rice, Green Beans
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger, then add the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the main ingredients, the green beans and a splash of water and simmer until tender and saucy. Serve over the brown rice with cilantro.

Recipe: Tofu Taco Salad with Cheddar and Salsa
Ingredients: Tofu, Romaine Lettuce, Corn, Black Beans, Cherry Tomatoes, Cheddar Cheese, Tortilla Chips, Taco Seasoning, Salsa
Instructions: Season the tofu with the taco seasoning. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Toss the romaine, corn, black beans and tomatoes in a large bowl. Top with the tofu, cheddar cheese and crushed tortilla chips and drizzle with the salsa.

Recipe: Chicken Fresh Spring Rolls with Cilantro and Cucumber
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Rice Paper Wrappers, Rice Noodles, Mixed Greens, Cucumber, Cilantro, Peanut Dipping Sauce
Instructions: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F), then slice thinly. Soak the rice paper wrappers one at a time in warm water until pliable. Layer each wrapper with the rice noodles, mixed greens, cucumber, cilantro and the chicken. Fold in the sides and roll tightly. Serve with the peanut dipping sauce.

Recipe: Garlic-Cumin Chicken Tacos with Guacamole and Pico de Gallo on Flour Tortillas
Ingredients: Chicken Thighs, Flour Tortillas, Garlic, Cumin, Oregano, Lime Juice, Guacamole, Pico de Gallo
Instructions: Season the chicken with the garlic, cumin, oregano and lime juice. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the chicken and top with guacamole and pico de gallo.

Recipe: Tabbouleh-Style Salad with Tofu and Parsley
Ingredients: Tofu, Bulgur, Tomatoes, Cucumber, Parsley, Lemon Juice, Olive Oil, Red Onion
Instructions: Soak the bulgur in hot water until tender, then drain well. Press the tofu, slice it, and pan-fry or bake until golden and firm. Toss the bulgur with the chopped tomatoes, cucumber, red onion and plenty of parsley. Dress with the lemon juice and olive oil and top with the tofu.

Recipe: Miso-Glazed Salmon Rice Bowl with Cucumber
Ingredients: Salmon Fillet, Brown Rice, Miso Paste, Rice Vinegar, Honey, Ginger, Green Beans, Carrots, Cucumber
Instructions: Whisk the miso, rice vinegar, honey and ginger into a glaze. Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Cut the salmon into chunks and gently cook in a pan until opaque and flaky (145°F), brushing with the glaze in the last few minutes. Steam the green beans and carrots until tender-crisp. Serve over the rice with cucumber.

Recipe: Almond Butter Rice Crackers Bites with Cucumber
Ingredients: Rice Crackers, Almond Butter, Cucumber
Instructions: Spread the almond butter on the rice crackers. Top with sliced cucumber.

Recipe: Puttanesca-Style Chicken over Brown Rice Pasta
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Brown Rice Pasta, Crushed Tomatoes, Olives, Capers, Anchovy Fillets, Garlic, Chili Flakes
Instructions: Cook the brown rice pasta according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Simmer the crushed tomatoes, olives, capers and anchovy fillets in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and chicken with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed.

Recipe: Taco-Seasoned Sweet Potato Burrito Bowl with Pinto Beans and Guacamole
Ingredients: Sweet Potatoes, Brown Rice, Pinto Beans, Guacamole, Taco Seasoning, Tomato Paste, Olive Oil
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Season the sweet potatoes with the taco seasoning and tomato paste. Cube the sweet potatoes and roast at 425°F until tender and caramelized (about 25 minutes). Drain and rinse the pinto beans, then warm them through in a pan. Build the bowls with the rice, beans, sweet potato and guacamole.

Recipe: Shrimp Biryani-Style Rice with Carrots
Ingredients: Shrimp, Basmati Rice, Greek Yogurt, Onion, Garam Masala, Turmeric, Garlic, Ginger, Cilantro, Carrots, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Marinate the shrimp in the yogurt and half the spices for at least 30 minutes. Cook the onion in the oil until deep golden. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Layer with the partly cooked basmati rice and the carrots, cover tightly, and steam on low heat for 15 to 20 minutes. Fluff and top with cilantro.

Recipe: Butter-Style Shrimp Curry over Basmati Rice
Ingredients: Shrimp, Basmati Rice, Butter, Crushed Tomatoes, Heavy Cream, Garam Masala, Garlic, Ginger
Instructions: Cook the basmati rice according to package directions. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque, then set aside. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil until soft, then stir in the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the butter, crushed tomatoes and heavy cream and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Return the shrimp to the sauce and simmer until heated through, then serve over the rice.

Recipe: Rajma Masala with Lime Juice over Quinoa
Ingredients: Kidney Beans, Crushed Tomatoes, Onion, Garlic, Ginger, Garam Masala, Cilantro, Quinoa, Lime Juice
Instructions: Cook the quinoa according to package directions. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger, then add the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the main ingredients, the lime juice and a splash of water and simmer until tender and saucy. Serve over the quinoa with cilantro.

Recipe: Sheet-Pan Italian Herb Chicken with Asparagus and Potatoes
Ingredients: Chicken Thighs, Asparagus, Potatoes, Olive Oil, Italian Herbs, Garlic, Lemon Juice
Instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the asparagus and potatoes with the olive oil, Italian herbs, garlic and lemon juice on a sheet pan. Nestle the seasoned chicken among the vegetables. Roast until the protein is cooked through (165°F for chicken, 145°F for pork and fish) and the vegetables are tender.

Recipe: Garlic Herb Lamb Gyro with Tzatziki
Ingredients: Ground Lamb, Pita Bread, Cucumber, Tomatoes, Garlic, Parsley, Thyme, Olive Oil, Tzatziki
Instructions: Toss the lamb with the garlic, parsley and thyme and olive oil. Mix the ground lamb with the spices, shape into patties or a loaf, and cook until browned and cooked through (160°F), then slice. Warm the pita bread. Stuff the pita with the lamb, cucumber and tomatoes and spoon over the tzatziki.

Recipe: Clam Chowder with Thyme
Ingredients: Clams, Bacon, Potatoes, Heavy Cream, Flour, Onion, Celery, Thyme
Instructions: Saute the aromatics in butter or oil until soft. Add the main vegetables or proteins, then the broth or milk, and simmer until tender. Blend until smooth or leave chunky, depending on the soup. Season to taste and top with thyme.

Recipe: Portobello Enchiladas with Monterey and Lime Juice
Ingredients: Portobello Mushrooms, Corn Tortillas, Monterey Jack Cheese, Crushed Tomatoes, Chili Powder, Cumin, Garlic, Onion, Lime Juice
Instructions: Slice the mushrooms and saute until browned and tender. Simmer the crushed tomatoes with the chili powder, cumin, garlic and onion for 10 minutes to make a flour-free sauce. Fill the corn tortillas with the portobello and some of the monterey jack cheese, roll, and place seam-side down in a baking dish. Pour the sauce over the top, sprinkle with the remaining cheese, and bake at 375°F for 20 minutes until bubbly.

Recipe: Salsa Verde Beef Burrito Bowl with Black Beans and Guacamole
Ingredients: Ground Beef, White Rice, Black Beans, Guacamole, Salsa Verde, Cilantro, Lime Juice
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Season the beef with the salsa verde, cilantro and lime juice. Brown the ground beef in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (160°F). Drain and rinse the black beans, then warm them through in a pan. Build the bowls with the rice, beans, beef and guacamole.

Recipe: Bolognese-Style Beef over Brown Rice Pasta
Ingredients: Ground Beef, Brown Rice Pasta, Crushed Tomatoes, Onion, Carrots, Celery, Garlic, Olive Oil, Tomato Paste
Instructions: Cook the brown rice pasta according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Brown the ground beef in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (160°F), then set aside. Simmer the crushed tomatoes, onion, carrots and celery in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and beef with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed.

Recipe: Bibimbap-Style Beef Rice Bowl with Avocado
Ingredients: Beef Sirloin Strips, Brown Rice, Gochujang, Sesame Oil, Soy Sauce, Spinach, Carrots, Zucchini, Mushrooms, Eggs, Avocado
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Sear the beef strips in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (at least 145°F). Saute the spinach, carrots, zucchini and mushrooms separately until tender, seasoning with a little soy sauce and sesame oil. Fry the eggs until the whites are fully set. Assemble over the rice with the beef, vegetables and avocado, and serve with the gochujang.

Recipe: Beef Lo Mein with Cabbage and Carrots
Ingredients: Beef Sirloin Strips, Egg Noodles, Soy Sauce, Sesame Oil, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking Oil, Cabbage, Carrots
Instructions: Cook the noodles, drain, and toss with a little oil. Sear the beef strips in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (at least 145°F), then set aside. Stir-fry the cabbage and carrots until tender-crisp. Add the noodles and the soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic and ginger, return the beef, and toss until everything is coated and hot.

Recipe: Hibachi-Style Beef Fried Rice
Ingredients: Beef Sirloin Strips, Jasmine Rice, Butter, Soy Sauce, Eggs, Garlic, Onion, Carrots, Peas
Instructions: Use day-old cold cooked jasmine rice for the best texture. Sear the beef strips in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (at least 145°F), then set aside. Heat the oil in a large pan and stir-fry the aromatics and vegetables for 2 minutes. Add the rice and the butter and soy sauce and stir-fry until the rice is hot and lightly toasted. Fold in the beef and eggs and cook until everything is heated through.

Recipe: Garlic Olive Oil Scallop over Brown Rice Pasta
Ingredients: Scallops, Brown Rice Pasta, Olive Oil, Garlic, Chili Flakes, Parsley, Lemon Juice
Instructions: Cook the brown rice pasta according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Sear the scallops for 1 to 2 minutes per side until golden and opaque, then set aside. Simmer the olive oil, garlic, chili flakes and parsley in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and scallop with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed.

Recipe: Ranch Steak Salad with Corn and Black Beans on Kale
Ingredients: Flank Steak, Kale, Corn, Black Beans, Ranch Dressing
Instructions: Season the steak and grill or sear to at least 145°F, rest for 5 minutes, then slice against the grain. Toss the kale with the corn and black beans. Top with the steak and drizzle with the ranch dressing.

Recipe: Italian Steak Salad with Avocado and Red Onion on Spinach
Ingredients: Flank Steak, Spinach, Avocado, Red Onion, Italian Vinaigrette
Instructions: Season the steak and grill or sear to at least 145°F, rest for 5 minutes, then slice against the grain. Toss the spinach with the avocado and red onion. Top with the steak and drizzle with the italian vinaigrette.

Recipe: Chili-Lime Tofu Tacos with Cabbage Slaw and Lime Crema
Ingredients: Tofu, Corn Tortillas, Chili Powder, Lime Juice, Garlic, Cumin, Coleslaw Mix, Lime Crema, Cilantro
Instructions: Season the tofu with the chili powder, lime juice, garlic and cumin. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the tofu and top with coleslaw mix, lime crema, cilantro and lime juice.

Recipe: Classic Beef Chili with Chili Powder Spices and Cheddar Cheese
Ingredients: Ground Beef, Kidney Beans, Diced Tomatoes, Chili Powder, Cumin, Onion, Bell Pepper, Garlic, Cheddar Cheese
Instructions: Saute the onion, bell pepper and garlic with the spices. Brown the ground beef in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (160°F). Add the remaining ingredients with a cup of water and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes. Serve topped with cheddar cheese.

Recipe: Antipasto Salad with Turkey and Balsamic Dressing
Ingredients: Turkey Breast, Mixed Greens, Olives, Roasted Red Peppers, Mozzarella, Chickpeas, Cherry Tomatoes, Balsamic Vinaigrette
Instructions: Cut the turkey into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until cooked through (165°F). Toss the greens, olives, roasted red peppers, mozzarella and tomatoes. Top with the turkey and dress with the balsamic vinaigrette.

Recipe: Lemongrass Coconut Tempeh Stir-Fry with Broccoli and Bell Pepper
Ingredients: Tempeh, White Rice, Broccoli, Bell Pepper, Coconut Milk, Fish Sauce, Lemongrass, Lime Juice, Garlic, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Cube the tempeh and pan-fry until golden and crisp at the edges, then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the broccoli and bell pepper for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the tempeh to the pan, add the coconut milk, fish sauce, lemongrass, lime juice and garlic and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the white rice.

Recipe: Coconut Lime Chicken Soup with Spinach
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Spinach, Coconut Milk, Fish Sauce, Lemongrass, Ginger, Lime Juice, Mushrooms, Cilantro, Chicken Broth
Instructions: Simmer the chicken broth with the lemongrass and ginger for 10 minutes. Add the coconut milk, mushrooms and spinach. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Season with the fish sauce and lime juice and finish with cilantro.

Recipe: Honey Garlic Shrimp Rice Bowl with Pickled Onions
Ingredients: Shrimp, Jasmine Rice, Honey, Soy Sauce, Garlic, Ginger, Sesame Seeds, Broccoli, Pickled Onions
Instructions: Cook the jasmine rice according to package directions. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Add the honey, soy sauce, garlic and ginger and simmer until sticky. Steam the broccoli until tender-crisp. Serve over the rice sprinkled with the sesame seeds and pickled onions.

Recipe: Mushrooms and Onion Scramble with Cheddar
Ingredients: Eggs, Mushrooms, Onion, Olive Oil, Cheddar Cheese
Instructions: Saute the mushrooms and onion in the oil until tender. Whisk the eggs and pour into the pan. Cook gently, stirring (scramble) or folding (omelet), until the eggs are fully set, adding the cheddar cheese at the end.

Recipe: Orange Ginger Edamame Stir-Fry with Broccoli and Carrots
Ingredients: Edamame, White Rice, Broccoli, Carrots, Orange Juice, Soy Sauce, Ginger, Cornstarch, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Boil or steam the edamame for 4 to 5 minutes until tender, then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the broccoli and carrots for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the edamame to the pan, add the orange juice, soy sauce, ginger and cornstarch and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the white rice.

Recipe: Mulligatawny-Style Chicken Soup with Spinach
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Chicken Broth, Lentils, Coconut Milk, Curry Powder, Onion, Garlic, Spinach
Instructions: Saute the onion and garlic with the curry powder. Add the chicken broth, lentils and spinach and simmer for 25 minutes. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Stir in the coconut milk and blend partly for a thick texture.

Recipe: Mediterranean Lentil Soup with Lamb and Red
Ingredients: Lentils, Vegetable Broth, Carrots, Onion, Garlic, Cumin, Coriander, Red Wine Vinegar, Lamb Leg
Instructions: Saute the onion, carrots and garlic with the cumin and coriander. Add the lentils and vegetable broth and simmer for 25 minutes until tender. Cut the lamb into bite-sized pieces and sear in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (at least 145°F) and stir it in. Finish with red wine vinegar.

Recipe: Puttanesca-Style White Bean Fettuccine
Ingredients: White Beans, Fettuccine, Crushed Tomatoes, Olives, Capers, Anchovy Fillets, Garlic, Chili Flakes
Instructions: Cook the fettuccine according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Drain and rinse the white beans, then warm them through in a pan, then set aside. Simmer the crushed tomatoes, olives, capers and anchovy fillets in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and white bean with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed.

Recipe: Tofu and Pinto Bean Burrito with Pico de Gallo
Ingredients: Tofu, Pinto Beans, Flour Tortillas, White Rice, Cheddar Cheese, Pico de Gallo
Instructions: Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Drain and rinse the pinto beans, then warm them through in a pan. Warm the flour tortilla so it folds without tearing. Fill with the rice, pinto beans, tofu, cheddar and pico de gallo. Fold in the sides and roll tightly, then toast seam-side down in a dry pan.

Recipe: Dal Tadka with Spinach over Quinoa
Ingredients: Lentils, Onion, Garlic, Ginger, Turmeric, Cumin, Cooking Oil, Cilantro, Quinoa, Spinach
Instructions: Cook the quinoa according to package directions. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger, then add the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the main ingredients, the spinach and a splash of water and simmer until tender and saucy. Serve over the quinoa with cilantro.

Recipe: Greek Salad with Salmon (No Cheese)
Ingredients: Salmon Fillet, Cucumber, Tomatoes, Red Onion, Olives, Olive Oil, Oregano, Red Wine Vinegar, Romaine Lettuce
Instructions: Season the salmon and bake or pan-sear until opaque and flaky (145°F). Chop the cucumber, tomatoes and red onion and toss with the romaine and olives. Whisk the olive oil, oregano and red wine vinegar and dress the salad. Top with the salmon.

Recipe: Creamy Mushroom Turkey Penne
Ingredients: Ground Turkey, Penne, Heavy Cream, Mushrooms, Garlic, Thyme, Parmesan
Instructions: Cook the penne according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Brown the ground turkey in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Simmer the heavy cream, mushrooms, garlic and thyme in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and turkey with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed, and finish with parmesan.

Recipe: Mulligatawny-Style Lentil Soup with Carrots
Ingredients: Lentils, Vegetable Broth, Coconut Milk, Curry Powder, Onion, Garlic, Carrots
Instructions: Saute the onion and garlic with the curry powder. Add the vegetable broth, lentils and carrots and simmer for 25 minutes. Cook the lentils until tender (or use canned lentils, drained and rinsed). Stir in the coconut milk and blend partly for a thick texture.

Recipe: Coconut Lime Chicken Soup with Bok Choy
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Bok Choy, Coconut Milk, Fish Sauce, Lemongrass, Ginger, Lime Juice, Mushrooms, Cilantro, Chicken Broth
Instructions: Simmer the chicken broth with the lemongrass and ginger for 10 minutes. Add the coconut milk, mushrooms and bok choy. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Season with the fish sauce and lime juice and finish with cilantro.

Recipe: Pork Lo Mein with Broccoli and Carrots
Ingredients: Pork Tenderloin, Egg Noodles, Soy Sauce, Sesame Oil, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking Oil, Broccoli, Carrots
Instructions: Cook the noodles, drain, and toss with a little oil. Slice the pork into thin pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (145°F), then set aside. Stir-fry the broccoli and carrots until tender-crisp. Add the noodles and the soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic and ginger, return the pork, and toss until everything is coated and hot.

Recipe: Pork Lo Mein with Bok Choy and Snow Peas
Ingredients: Pork Tenderloin, Egg Noodles, Soy Sauce, Sesame Oil, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking Oil, Bok Choy, Snow Peas
Instructions: Cook the noodles, drain, and toss with a little oil. Slice the pork into thin pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (145°F), then set aside. Stir-fry the bok choy and snow peas until tender-crisp. Add the noodles and the soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic and ginger, return the pork, and toss until everything is coated and hot.

Recipe: Cumin Coriander Chickpea Pita with Tzatziki
Ingredients: Chickpeas, Pita Bread, Tomatoes, Red Onion, Cumin, Coriander, Paprika, Garlic, Olive Oil, Tzatziki, Parsley
Instructions: Toss the chickpeas with the cumin, coriander, paprika and garlic and olive oil. Mash the chickpeas with the parsley, garlic and spices, shape into patties, and pan-fry until crisp. Warm the pita bread. Stuff the pita with the chickpeas, tomatoes and red onion and spoon over the tzatziki.

Recipe: Avocado Lime Chicken Salad with Parmesan and Croutons on Spinach
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Spinach, Parmesan, Croutons, Avocado Lime Dressing
Instructions: Season the chicken and grill or pan-sear until cooked through (165°F), then slice. Toss the spinach with the parmesan and croutons. Top with the chicken and drizzle with the avocado lime dressing.

Recipe: Coconut Shrimp Curry over Brown Rice
Ingredients: Shrimp, Brown Rice, Coconut Milk, Curry Powder, Ginger, Garlic, Lime Juice, Onion, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque, then set aside. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil until soft, then stir in the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the coconut milk and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Return the shrimp to the sauce and simmer until heated through, then serve over the rice.

Recipe: Sizzling Tofu Fajitas with Salsa (Corn Tortillas)
Ingredients: Tofu, Corn Tortillas, Bell Pepper, Onion, Chili Powder, Cumin, Garlic, Lime Juice, Salsa, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Toss the tofu with the chili powder, cumin, garlic and lime juice. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Cook the bell pepper and onion in a very hot pan until charred at the edges. Serve the tofu and vegetables with the warm tortillas and salsa.

Recipe: Bolognese-Style Turkey Linguine
Ingredients: Ground Turkey, Linguine, Crushed Tomatoes, Onion, Carrots, Celery, Garlic, Olive Oil, Tomato Paste
Instructions: Cook the linguine according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Brown the ground turkey in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Simmer the crushed tomatoes, onion, carrots and celery in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and turkey with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed.

Recipe: Sheet-Pan Smoky Paprika Cod with Zucchini and Bell Pepper
Ingredients: Cod Fillet, Zucchini, Bell Pepper, Smoked Paprika, Garlic, Olive Oil
Instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the zucchini and bell pepper with half of the smoked paprika and garlic and olive oil on a sheet pan. Coat the cod with the remaining seasoning and add to the pan. Roast until the protein is cooked through (165°F for poultry, 145°F for pork and fish) and the vegetables are tender and browned.

Recipe: Carbonara-Style Peas over Brown Rice Pasta
Ingredients: Bacon, Brown Rice Pasta, Eggs, Parmesan, Black Pepper, Peas
Instructions: Cook the brown rice pasta according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Cook the bacon until crisp. Saute the peas in the bacon fat until tender. Whisk the eggs with the parmesan and black pepper. Toss the hot pasta with the bacon and vegetables off the heat, then stir in the egg mixture with a splash of pasta water. Warm gently over low heat, stirring constantly, until the sauce thickens and reaches 160°F (do not let it scramble).

Recipe: Butter-Style Chickpea Curry over Brown Rice
Ingredients: Chickpeas, Brown Rice, Butter, Crushed Tomatoes, Heavy Cream, Garam Masala, Garlic, Ginger
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Drain and rinse the chickpeas, then warm them through (or crisp them in a hot pan), then set aside. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil until soft, then stir in the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the butter, crushed tomatoes and heavy cream and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Return the chickpeas to the sauce and simmer until heated through, then serve over the rice.

Recipe: Blueberries Soy Parfait with Seed Granola and Honey
Ingredients: Soy Milk, Blueberries, Seed Granola, Honey
Instructions: Spoon the soy milk into a bowl. Top with the blueberries, granola and honey.

Recipe: Lemon Oregano Chickpea Bulgur Bowl with Tahini Lemon Sauce
Ingredients: Chickpeas, Bulgur, Red Onion, Olives, Lemon Juice, Oregano, Garlic, Olive Oil, Tahini
Instructions: Cook the bulgur according to package directions. Toss the chickpeas with the lemon juice, oregano and garlic and olive oil. Drain and rinse the chickpeas, then warm them through (or crisp them in a hot pan). Fill the bowls with the bulgur, red onion and olives. Top with the chickpeas and drizzle with the tahini lemon sauce.

Recipe: Tikka Masala-Style Chicken Curry over Brown Rice
Ingredients: Chicken Thighs, Brown Rice, Crushed Tomatoes, Heavy Cream, Greek Yogurt, Garam Masala, Garlic, Ginger, Onion, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil until soft, then stir in the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the crushed tomatoes, heavy cream and greek yogurt and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Return the chicken to the sauce and simmer until heated through, then serve over the rice.

Recipe: Garlic Ham Fried Rice
Ingredients: Ham, Jasmine Rice, Eggs, Soy Sauce, Garlic, Green Onions, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Use day-old cold cooked jasmine rice for the best texture. Dice the ham and warm it through in the pan, then set aside. Heat the oil in a large pan and stir-fry the aromatics and vegetables for 2 minutes. Add the rice and the soy sauce and stir-fry until the rice is hot and lightly toasted. Fold in the ham and eggs and cook until everything is heated through.

Recipe: Chana Masala with Lime Juice over Quinoa
Ingredients: Chickpeas, Crushed Tomatoes, Onion, Garlic, Ginger, Garam Masala, Cumin, Cilantro, Quinoa, Lime Juice
Instructions: Cook the quinoa according to package directions. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger, then add the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the main ingredients, the lime juice and a splash of water and simmer until tender and saucy. Serve over the quinoa with cilantro.

Recipe: Korma-Style Chickpea Curry over Basmati Rice
Ingredients: Chickpeas, Basmati Rice, Cashews, Coconut Milk, Onion, Garam Masala, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the basmati rice according to package directions. Drain and rinse the chickpeas, then warm them through (or crisp them in a hot pan), then set aside. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil until soft, then stir in the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the cashews and coconut milk and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Return the chickpeas to the sauce and simmer until heated through, then serve over the rice.

Recipe: Smoky Paprika Pork Tacos with Lettuce, Cheddar and Salsa
Ingredients: Pork Shoulder, Corn Tortillas, Smoked Paprika, Garlic, Cumin, Olive Oil, Romaine Lettuce, Cheddar Cheese, Salsa
Instructions: Season the pork with the smoked paprika, garlic and cumin. Braise or slow-cook the pork until very tender (at least 145°F, ideally much longer for shredding), then shred it. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the pork and top with romaine lettuce, cheddar cheese and salsa.

Recipe: Banana Coconut Parfait with Seed Granola and Peanut Butter
Ingredients: Coconut Milk, Banana, Seed Granola, Peanut Butter
Instructions: Spoon the coconut milk into a bowl. Top with the banana, granola and peanut butter.

Recipe: Garlic Herb Turkey Pita with Roasted Red Pepper Sauce
Ingredients: Turkey Breast, Pita Bread, Cucumber, Tomatoes, Garlic, Parsley, Thyme, Olive Oil, Roasted Red Peppers
Instructions: Toss the turkey with the garlic, parsley and thyme and olive oil. Season the turkey and roast or pan-sear until cooked through (165°F), then slice. Warm the pita bread. Stuff the pita with the turkey, cucumber and tomatoes and spoon over the roasted red pepper sauce.

Recipe: Lemon Herb Breadcrumb Baked Cod with Asparagus
Ingredients: Cod Fillet, Asparagus, Breadcrumbs, Lemon Juice, Parsley, Olive Oil
Instructions: Heat the oven to 400°F. Brush the cod with the mustard or oil and press the crust mixture on top. Bake until opaque and flaky (145°F) and serve with asparagus.

Recipe: Smoky Tofu Sandwich on Gluten-Free Bread with Mayo and Mozzarella and Basil
Ingredients: Tofu, Gluten-Free Bread, Mayonnaise, Mozzarella, Basil
Instructions: Press the tofu, slice it, and pan-fry or bake until golden and firm. Toast the bread or warm the tortilla. Spread with the mayonnaise. Layer the smoky tofu with the mozzarella and basil.

Recipe: Baked Spinach Rigatoni with Mozzarella
Ingredients: Spinach, Rigatoni, Marinara Sauce, Garlic, Basil, Mozzarella, Parmesan
Instructions: Cook the rigatoni until just shy of tender and drain. Saute the spinach until tender. Stir the marinara sauce, garlic and basil into the pan. Combine with the pasta and half the mozzarella and transfer to a baking dish. Top with the remaining mozzarella and the parmesan and bake at 375°F for 20 to 25 minutes until bubbling.

Recipe: Garlic Olive Oil Portobello Rigatoni
Ingredients: Portobello Mushrooms, Rigatoni, Olive Oil, Garlic, Chili Flakes, Parsley, Lemon Juice
Instructions: Cook the rigatoni according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Slice the mushrooms and saute until browned and tender, then set aside. Simmer the olive oil, garlic, chili flakes and parsley in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and portobello with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed.

Recipe: Bolognese-Style Portobello Linguine
Ingredients: Portobello Mushrooms, Linguine, Crushed Tomatoes, Onion, Carrots, Celery, Garlic, Olive Oil, Tomato Paste
Instructions: Cook the linguine according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Slice the mushrooms and saute until browned and tender, then set aside. Simmer the crushed tomatoes, onion, carrots and celery in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and portobello with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed.

Recipe: Turkey Burger with Blue Cheese and Arugula
Ingredients: Ground Turkey, Blue Cheese, Arugula, Red Onion, Burger Bun
Instructions: Shape the ground turkey into patties and cook to 165°F. Toast the bun. Assemble with the blue cheese, arugula and red onion.

Recipe: Cilantro-Lime Chicken Burrito Bowl with Pinto Beans and Lime Crema
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, White Rice, Pinto Beans, Lime Crema, Lime Juice, Cilantro, Garlic, Olive Oil
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Season the chicken with the lime juice, cilantro and garlic. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Drain and rinse the pinto beans, then warm them through in a pan. Build the bowls with the rice, beans, chicken and lime crema.

Recipe: Garlic-Cumin Portobello Tacos with Mango Salsa on Flour Tortillas
Ingredients: Portobello Mushrooms, Flour Tortillas, Garlic, Cumin, Oregano, Lime Juice, Mango, Red Onion, Jalapeno, Cilantro
Instructions: Season the portobello with the garlic, cumin, oregano and lime juice. Slice the mushrooms and saute until browned and tender. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the portobello and top with mango, red onion, jalapeno, lime juice and cilantro.

Recipe: Singapore-Style Shrimp Noodles with Bell Pepper
Ingredients: Shrimp, Rice Noodles, Curry Powder, Soy Sauce, Eggs, Garlic, Cooking Oil, Bell Pepper, Carrots
Instructions: Soak the rice noodles until tender and drain. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque, then set aside. Scramble the eggs and set aside. Stir-fry the bell pepper, carrots and garlic, add the curry powder and soy sauce, then toss in the noodles, shrimp and eggs until hot.

Recipe: Madras-Style Beef Curry over Basmati Rice
Ingredients: Beef Sirloin Strips, Basmati Rice, Curry Powder, Chili Powder, Tomato Paste, Onion, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking Oil, Coconut Milk
Instructions: Cook the basmati rice according to package directions. Sear the beef strips in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (at least 145°F), then set aside. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil until soft, then stir in the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the tomato paste and coconut milk and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Return the beef to the sauce and simmer until heated through, then serve over the rice.

Recipe: Mediterranean Lentil Soup with Chicken and Lemon
Ingredients: Lentils, Chicken Broth, Carrots, Onion, Garlic, Cumin, Coriander, Lemon Juice, Chicken Breast
Instructions: Saute the onion, carrots and garlic with the cumin and coriander. Add the lentils and chicken broth and simmer for 25 minutes until tender. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F) and stir it in. Finish with lemon juice.

Recipe: Coconut Tofu Curry over Brown Rice
Ingredients: Tofu, Brown Rice, Coconut Milk, Curry Powder, Ginger, Garlic, Lime Juice, Onion, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides, then set aside. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil until soft, then stir in the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the coconut milk and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Return the tofu to the sauce and simmer until heated through, then serve over the rice.

Recipe: Baked Turkey Penne with Ricotta
Ingredients: Ground Turkey, Penne, Marinara Sauce, Garlic, Basil, Ricotta, Parmesan, Mozzarella
Instructions: Cook the penne until just shy of tender and drain. Brown the ground turkey in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (165°F). Stir the marinara sauce, garlic and basil into the pan. Combine with the pasta and half the ricotta and transfer to a baking dish. Top with the remaining ricotta and the parmesan and bake at 375°F for 20 to 25 minutes until bubbling.

Recipe: Ranch Tuna Salad with Apple and Walnuts on Kale
Ingredients: Canned Tuna, Kale, Apple, Walnuts, Ranch Dressing
Instructions: Flake the canned tuna. Toss the kale with the apple and walnuts. Top with the tuna and drizzle with the ranch dressing.

Recipe: Lemon Olive Oil Egg Salad with Avocado and Red Onion on Mixed Greens
Ingredients: Eggs, Mixed Greens, Avocado, Red Onion, Lemon Olive Oil Dressing
Instructions: Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool, and slice. Toss the mixed greens with the avocado and red onion. Top with the egg and drizzle with the lemon olive oil dressing.

Recipe: Fajita-Style Beef Burrito Bowl with Black Beans and Pico de Gallo
Ingredients: Ground Beef, Brown Rice, Black Beans, Pico de Gallo, Bell Pepper, Onion, Chili Powder, Cumin, Lime Juice, Olive Oil
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Season the beef with the bell pepper, onion, chili powder, cumin and lime juice. Brown the ground beef in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (160°F). Drain and rinse the black beans, then warm them through in a pan. Build the bowls with the rice, beans, beef and pico de gallo.

Recipe: Cottage Cheese Bowl with Pineapple and Seed Granola
Ingredients: Cottage Cheese, Pineapple, Seed Granola
Instructions: Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl. Top with the pineapple and seed granola.

Recipe: Sizzling Tofu Fajitas with Sour Cream (Corn Tortillas)
Ingredients: Tofu, Corn Tortillas, Bell Pepper, Onion, Chili Powder, Cumin, Garlic, Lime Juice, Sour Cream, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Toss the tofu with the chili powder, cumin, garlic and lime juice. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Cook the bell pepper and onion in a very hot pan until charred at the edges. Serve the tofu and vegetables with the warm tortillas and sour cream.

Recipe: Primavera Cherry Tomatoes Fettuccine
Ingredients: Fettuccine, Olive Oil, Garlic, Zucchini, Cherry Tomatoes, Parmesan, Lemon Juice
Instructions: Cook the fettuccine according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Saute the garlic and zucchini in the olive oil for 3 minutes. Add the cherry tomatoes and cook until just tender. Toss with the pasta, lemon juice and a splash of pasta water and top with parmesan.

Recipe: Katsu-Style Chicken Rice Bowl with Mango
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, White Rice, Breadcrumbs, Eggs, Flour, Cooking Oil, Soy Sauce, Cabbage, Carrots, Mango
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Coat the chicken in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs. Pan-fry in oil until golden and cooked through (165F for chicken, 145F for pork), then slice. Serve over the rice with shredded cabbage, carrots, a drizzle of soy sauce and mango.

Recipe: Pozole-Style Chicken Stew with Cabbage
Ingredients: Chicken Thighs, Chicken Broth, Hominy, Chili Powder, Garlic, Onion, Oregano, Lime Juice, Cabbage
Instructions: Saute the onion and garlic with the chili powder and oregano. Add the chicken broth and hominy. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Simmer until the flavors come together, about 30 minutes. Serve with lime juice and cabbage.

Recipe: Sesame Ginger Tempeh Stir-Fry with Zucchini and Bell Pepper
Ingredients: Tempeh, Jasmine Rice, Zucchini, Bell Pepper, Soy Sauce, Sesame Oil, Sesame Seeds, Ginger, Garlic, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the jasmine rice according to package directions. Cube the tempeh and pan-fry until golden and crisp at the edges, then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the zucchini and bell pepper for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the tempeh to the pan, add the soy sauce, sesame oil, sesame seeds, ginger and garlic and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the jasmine rice.

Recipe: Ranch Bacon Salad with Avocado and Red Onion on Arugula
Ingredients: Bacon, Arugula, Avocado, Red Onion, Ranch Dressing
Instructions: Cook the bacon until crisp and crumble it. Toss the arugula with the avocado and red onion. Top with the bacon and drizzle with the ranch dressing.

Recipe: Carbonara-Style Asparagus Penne
Ingredients: Bacon, Penne, Eggs, Parmesan, Black Pepper, Asparagus
Instructions: Cook the penne according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Cook the bacon until crisp. Saute the asparagus in the bacon fat until tender. Whisk the eggs with the parmesan and black pepper. Toss the hot pasta with the bacon and vegetables off the heat, then stir in the egg mixture with a splash of pasta water. Warm gently over low heat, stirring constantly, until the sauce thickens and reaches 160°F (do not let it scramble).

Recipe: Cumin Coriander Beef Pita with Lemon Herb Vinaigrette
Ingredients: Beef Sirloin Strips, Pita Bread, Red Onion, Lettuce, Cumin, Coriander, Paprika, Garlic, Olive Oil, Lemon Olive Oil Dressing, Parsley
Instructions: Toss the beef with the cumin, coriander, paprika and garlic and olive oil. Season the beef and sear until browned and cooked through (at least 145°F), then slice. Warm the pita bread. Stuff the pita with the beef, red onion and lettuce and spoon over the lemon herb vinaigrette.

Recipe: Bulgogi-Style Tofu Rice Bowl with Cabbage
Ingredients: Tofu, Brown Rice, Soy Sauce, Brown Sugar, Sesame Oil, Garlic, Ginger, Green Onions, Cabbage
Instructions: Marinate the tofu in the soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, garlic and ginger for at least 20 minutes. Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Serve over the rice topped with cabbage and green onions.

Recipe: Chicken Pad Thai-Style Noodles
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Rice Noodles, Fish Sauce, Tamarind Paste, Brown Sugar, Lime Juice, Eggs, Bean Sprouts, Peanuts, Green Onions, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Soak the rice noodles in hot water until just tender, then drain. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F), then push to the side of the pan. Scramble the eggs in the same pan until set. Add the noodles with the fish sauce, tamarind paste, brown sugar and lime juice and toss until coated. Top with the peanuts, bean sprouts and green onions.

Recipe: Tofu Lo Mein with Bell Pepper and Mushrooms
Ingredients: Tofu, Egg Noodles, Soy Sauce, Sesame Oil, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking Oil, Bell Pepper, Mushrooms
Instructions: Cook the noodles, drain, and toss with a little oil. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides, then set aside. Stir-fry the bell pepper and mushrooms until tender-crisp. Add the noodles and the soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic and ginger, return the tofu, and toss until everything is coated and hot.

Recipe: Loaded Potato Soup with Pumpkin Seeds
Ingredients: Potatoes, Milk, Cheddar Cheese, Bacon, Green Onions, Butter, Flour, Chicken Broth, Pumpkin Seeds
Instructions: Saute the aromatics in butter or oil until soft. Add the main vegetables or proteins, then the broth or milk, and simmer until tender. Blend until smooth or leave chunky, depending on the soup. Season to taste and top with pumpkin seeds.

Recipe: Lemon Oregano Lamb White Rice Bowl with Lemon Herb Vinaigrette
Ingredients: Lamb Leg, White Rice, Cucumber, Red Onion, Lemon Juice, Oregano, Garlic, Olive Oil, Lemon Olive Oil Dressing, Parsley
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Toss the lamb with the lemon juice, oregano and garlic and olive oil. Cut the lamb into bite-sized pieces and sear in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (at least 145°F). Fill the bowls with the white rice, cucumber and red onion. Top with the lamb and drizzle with the lemon herb vinaigrette.

Recipe: Chicken Yakisoba-Style Noodles with Bell Pepper and Cabbage
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Ramen Noodles, Soy Sauce, Ketchup, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking Oil, Bell Pepper, Cabbage
Instructions: Cook the noodles according to package directions and drain. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Stir-fry the bell pepper and cabbage until tender-crisp. Add the noodles, chicken, soy sauce and ketchup and toss until glazed and hot.

Recipe: Dal Tadka with Lime Juice over Basmati Rice
Ingredients: Lentils, Onion, Garlic, Ginger, Turmeric, Cumin, Cooking Oil, Cilantro, Basmati Rice, Lime Juice
Instructions: Cook the basmati rice according to package directions. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger, then add the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the main ingredients, the lime juice and a splash of water and simmer until tender and saucy. Serve over the basmati rice with cilantro.

Recipe: Spiced Paneer Kathi Roll with Tzatziki
Ingredients: Paneer, Flour Tortillas, Tzatziki, Red Onion, Cucumber, Cilantro, Garam Masala, Lemon Juice, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Toss the paneer with the garam masala and lemon juice. Cube the paneer and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Warm the tortillas. Fill with the paneer, red onion, cucumber and cilantro and drizzle with the tzatziki.

Recipe: Fajita-Style Tofu Burrito Bowl with Black Beans and Salsa
Ingredients: Tofu, White Rice, Black Beans, Salsa, Bell Pepper, Onion, Chili Powder, Cumin, Lime Juice, Olive Oil
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Season the tofu with the bell pepper, onion, chili powder, cumin and lime juice. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Drain and rinse the black beans, then warm them through in a pan. Build the bowls with the rice, beans, tofu and salsa.

Recipe: Chipotle Turkey Burrito Bowl with Pinto Beans and Corn
Ingredients: Ground Turkey, White Rice, Pinto Beans, Corn, Chipotle Peppers in Adobo, Garlic, Lime Juice, Olive Oil
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Season the turkey with the chipotle peppers in adobo, garlic and lime juice. Brown the ground turkey in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (165°F). Drain and rinse the pinto beans, then warm them through in a pan. Build the bowls with the rice, beans, turkey and corn.

Recipe: Spiced Chicken Kathi Roll with Garlic
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Flour Tortillas, Garlic Yogurt Sauce, Red Onion, Cucumber, Cilantro, Garam Masala, Lemon Juice, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Toss the chicken with the garam masala and lemon juice. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Warm the tortillas. Fill with the chicken, red onion, cucumber and cilantro and drizzle with the garlic yogurt sauce.

Recipe: Katsu-Style Tofu Rice Bowl with Cucumber
Ingredients: Tofu, Jasmine Rice, Breadcrumbs, Eggs, Flour, Cooking Oil, Soy Sauce, Cabbage, Carrots, Cucumber
Instructions: Cook the jasmine rice according to package directions. Coat the tofu in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs. Recipe: Smoky Tofu Sandwich with Mayo and Cheddar
Ingredients: Tofu, Bread, Mayonnaise, Cheddar Cheese, Lettuce
Instructions: Press the tofu, slice it, and pan-fry or bake until golden and firm. Toast the bread or warm the tortilla. Spread with the mayonnaise. Layer the smoky tofu with the cheddar cheese and lettuce.

Recipe: Tabbouleh-Style Salad with Halloumi and Mint
Ingredients: Halloumi, Bulgur, Tomatoes, Cucumber, Mint, Lemon Juice, Olive Oil, Red Onion
Instructions: Soak the bulgur in hot water until tender, then drain well. Slice the halloumi and grill or pan-fry until golden on both sides. Toss the bulgur with the chopped tomatoes, cucumber, red onion and plenty of mint. Dress with the lemon juice and olive oil and top with the halloumi.

Recipe: Spicy Arrabbiata Shrimp Penne

Recipe: Creamy Alfredo Chicken Linguine
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Linguine, Heavy Cream, Butter, Parmesan, Garlic, Black Pepper
Instructions: Cook the linguine according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Simmer the heavy cream, butter and garlic in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and chicken with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed, and finish with parmesan.

Recipe: Black Bean Dip with Rice Crackers and Carrots
Ingredients: Black Beans, Lime Juice, Cumin, Garlic, Rice Crackers, Carrots
Instructions: Prepare the black beans dip by mashing or blending the ingredients until smooth. Cut the carrots and arrange with the rice crackers. Serve for dipping.

Recipe: Greek Salad with Chicken (No Cheese)
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Cucumber, Tomatoes, Red Onion, Olives, Olive Oil, Oregano, Red Wine Vinegar, Romaine Lettuce
Instructions: Season the chicken and grill or pan-sear until cooked through (165°F), then slice. Chop the cucumber, tomatoes and red onion and toss with the romaine and olives. Whisk the olive oil, oregano and red wine vinegar and dress the salad. Top with the chicken.

Recipe: Sheet-Pan Garlic Parmesan Chicken with Sweet Potatoes and Brussels Sprouts
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Sweet Potatoes, Brussels Sprouts, Parmesan, Garlic, Olive Oil
Instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the sweet potatoes and brussels sprouts with half of the parmesan and garlic and olive oil on a sheet pan. Coat the chicken with the remaining seasoning and add to the pan. Roast until the protein is cooked through (165°F for poultry, 145°F for pork and fish) and the vegetables are tender and browned.

Recipe: Fajita-Style Chicken Burrito Bowl with Pinto Beans and Avocado
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Brown Rice, Pinto Beans, Avocado, Bell Pepper, Onion, Chili Powder, Cumin, Lime Juice, Olive Oil
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Season the chicken with the bell pepper, onion, chili powder, cumin and lime juice. Recipe: Bulgogi-Style Tofu Rice Bowl with Avocado

Recipe: Al Pastor-Style Steak Tacos with Mango Salsa
Ingredients: Flank Steak, Corn Tortillas, Pineapple, Chili Powder, Cumin, Garlic, Oregano, Mango, Red Onion, Jalapeno, Lime Juice, Cilantro
