Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the steak and top with mango, red onion, jalapeno, lime juice and cilantro.

Recipe: Garlic Ginger Steak Stir-Fry with Cabbage and Carrots
Ingredients: Flank Steak, Jasmine Rice, Cabbage, Carrots, Soy Sauce, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking Oil

Recipe: Puttanesca-Style Chicken Fettuccine
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Fettuccine, Crushed Tomatoes, Olives, Capers, Anchovy Fillets, Garlic, Chili Flakes
Instructions: Cook the fettuccine according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Simmer the crushed tomatoes, olives, capers and anchovy fillets in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and chicken with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed.

Recipe: Smoky Paprika Beef Pita with Tahini Lemon Sauce
Ingredients: Beef Sirloin Strips, Pita Bread, Tomatoes, Red Onion, Smoked Paprika, Garlic, Lemon Juice, Olive Oil, Tahini
Instructions: Toss the beef with the smoked paprika, garlic and lemon juice and olive oil. Season the beef and sear until browned and cooked through (at least 145°F), then slice. Warm the pita bread. Stuff the pita with the beef, tomatoes and red onion and spoon over the tahini lemon sauce.

Recipe: Spicy Basil Beef Noodles with Green Beans
Ingredients: Beef Sirloin Strips, Rice Noodles, Soy Sauce, Oyster Sauce, Thai Basil, Dried Chilies, Garlic, Cooking Oil, Green Beans, Onion
Instructions: Soak the rice noodles in hot water until tender and drain. Sear the beef strips in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (at least 145°F), then set aside. Stir-fry the garlic, chilies, green beans and onion for 2 minutes. Add the noodles, soy sauce, oyster sauce and beef and toss until hot, then fold in the Thai basil.

Recipe: Honey Soy Tempeh Stir-Fry with Snow Peas and Carrots
Ingredients: Tempeh, White Rice, Snow Peas, Carrots, Soy Sauce, Honey, Garlic, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Cube the tempeh and pan-fry until golden and crisp at the edges, then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the snow peas and carrots for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the tempeh to the pan, add the soy sauce, honey and garlic and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the white rice.

Recipe: Chicken Fresh Spring Rolls with Basil and Carrots
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Rice Paper Wrappers, Rice Noodles, Mixed Greens, Carrots, Basil, Peanut Dipping Sauce
Instructions: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F), then slice thinly. Soak the rice paper wrappers one at a time in warm water until pliable. Layer each wrapper with the rice noodles, mixed greens, carrots, basil and the chicken. Fold in the sides and roll tightly. Serve with the peanut dipping sauce.

Recipe: Orange Ginger Shrimp Stir-Fry with Bok Choy and Mushrooms
Ingredients: Shrimp, Brown Rice, Bok Choy, Mushrooms, Orange Juice, Soy Sauce, Ginger, Cornstarch, Cooking Oil

Ingredients: White Beans, Vegetable Broth, Hominy, Chili Powder, Garlic, Onion, Oregano, Lime Juice, Avocado

Recipe: Lamb Burger with BBQ Sauce and Red Onion (Lettuce-Wrapped)
Ingredients: Ground Lamb, BBQ Sauce, Red Onion, Lettuce
Instructions: Shape the ground lamb into patties and cook to 160°F. Wash and dry large lettuce leaves to use as the wrap. Assemble with the bbq sauce, red onion and lettuce.

Recipe: Katsu-Style Tofu Rice Bowl with Pineapple
Ingredients: Tofu, Brown Rice, Breadcrumbs, Eggs, Flour, Cooking Oil, Soy Sauce, Cabbage, Carrots, Pineapple

Pan-fry in oil until golden and cooked through (165F for chicken, 145F for pork), then slice. Serve over the rice with shredded cabbage, carrots, a drizzle of soy sauce and pineapple.

Recipe: Steak and Corn Quesadilla with Cheddar
Ingredients: Flank Steak, Flour Tortillas, Cheddar Cheese, Corn, Jalapeno, Salsa
Instructions: Slice the steak thinly against the grain and sear in a hot pan until browned (at least 145°F). Saute the corn and jalapeno until soft. Fill half of each flour tortilla with the steak, vegetables and cheddar cheese, then fold over. Cook in a dry pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until crisp and the cheese melts. Serve with salsa.

Recipe: Rajma Masala with Lime Juice over Brown Rice
Ingredients: Kidney Beans, Crushed Tomatoes, Onion, Garlic, Ginger, Garam Masala, Cilantro, Brown Rice, Lime Juice
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger, then add the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the main ingredients, the lime juice and a splash of water and simmer until tender and saucy. Serve over the brown rice with cilantro.

Recipe: Baked Pork Penne with Ricotta
Ingredients: Ground Pork, Penne, Marinara Sauce, Garlic, Basil, Ricotta, Parmesan, Mozzarella
Instructions: Cook the penne until just shy of tender and drain. Brown the ground pork in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (160°F). Stir the marinara sauce, garlic and basil into the pan. Combine with the pasta and half the ricotta and transfer to a baking dish. Top with the remaining ricotta and the parmesan and bake at 375°F for 20 to 25 minutes until bubbling.

Recipe: Chicken Biryani-Style Rice with Peas
Ingredients: Chicken Thighs, Basmati Rice, Greek Yogurt, Onion, Garam Masala, Turmeric, Garlic, Ginger, Cilantro, Peas, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Marinate the chicken in the yogurt and half the spices for at least 30 minutes. Cook the onion in the oil until deep golden. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Layer with the partly cooked basmati rice and the peas, cover tightly, and steam on low heat for 15 to 20 minutes. Fluff and top with cilantro.

Recipe: Mulligatawny-Style Chicken Soup with Apple
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Chicken Broth, Lentils, Coconut Milk, Curry Powder, Onion, Garlic, Apple
Instructions: Saute the onion and garlic with the curry powder. Add the chicken broth, lentils and apple and simmer for 25 minutes. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Stir in the coconut milk and blend partly for a thick texture.

Recipe: Italian Wedding-Style Soup with Kale (Egg-Free Meatballs)
Ingredients: Ground Turkey, Chicken Broth, Orzo, Kale, Carrots, Onion, Garlic, Parmesan
Instructions: Mix the ground turkey with garlic and form small meatballs. Simmer the chicken broth with the carrots and onion. Add the meatballs and cook until they reach 165°F. Add the orzo and kale and cook until the pasta is tender, then top with parmesan.

Recipe: Mixed Berries Spinach Smoothie with Coconut Milk
Ingredients: Coconut Milk, Mixed Berries, Spinach
Instructions: Blend the coconut milk, mixed berries and spinach with ice until smooth.

Recipe: Spicy Basil Shrimp Noodles with Green Beans
Ingredients: Shrimp, Rice Noodles, Soy Sauce, Oyster Sauce, Thai Basil, Dried Chilies, Garlic, Cooking Oil, Green Beans, Onion
Instructions: Soak the rice noodles in hot water until tender and drain. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque, then set aside. Stir-fry the garlic, chilies, green beans and onion for 2 minutes. Add the noodles, soy sauce, oyster sauce and shrimp and toss until hot, then fold in the Thai basil.

Recipe: Grilled Portobello Sandwich on Gluten-Free Bread with Avocado and Spinach and Cucumber
Ingredients: Portobello Mushrooms, Gluten-Free Bread, Avocado, Spinach, Cucumber
Instructions: Brush the mushroom caps with oil and grill or roast until tender and browned. Toast the bread or warm the tortilla. Spread with the avocado. Layer the grilled portobello with the spinach and cucumber.

Recipe: Taco-Seasoned Tofu Burrito Bowl with Pinto Beans and Avocado
Ingredients: Tofu, Brown Rice, Pinto Beans, Avocado, Taco Seasoning, Tomato Paste, Olive Oil
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Season the tofu with the taco seasoning and tomato paste. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Drain and rinse the pinto beans, then warm them through in a pan. Build the bowls with the rice, beans, tofu and avocado.

Recipe: Tomatoes and Spinach Omelet with Feta
Ingredients: Eggs, Tomatoes, Spinach, Olive Oil, Feta Cheese
Instructions: Saute the tomatoes and spinach in the oil until tender. Whisk the eggs and pour into the pan. Cook gently, stirring (scramble) or folding (omelet), until the eggs are fully set, adding the feta cheese at the end.

Recipe: Black Pepper Scallop Stir-Fry with Zucchini and Bell Pepper
Ingredients: Scallops, White Rice, Zucchini, Bell Pepper, Soy Sauce, Black Pepper, Garlic, Butter, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Sear the scallops for 1 to 2 minutes per side until golden and opaque, then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the zucchini and bell pepper for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the scallops to the pan, add the soy sauce, black pepper, garlic and butter and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the white rice.

Recipe: Hoisin Turkey Lettuce Cups with Cabbage
Ingredients: Ground Turkey, Butter Lettuce, Hoisin Sauce, Water Chestnuts, Green Onions, Garlic, Rice Vinegar, Cabbage, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Brown the ground turkey in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Saute the garlic and cabbage for 2 minutes. Return the turkey to the pan with the hoisin sauce, rice vinegar and water chestnuts and cook until glazed. Spoon into the lettuce leaves and top with green onions.

Recipe: Coconut Shrimp Curry over Basmati Rice
Ingredients: Shrimp, Basmati Rice, Coconut Milk, Curry Powder, Ginger, Garlic, Lime Juice, Onion, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the basmati rice according to package directions. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque, then set aside. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil until soft, then stir in the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the coconut milk and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Return the shrimp to the sauce and simmer until heated through, then serve over the rice.

Recipe: Lemon Oregano Tofu Pita with Garlic Yogurt Sauce
Ingredients: Tofu, Pita Bread, Cucumber, Tomatoes, Lemon Juice, Oregano, Garlic, Olive Oil, Garlic Yogurt Sauce
Instructions: Toss the tofu with the lemon juice, oregano and garlic and olive oil. Press the tofu, slice it, and pan-fry or bake until golden and firm. Warm the pita bread. Stuff the pita with the tofu, cucumber and tomatoes and spoon over the garlic yogurt sauce.

Recipe: Tuscan White Bean and Kale Soup with Bacon
Ingredients: White Beans, Vegetable Broth, Kale, Onion, Carrots, Celery, Garlic, Rosemary, Olive Oil, Bacon
Instructions: Saute the onion, carrots, celery and garlic in the olive oil. Add the vegetable broth, white beans and rosemary and simmer for 20 minutes. Cook the bacon until crisp, then crumble it. Stir in the kale until wilted.

Recipe: Hearty Lentil Stew with Peas
Ingredients: Lentils, Peas, Vegetable Broth, Potatoes, Carrots, Onion, Tomato Paste, Thyme, Bay Leaf, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Rinse the lentils. Add the onion, carrots and potatoes and cook for 3 minutes. Add the tomato paste, thyme, bay leaf and vegetable broth and simmer until the lentils is tender (about 1 hour for meat, 25 minutes for lentils). Add the peas for the last 10 minutes.

Recipe: Sizzling Chicken Fajitas with Pico de Gallo (Corn Tortillas)
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Corn Tortillas, Bell Pepper, Onion, Chili Powder, Cumin, Garlic, Lime Juice, Pico de Gallo, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Toss the chicken with the chili powder, cumin, garlic and lime juice. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Cook the bell pepper and onion in a very hot pan until charred at the edges. Serve the chicken and vegetables with the warm tortillas and pico de gallo.

Recipe: Lemon Oregano Chickpea Pita with Tzatziki
Ingredients: Chickpeas, Pita Bread, Cucumber, Lettuce, Lemon Juice, Oregano, Garlic, Olive Oil, Tzatziki, Parsley, Cumin
Instructions: Toss the chickpeas with the lemon juice, oregano and garlic and olive oil. Mash the chickpeas with the parsley, garlic and spices, shape into patties, and pan-fry until crisp. Warm the pita bread. Stuff the pita with the chickpeas, cucumber and lettuce and spoon over the tzatziki.

Recipe: Mushroom Ragu Polenta Bowl (Dairy-Free)
Ingredients: Polenta, Vegetable Broth, Mushrooms, Marinara Sauce, Garlic, Thyme
Instructions: Whisk the polenta into the simmering vegetable broth and cook, stirring often, until thick and creamy (about 20 minutes). Cook the remaining toppings in a pan until tender and combined. Spoon the polenta into bowls and top with the mushroom ragu.

Recipe: Pulled Pork Sandwich with Honey Mustard and Lettuce and Tomato
Ingredients: Pork Shoulder, Bread, Dijon Mustard, Honey, Lettuce, Tomatoes
Instructions: Braise or slow-cook the pork until very tender (at least 145°F, ideally much longer for shredding), then shred it. Toast the bread or warm the tortilla. Spread with the dijon mustard and honey. Layer the pulled pork with the lettuce and tomatoes.

Recipe: Smoky Paprika Salmon White Rice Bowl with Hummus
Ingredients: Salmon Fillet, White Rice, Kale, Cherry Tomatoes, Smoked Paprika, Garlic, Lemon Juice, Olive Oil, Hummus
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Toss the salmon with the smoked paprika, garlic and lemon juice and olive oil. Cut the salmon into chunks and gently cook in a pan until opaque and flaky (145°F). Fill the bowls with the white rice, kale and cherry tomatoes. Top with the salmon and drizzle with the hummus.

Recipe: Mixed Berries Chia Seeds Oatmeal with Milk
Ingredients: Rolled Oats, Milk, Mixed Berries, Chia Seeds, Maple Syrup
Instructions: Simmer the oats in the milk for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring, until creamy. Top with the mixed berries, chia seeds and maple syrup.

Recipe: Turkey Burger with Guacamole and Salsa
Ingredients: Ground Turkey, Guacamole, Salsa, Lettuce, Burger Bun
Instructions: Shape the ground turkey into patties and cook to 165°F. Toast the bun. Assemble with the guacamole, salsa and lettuce.

Recipe: Bulgogi-Style Pork Rice Bowl with Carrots
Ingredients: Pork Tenderloin, Brown Rice, Soy Sauce, Brown Sugar, Sesame Oil, Garlic, Ginger, Green Onions, Carrots
Instructions: Marinate the pork in the soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, garlic and ginger for at least 20 minutes. Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Slice the pork into thin pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (145°F). Serve over the rice topped with carrots and green onions.

Recipe: Bolognese-Style Pork Linguine
Ingredients: Ground Pork, Linguine, Crushed Tomatoes, Onion, Carrots, Celery, Garlic, Olive Oil, Tomato Paste
Instructions: Cook the linguine according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Brown the ground pork in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (160°F), then set aside. Simmer the crushed tomatoes, onion, carrots and celery in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and pork with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed.

Recipe: Ginger Rice Soup with Tofu and Bok Choy
Ingredients: Tofu, Bok Choy, White Rice, Ginger, Soy Sauce, Green Onions, Vegetable Broth
Instructions: Simmer the rice in the vegetable broth with the ginger until very soft and thick. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Stir in the bok choy and cook until tender. Season with soy sauce and top with green onions.

Recipe: Black Bean Dip with Pita Chips and Cucumber
Ingredients: Black Beans, Lime Juice, Cumin, Garlic, Pita Chips, Cucumber
Instructions: Prepare the black beans dip by mashing or blending the ingredients until smooth. Cut the cucumber and arrange with the pita chips. Serve for dipping.

Recipe: Al Pastor-Style Chicken Tacos with Cotija and Pickled Onions
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Corn Tortillas, Pineapple, Chili Powder, Cumin, Garlic, Oregano, Cotija, Pickled Onions, Cilantro
Instructions: Season the chicken with the pineapple, chili powder, cumin, garlic and oregano. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the chicken and top with cotija, pickled onions and cilantro.

Recipe: Split Pea Soup with Ham with Croutons
Ingredients: Split Peas, Ham, Carrots, Onion, Celery, Chicken Broth, Thyme, Croutons
Instructions: Saute the aromatics in butter or oil until soft. Add the main vegetables or proteins, then the broth or milk, and simmer until tender. Blend until smooth or leave chunky, depending on the soup. Season to taste and top with croutons.

Recipe: Tuscan White Bean and Spinach Soup
Ingredients: White Beans, Vegetable Broth, Spinach, Onion, Carrots, Celery, Garlic, Rosemary, Olive Oil
Instructions: Saute the onion, carrots, celery and garlic in the olive oil. Add the vegetable broth, white beans and rosemary and simmer for 20 minutes. Mash a few beans against the side of the pot to thicken the soup. Stir in the spinach until wilted.

Recipe: Tofu Lo Mein with Bok Choy and Snow Peas
Ingredients: Tofu, Egg Noodles, Soy Sauce, Sesame Oil, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking Oil, Bok Choy, Snow Peas
Instructions: Cook the noodles, drain, and toss with a little oil. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides, then set aside. Stir-fry the bok choy and snow peas until tender-crisp. Add the noodles and the soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic and ginger, return the tofu, and toss until everything is coated and hot.

Recipe: Miso-Glazed Cod Rice Bowl with Edamame
Ingredients: Cod Fillet, White Rice, Miso Paste, Rice Vinegar, Honey, Ginger, Green Beans, Carrots, Edamame
Instructions: Whisk the miso, rice vinegar, honey and ginger into a glaze. Cook the white rice according to package directions. Cut the cod into chunks and gently cook in a pan until opaque and flaky (145°F), brushing with the glaze in the last few minutes. Steam the green beans and carrots until tender-crisp. Serve over the rice with edamame.

Recipe: Greek Salad with Chickpea and Feta
Ingredients: Chickpeas, Cucumber, Tomatoes, Red Onion, Olives, Olive Oil, Oregano, Red Wine Vinegar, Romaine Lettuce, Feta Cheese
Instructions: Drain and rinse the chickpeas. Chop the cucumber, tomatoes and red onion and toss with the romaine and olives. Whisk the olive oil, oregano and red wine vinegar and dress the salad. Top with the chickpeas and crumbled feta.

Recipe: Roast Turkey Wrap with Mayo and Lettuce and Tomato
Ingredients: Turkey Breast, Flour Tortillas, Mayonnaise, Lettuce, Tomatoes
Instructions: Season the turkey and roast or pan-sear until cooked through (165°F), then slice. Toast the bread or warm the tortilla. Spread with the mayonnaise. Layer the roast turkey with the lettuce and tomatoes.

Recipe: Chicken Fresh Spring Rolls with Mint and Cucumber
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Rice Paper Wrappers, Rice Noodles, Mixed Greens, Cucumber, Mint, Peanut Dipping Sauce
Instructions: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F), then slice thinly. Soak the rice paper wrappers one at a time in warm water until pliable. Layer each wrapper with the rice noodles, mixed greens, cucumber, mint and the chicken. Fold in the sides and roll tightly. Serve with the peanut dipping sauce.

Recipe: Chana Masala with Green Beans over Quinoa
Ingredients: Chickpeas, Crushed Tomatoes, Onion, Garlic, Ginger, Garam Masala, Cumin, Cilantro, Quinoa, Green Beans
Instructions: Cook the quinoa according to package directions. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger, then add the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the main ingredients, the green beans and a splash of water and simmer until tender and saucy. Serve over the quinoa with cilantro.

Recipe: Garlic Olive Oil Shrimp Penne
Ingredients: Shrimp, Penne, Olive Oil, Garlic, Chili Flakes, Parsley, Lemon Juice
Instructions: Cook the penne according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque, then set aside. Simmer the olive oil, garlic, chili flakes and parsley in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and shrimp with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed.

Recipe: Lemon Oregano Chicken Couscous Bowl with Lemon Herb Vinaigrette
Ingredients: Chicken Thighs, Couscous, Cucumber, Cherry Tomatoes, Lemon Juice, Oregano, Garlic, Olive Oil, Lemon Olive Oil Dressing, Parsley
Instructions: Cook the couscous according to package directions. Toss the chicken with the lemon juice, oregano and garlic and olive oil. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Fill the bowls with the couscous, cucumber and cherry tomatoes. Top with the chicken and drizzle with the lemon herb vinaigrette.

Recipe: Harira-Style Chickpea and Lentil Soup and Parsley
Ingredients: Chickpeas, Lentils, Diced Tomatoes, Vegetable Broth, Onion, Celery, Cinnamon, Turmeric, Parsley
Instructions: Saute the onion and celery with the cinnamon and turmeric. Add the tomatoes, chickpeas, lentils and vegetable broth and simmer for 30 minutes. Finish with parsley.

Recipe: Cumin Coriander Chicken Bulgur Bowl with Hummus
Ingredients: Chicken Thighs, Bulgur, Roasted Red Peppers, Spinach, Cumin, Coriander, Paprika, Garlic, Olive Oil, Hummus
Instructions: Cook the bulgur according to package directions. Toss the chicken with the cumin, coriander, paprika and garlic and olive oil. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Fill the bowls with the bulgur, roasted red peppers and spinach. Top with the chicken and drizzle with the hummus.

Recipe: Chipotle Sweet Potato Tacos with Guacamole and Pico de Gallo on Flour Tortillas
Ingredients: Sweet Potatoes, Flour Tortillas, Chipotle Peppers in Adobo, Garlic, Cumin, Lime Juice, Guacamole, Pico de Gallo
Instructions: Season the sweet potatoes with the chipotle peppers in adobo, garlic, cumin and lime juice. Cube the sweet potatoes and roast at 425°F until tender and caramelized (about 25 minutes). Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the sweet potatoes and top with guacamole and pico de gallo.

Recipe: Butter-Style Chicken Curry over Brown Rice
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Brown Rice, Butter, Crushed Tomatoes, Heavy Cream, Garam Masala, Garlic, Ginger
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil until soft, then stir in the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the butter, crushed tomatoes and heavy cream and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Return the chicken to the sauce and simmer until heated through, then serve over the rice.

Recipe: Garlic-Cumin Turkey Tacos with Salsa Verde and Red Onion
Ingredients: Ground Turkey, Corn Tortillas, Garlic, Cumin, Oregano, Lime Juice, Salsa Verde, Red Onion, Cilantro
Instructions: Season the turkey with the garlic, cumin, oregano and lime juice. Brown the ground turkey in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (165°F). Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the turkey and top with salsa verde, red onion and cilantro.

Recipe: Sheet-Pan Lemon Herb Cod with Sweet Potatoes and Brussels Sprouts
Ingredients: Cod Fillet, Sweet Potatoes, Brussels Sprouts, Lemon Juice, Garlic, Thyme, Olive Oil
Instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the sweet potatoes and brussels sprouts with half of the lemon juice, garlic and thyme and olive oil on a sheet pan. Coat the cod with the remaining seasoning and add to the pan. Roast until the protein is cooked through (165°F for poultry, 145°F for pork and fish) and the vegetables are tender and browned.

Recipe: Lemon Oregano Turkey Brown Rice Bowl with Garlic Yogurt Sauce
Ingredients: Turkey Breast, Brown Rice, Red Onion, Olives, Lemon Juice, Oregano, Garlic, Olive Oil, Garlic Yogurt Sauce
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Toss the turkey with the lemon juice, oregano and garlic and olive oil. Cut the turkey into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until cooked through (165°F). Fill the bowls with the brown rice, red onion and olives. Top with the turkey and drizzle with the garlic yogurt sauce.

Recipe: Mediterranean Lentil Soup with Spinach and Lemon
Ingredients: Lentils, Vegetable Broth, Carrots, Onion, Garlic, Cumin, Coriander, Lemon Juice, Spinach
Instructions: Saute the onion, carrots and garlic with the cumin and coriander. Add the lentils and vegetable broth and simmer for 25 minutes until tender. Stir in the spinach until wilted. Finish with lemon juice.

Recipe: Waffles with Banana and Honey
Ingredients: Flour, Eggs, Milk, Baking Powder, Butter, Banana, Honey
Instructions: Whisk the dry ingredients, then the eggs, milk and melted butter, and combine. Cook on a hot griddle until golden on both sides. Top with banana and honey.

Recipe: Sesame Peanut Chicken Noodles with Cucumber and Bell Pepper
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Soba Noodles, Peanut Butter, Soy Sauce, Sesame Oil, Rice Vinegar, Garlic, Lime Juice, Cucumber, Bell Pepper
Instructions: Cook the soba noodles, drain, and rinse under cold water. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, garlic and lime juice with a splash of warm water until smooth. Toss the noodles with the sauce, the cucumber and the bell pepper, then top with the chicken.

Recipe: Portobello Enchiladas with Cotija and Cilantro
Ingredients: Portobello Mushrooms, Corn Tortillas, Cotija, Crushed Tomatoes, Chili Powder, Cumin, Garlic, Onion, Cilantro
Instructions: Slice the mushrooms and saute until browned and tender. Simmer the crushed tomatoes with the chili powder, cumin, garlic and onion for 10 minutes to make a flour-free sauce. Fill the corn tortillas with the portobello and some of the cotija, roll, and place seam-side down in a baking dish. Pour the sauce over the top, sprinkle with the remaining cheese, and bake at 375°F for 20 minutes until bubbly.

Recipe: Poke-Style Shrimp Rice Bowl with Edamame
Ingredients: Shrimp, Jasmine Rice, Soy Sauce, Sesame Oil, Sesame Seeds, Rice Vinegar, Avocado, Cucumber, Edamame, Green Onions
Instructions: Cook the jasmine rice according to package directions and season with the rice vinegar. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque, then let cool slightly. Toss the shrimp with the soy sauce and sesame oil. Top the rice with the shrimp, avocado, cucumber, edamame, sesame seeds and edamame.

Recipe: Sesame Peanut Chicken Noodles with Green Onions and Cabbage
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Soba Noodles, Peanut Butter, Soy Sauce, Sesame Oil, Rice Vinegar, Garlic, Lime Juice, Green Onions, Cabbage
Instructions: Cook the soba noodles, drain, and rinse under cold water. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, garlic and lime juice with a splash of warm water until smooth. Toss the noodles with the sauce, the green onions and the cabbage, then top with the chicken.

Recipe: Chicken Udon Stir-Fry with Bell Pepper and Bok Choy
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Udon Noodles, Soy Sauce, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking Oil, Bell Pepper, Bok Choy
Instructions: Cook the udon noodles according to package directions and drain. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Stir-fry the bell pepper and bok choy with the garlic and ginger until tender-crisp. Add the noodles, soy sauce and chicken and toss until heated through.

Recipe: Chili-Lime Tilapia Tacos with Lettuce, Cheddar and Salsa
Ingredients: Tilapia Fillet, Corn Tortillas, Chili Powder, Lime Juice, Garlic, Cumin, Romaine Lettuce, Cheddar Cheese, Salsa
Instructions: Season the tilapia with the chili powder, lime juice, garlic and cumin. Cut the tilapia into chunks and gently cook in a pan until opaque and flaky (145°F). Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the tilapia and top with romaine lettuce, cheddar cheese and salsa.

Recipe: Vindaloo-Style Cauliflower Curry over Basmati Rice
Ingredients: Cauliflower, Basmati Rice, Red Wine Vinegar, Chili Powder, Garlic, Ginger, Cumin, Crushed Tomatoes, Onion, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the basmati rice according to package directions. Cut the cauliflower into florets and roast or saute until tender and lightly browned, then set aside. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil until soft, then stir in the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the crushed tomatoes and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Return the cauliflower to the sauce and simmer until heated through, then serve over the rice.

Recipe: Sheet-Pan Honey Dijon Salmon with Sweet Potatoes and Brussels Sprouts
Ingredients: Salmon Fillet, Sweet Potatoes, Brussels Sprouts, Dijon Mustard, Honey, Garlic, Olive Oil
Instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the sweet potatoes and brussels sprouts with half of the dijon mustard, honey and garlic and olive oil on a sheet pan. Coat the salmon with the remaining seasoning and add to the pan. Roast until the protein is cooked through (165°F for poultry, 145°F for pork and fish) and the vegetables are tender and browned.

Recipe: Marinara Turkey Spaghetti
Ingredients: Ground Turkey, Spaghetti, Marinara Sauce, Garlic, Basil, Olive Oil, Parmesan
Instructions: Cook the spaghetti according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Brown the ground turkey in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Simmer the marinara sauce, garlic, basil and olive oil in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and turkey with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed, and finish with parmesan.

Recipe: Strawberries Soy Parfait with Seed Granola and Honey
Ingredients: Soy Milk, Strawberries, Seed Granola, Honey
Instructions: Spoon the soy milk into a bowl. Top with the strawberries, granola and honey.

Recipe: Sheet-Pan Smoky Paprika Pork with Cauliflower and Red Onion
Ingredients: Pork Tenderloin, Cauliflower, Red Onion, Smoked Paprika, Garlic, Olive Oil
Instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the cauliflower and red onion with half of the smoked paprika and garlic and olive oil on a sheet pan. Coat the pork with the remaining seasoning and add to the pan. Roast until the protein is cooked through (165°F for poultry, 145°F for pork and fish) and the vegetables are tender and browned.

Recipe: Sweet Chili Tofu Stir-Fry with Broccoli and Bell Pepper
Ingredients: Tofu, White Rice, Broccoli, Bell Pepper, Sweet Chili Sauce, Lime Juice, Garlic, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides, then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the broccoli and bell pepper for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the tofu to the pan, add the sweet chili sauce, lime juice and garlic and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the white rice.

Recipe: Bibimbap-Style Tofu Rice Bowl with Edamame
Ingredients: Tofu, Jasmine Rice, Gochujang, Sesame Oil, Soy Sauce, Spinach, Carrots, Zucchini, Mushrooms, Eggs, Edamame
Instructions: Cook the jasmine rice according to package directions. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Saute the spinach, carrots, zucchini and mushrooms separately until tender, seasoning with a little soy sauce and sesame oil. Fry the eggs until the whites are fully set. Assemble over the rice with the tofu, vegetables and edamame, and serve with the gochujang.

Recipe: Madras-Style Lentil Curry over Brown Rice
Ingredients: Lentils, Brown Rice, Curry Powder, Chili Powder, Tomato Paste, Onion, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking Oil, Coconut Milk
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Cook the lentils until tender (or use canned lentils, drained and rinsed), then set aside. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil until soft, then stir in the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the tomato paste and coconut milk and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Return the lentils to the sauce and simmer until heated through, then serve over the rice.

Fill the corn tortillas with the beef and some of the cheddar cheese, roll, and place seam-side down in a baking dish. Pour the sauce over the top, sprinkle with the remaining cheese, and bake at 375°F for 20 minutes until bubbly.

Recipe: Pesto Chicken over Brown Rice Pasta
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Brown Rice Pasta, Pesto, Cherry Tomatoes, Olive Oil
Instructions: Cook the brown rice pasta according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Simmer the pesto, cherry tomatoes and olive oil in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and chicken with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed.

Recipe: Turkey Burger with Mustard and Tomato on Gluten-Free Bread
Ingredients: Ground Turkey, Mustard, Tomatoes, Lettuce, Gluten-Free Bread
Instructions: Shape the ground turkey into patties and cook to 165°F. Toast the bread. Assemble with the mustard, tomatoes and lettuce.

Recipe: Creamy Mushroom Turkey Linguine
Ingredients: Ground Turkey, Linguine, Heavy Cream, Mushrooms, Garlic, Thyme, Parmesan
Instructions: Cook the linguine according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Brown the ground turkey in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Simmer the heavy cream, mushrooms, garlic and thyme in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and turkey with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed, and finish with parmesan.

Recipe: Banh Mi-Style Tofu Sandwich with Jalapeno
Ingredients: Tofu, Hoagie Roll, Mayonnaise, Soy Sauce, Garlic, Carrots, Cucumber, Jalapeno, Rice Vinegar
Instructions: Marinate the tofu in soy sauce and garlic for at least 15 minutes. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Toast the hoagie roll and spread with the mayonnaise. Fill with the tofu, quick-pickled carrots, cucumber and jalapeno.

Recipe: Salmon Burger with Mustard and Tomato (Lettuce-Wrapped)
Ingredients: Salmon Fillet, Breadcrumbs, Eggs, Mustard, Tomatoes, Lettuce
Instructions: Finely chop the salmon, mix with the breadcrumbs and egg, shape into patties, and pan-sear until cooked through (145°F). Wash and dry large lettuce leaves to use as the wrap. Assemble with the mustard, tomatoes and lettuce.

Recipe: Bibimbap-Style Tofu Rice Bowl with Cucumber
Ingredients: Tofu, White Rice, Gochujang, Sesame Oil, Soy Sauce, Spinach, Carrots, Zucchini, Mushrooms, Eggs, Cucumber
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Saute the spinach, carrots, zucchini and mushrooms separately until tender, seasoning with a little soy sauce and sesame oil. Fry the eggs until the whites are fully set. Assemble over the rice with the tofu, vegetables and cucumber, and serve with the gochujang.

Recipe: Harira-Style Chickpea and Lentil Soup with Chicken and Parsley
Ingredients: Chickpeas, Lentils, Diced Tomatoes, Chicken Broth, Onion, Celery, Cinnamon, Turmeric, Parsley, Chicken Breast
Instructions: Saute the onion and celery with the cinnamon and turmeric. Add the tomatoes, chickpeas, lentils and chicken broth and simmer for 30 minutes. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F) and add to the pot. Finish with parsley.

Recipe: Primavera Spinach Linguine
Ingredients: Linguine, Olive Oil, Garlic, Zucchini, Spinach, Parmesan, Lemon Juice
Instructions: Cook the linguine according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Saute the garlic and zucchini in the olive oil for 3 minutes. Add the spinach and cook until just tender. Toss with the pasta, lemon juice and a splash of pasta water and top with parmesan.

Recipe: Italian Lentil and White Stuffed Peppers
Ingredients: Lentils, White Rice, Bell Pepper, Marinara Sauce, Garlic, Basil, Mozzarella
Instructions: Cook the lentils until tender (or use canned lentils, drained and rinsed). Mix with the cooked white rice, marinara, garlic and basil. Stuff into halved bell peppers and top with the mozzarella. Bake at 375°F for 30 minutes until the peppers are tender and the cheese is golden.

Recipe: Sesame Ginger Chicken Salad with Avocado and Red Onion on Mixed Greens
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Mixed Greens, Avocado, Red Onion, Sesame Ginger Dressing
Instructions: Season the chicken and grill or pan-sear until cooked through (165°F), then slice. Toss the mixed greens with the avocado and red onion. Top with the chicken and drizzle with the sesame ginger dressing.

Recipe: Smoky Paprika Lamb White Rice Bowl with Roasted Red Pepper Sauce
Ingredients: Lamb Leg, White Rice, Cucumber, Red Onion, Smoked Paprika, Garlic, Lemon Juice, Olive Oil, Roasted Red Peppers
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Toss the lamb with the smoked paprika, garlic and lemon juice and olive oil. Cut the lamb into bite-sized pieces and sear in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (at least 145°F). Fill the bowls with the white rice, cucumber and red onion. Top with the lamb and drizzle with the roasted red pepper sauce.

Recipe: Hot and Sour Shrimp Soup with Carrots
Ingredients: Shrimp, Carrots, Soy Sauce, Rice Vinegar, Black Pepper, Cornstarch, Eggs, Mushrooms, Ginger, Vegetable Broth
Instructions: Bring the vegetable broth to a simmer with the ginger and mushrooms. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Stir in the soy sauce and rice vinegar, then thicken with the cornstarch mixed with water. Drizzle in the beaten eggs while stirring slowly to make ribbons. Finish with black pepper and the carrots.

Recipe: Sheet-Pan BBQ Pork with Sweet Potatoes and Brussels Sprouts
Ingredients: Pork Tenderloin, Sweet Potatoes, Brussels Sprouts, BBQ Sauce, Olive Oil
Instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the sweet potatoes and brussels sprouts with half of the bbq sauce and olive oil on a sheet pan. Coat the pork with the remaining seasoning and add to the pan. Roast until the protein is cooked through (165°F for poultry, 145°F for pork and fish) and the vegetables are tender and browned.

Recipe: Marinara Chicken Penne
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Penne, Marinara Sauce, Garlic, Basil, Olive Oil, Parmesan
Instructions: Cook the penne according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Simmer the marinara sauce, garlic, basil and olive oil in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and chicken with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed, and finish with parmesan.

Recipe: Tofu Pad Thai-Style Noodles
Ingredients: Tofu, Rice Noodles, Fish Sauce, Tamarind Paste, Brown Sugar, Lime Juice, Eggs, Bean Sprouts, Peanuts, Green Onions, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Soak the rice noodles in hot water until just tender, then drain. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides, then push to the side of the pan. Scramble the eggs in the same pan until set. Add the noodles with the fish sauce, tamarind paste, brown sugar and lime juice and toss until coated. Top with the peanuts, bean sprouts and green onions.

Recipe: Hoisin Turkey Lettuce Cups with Carrots
Ingredients: Ground Turkey, Butter Lettuce, Hoisin Sauce, Water Chestnuts, Green Onions, Garlic, Rice Vinegar, Carrots, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Brown the ground turkey in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Saute the garlic and carrots for 2 minutes. Return the turkey to the pan with the hoisin sauce, rice vinegar and water chestnuts and cook until glazed. Spoon into the lettuce leaves and top with green onions.

Recipe: Puttanesca-Style Shrimp Penne
Ingredients: Shrimp, Penne, Crushed Tomatoes, Olives, Capers, Anchovy Fillets, Garlic, Chili Flakes
Instructions: Cook the penne according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque, then set aside. Simmer the crushed tomatoes, olives, capers and anchovy fillets in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and shrimp with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed.

Recipe: Creamy Alfredo Portobello over Brown Rice Pasta
Ingredients: Portobello Mushrooms, Brown Rice Pasta, Heavy Cream, Butter, Parmesan, Garlic, Black Pepper
Instructions: Cook the brown rice pasta according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Slice the mushrooms and saute until browned and tender, then set aside. Simmer the heavy cream, butter and garlic in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and portobello with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed, and finish with parmesan.

Recipe: Katsu-Style Pork Rice Bowl with Pineapple
Ingredients: Pork Tenderloin, Jasmine Rice, Breadcrumbs, Eggs, Flour, Cooking Oil, Soy Sauce, Cabbage, Carrots, Pineapple
Instructions: Cook the jasmine rice according to package directions. Coat the pork in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs. Pan-fry in oil until golden and cooked through (165F for chicken, 145F for pork), then slice. Serve over the rice with shredded cabbage, carrots, a drizzle of soy sauce and pineapple.

Recipe: Carbonara-Style Spinach Spaghetti
Ingredients: Bacon, Spaghetti, Eggs, Parmesan, Black Pepper, Spinach
Instructions: Cook the spaghetti according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Cook the bacon until crisp. Saute the spinach in the bacon fat until tender. Whisk the eggs with the parmesan and black pepper. Toss the hot pasta with the bacon and vegetables off the heat, then stir in the egg mixture with a splash of pasta water. Warm gently over low heat, stirring constantly, until the sauce thickens and reaches 160°F (do not let it scramble).

Recipe: Grilled Chicken Sandwich on Gluten-Free Bread with Dijon and Red Onion and Pickles
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Gluten-Free Bread, Dijon Mustard, Red Onion, Pickles
Instructions: Season the chicken and grill or pan-sear until cooked through (165°F), then slice. Toast the bread or warm the tortilla. Spread with the dijon mustard. Layer the grilled chicken with the red onion and pickles.

Recipe: Lemon Oregano Chickpea Pita with Garlic Yogurt Sauce
Ingredients: Chickpeas, Pita Bread, Red Onion, Lettuce, Lemon Juice, Oregano, Garlic, Olive Oil, Garlic Yogurt Sauce, Parsley, Cumin
Instructions: Toss the chickpeas with the lemon juice, oregano and garlic and olive oil. Mash the chickpeas with the parsley, garlic and spices, shape into patties, and pan-fry until crisp. Warm the pita bread. Stuff the pita with the chickpeas, red onion and lettuce and spoon over the garlic yogurt sauce.

Recipe: Turkey Burger with BBQ Sauce and Red Onion (Lettuce-Wrapped)
Ingredients: Ground Turkey, BBQ Sauce, Red Onion, Lettuce
Instructions: Shape the ground turkey into patties and cook to 165°F. Wash and dry large lettuce leaves to use as the wrap. Assemble with the bbq sauce, red onion and lettuce.

Recipe: Sheet-Pan Garlic Parmesan Tofu with Asparagus and Cherry Tomatoes
Ingredients: Tofu, Asparagus, Cherry Tomatoes, Parmesan, Garlic, Olive Oil
Instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the asparagus and cherry tomatoes with half of the parmesan and garlic and olive oil on a sheet pan. Coat the tofu with the remaining seasoning and add to the pan. Roast until the protein is cooked through (165°F for poultry, 145°F for pork and fish) and the vegetables are tender and browned.

Recipe: Thai Coconut-Lime Salmon Rice Bowl with Mango
Ingredients: Salmon Fillet, White Rice, Coconut Milk, Fish Sauce, Lime Juice, Cilantro, Bell Pepper, Peanuts, Mango
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Cut the salmon into chunks and gently cook in a pan until opaque and flaky (145°F). Add the coconut milk, fish sauce and lime juice and simmer for 5 minutes. Stir in the bell pepper and cook until just tender. Serve over the rice topped with the peanuts, cilantro and mango.

Recipe: Lemon Oregano Shrimp Pita with Lemon Herb Vinaigrette
Ingredients: Shrimp, Pita Bread, Red Onion, Lettuce, Lemon Juice, Oregano, Garlic, Olive Oil, Lemon Olive Oil Dressing, Parsley
Instructions: Toss the shrimp with the lemon juice, oregano and garlic and olive oil. Season the shrimp and cook in a hot pan or on the grill for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Warm the pita bread. Stuff the pita with the shrimp, red onion and lettuce and spoon over the lemon herb vinaigrette.

Recipe: Chipotle Turkey Tacos with Salsa Verde and Red Onion
Ingredients: Ground Turkey, Corn Tortillas, Chipotle Peppers in Adobo, Garlic, Cumin, Lime Juice, Salsa Verde, Red Onion, Cilantro
Instructions: Season the turkey with the chipotle peppers in adobo, garlic, cumin and lime juice. Brown the ground turkey in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (165°F). Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the turkey and top with salsa verde, red onion and cilantro.

Recipe: Poke-Style Tuna Rice Bowl with Cucumber
Ingredients: Tuna Steak, White Rice, Soy Sauce, Sesame Oil, Sesame Seeds, Rice Vinegar, Avocado, Cucumber, Edamame, Green Onions
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions and season with the rice vinegar. Sear the tuna on all sides until cooked through (145°F), then cut into cubes, then let cool slightly. Toss the tuna with the soy sauce and sesame oil. Top the rice with the tuna, avocado, cucumber, edamame, sesame seeds and cucumber.

Recipe: Miso Soup with Tofu and Mushrooms
Ingredients: Tofu, Mushrooms, Miso Paste, Dashi Stock, Seaweed, Green Onions
Instructions: Heat the dashi stock until barely simmering. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Add the mushrooms and cook for 2 minutes. Whisk in the miso paste off the boil and add the seaweed. Top with green onions and the tofu.

Recipe: Lemon Butter Shrimp Linguine
Ingredients: Shrimp, Linguine, Butter, Lemon Juice, Parsley, Garlic, Parmesan
Instructions: Cook the linguine according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque, then set aside. Simmer the butter, lemon juice, parsley and garlic in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and shrimp with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed, and finish with parmesan.

Recipe: Coconut Lime Shrimp Soup with Bok Choy
Ingredients: Shrimp, Bok Choy, Coconut Milk, Fish Sauce, Lemongrass, Ginger, Lime Juice, Mushrooms, Cilantro, Vegetable Broth
Instructions: Simmer the vegetable broth with the lemongrass and ginger for 10 minutes. Add the coconut milk, mushrooms and bok choy. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Season with the fish sauce and lime juice and finish with cilantro.

Recipe: Carrot Ginger Soup with Croutons
Ingredients: Carrots, Ginger, Coconut Milk, Onion, Vegetable Broth, Croutons
Instructions: Saute the aromatics in butter or oil until soft. Add the main vegetables or proteins, then the broth or milk, and simmer until tender. Blend until smooth or leave chunky, depending on the soup. Season to taste and top with croutons.

Recipe: Tuna Salad Sub with Mozzarella and Basil
Ingredients: Canned Tuna, Mayonnaise, Celery, Lemon Juice, Hoagie Roll, Mozzarella, Basil
Instructions: Flake the tuna and mix with the mayonnaise, celery and lemon juice. Toast the bread or warm the tortilla. Fill with the tuna salad and mozzarella and basil.

Recipe: Al Pastor-Style Pork Tacos with Mango Salsa
Ingredients: Pork Shoulder, Corn Tortillas, Pineapple, Chili Powder, Cumin, Garlic, Oregano, Mango, Red Onion, Jalapeno, Lime Juice, Cilantro
Instructions: Season the pork with the pineapple, chili powder, cumin, garlic and oregano. Braise or slow-cook the pork until very tender (at least 145°F, ideally much longer for shredding), then shred it. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the pork and top with mango, red onion, jalapeno, lime juice and cilantro.

Recipe: Almond Butter Rice Cakes Bites with Banana
Ingredients: Rice Cakes, Almond Butter, Banana
Instructions: Spread the almond butter on the rice cakes. Top with sliced banana.

Recipe: Lemon Oregano Chicken Bulgur Bowl with Tahini Lemon Sauce
Ingredients: Chicken Thighs, Bulgur, Red Onion, Olives, Lemon Juice, Oregano, Garlic, Olive Oil, Tahini
Instructions: Cook the bulgur according to package directions. Toss the chicken with the lemon juice, oregano and garlic and olive oil. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Fill the bowls with the bulgur, red onion and olives. Top with the chicken and drizzle with the tahini lemon sauce.

Recipe: Banh Mi-Style Pork Sandwich with Cilantro
Ingredients: Pork Tenderloin, Hoagie Roll, Mayonnaise, Soy Sauce, Garlic, Carrots, Cucumber, Cilantro, Rice Vinegar
Instructions: Marinate the pork in soy sauce and garlic for at least 15 minutes. Slice the pork into thin pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (145°F). Toast the hoagie roll and spread with the mayonnaise. Fill with the pork, quick-pickled carrots, cucumber and cilantro.

Recipe: Sheet-Pan Honey Dijon Cauliflower with Broccoli and Carrots
Ingredients: Cauliflower, Broccoli, Carrots, Dijon Mustard, Honey, Garlic, Olive Oil
Instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the broccoli and carrots with half of the dijon mustard, honey and garlic and olive oil on a sheet pan. Coat the cauliflower with the remaining seasoning and add to the pan. Roast until the protein is cooked through (165°F for poultry, 145°F for pork and fish) and the vegetables are tender and browned.

Recipe: Lemon Oregano Turkey Pita with Roasted Red Pepper Sauce
Ingredients: Turkey Breast, Pita Bread, Red Onion, Lettuce, Lemon Juice, Oregano, Garlic, Olive Oil, Roasted Red Peppers
Instructions: Toss the turkey with the lemon juice, oregano and garlic and olive oil. Season the turkey and roast or pan-sear until cooked through (165°F), then slice. Warm the pita bread. Stuff the pita with the turkey, red onion and lettuce and spoon over the roasted red pepper sauce.

Recipe: Kimchi Shrimp Fried Rice (Brown Rice)
Ingredients: Shrimp, Brown Rice, Kimchi, Eggs, Soy Sauce, Sesame Oil, Green Onions
Instructions: Use day-old cold cooked brown rice for the best texture. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque, then set aside. Heat the oil in a large pan and stir-fry the aromatics and vegetables for 2 minutes. Add the rice and the kimchi, soy sauce and sesame oil and stir-fry until the rice is hot and lightly toasted. Fold in the shrimp and eggs and cook until everything is heated through.

Recipe: Thai Basil Edamame Stir-Fry with Zucchini and Bell Pepper
Ingredients: Edamame, Brown Rice, Zucchini, Bell Pepper, Fish Sauce, Oyster Sauce, Thai Basil, Dried Chilies, Garlic, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Boil or steam the edamame for 4 to 5 minutes until tender, then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the zucchini and bell pepper for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the edamame to the pan, add the fish sauce, oyster sauce, thai basil, dried chilies and garlic and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the brown rice.

Recipe: Turkey and Corn Quesadilla with Cheddar
Ingredients: Ground Turkey, Flour Tortillas, Cheddar Cheese, Corn, Jalapeno, Salsa
Instructions: Brown the ground turkey in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (165°F). Saute the corn and jalapeno until soft. Fill half of each flour tortilla with the turkey, vegetables and cheddar cheese, then fold over. Cook in a dry pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until crisp and the cheese melts. Serve with salsa.

Recipe: Sheet-Pan Lemon Herb Chickpea with Asparagus and Cherry Tomatoes
Ingredients: Chickpeas, Asparagus, Cherry Tomatoes, Lemon Juice, Garlic, Thyme, Olive Oil
Instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the asparagus and cherry tomatoes with half of the lemon juice, garlic and thyme and olive oil on a sheet pan. Coat the chickpeas with the remaining seasoning and add to the pan. Roast until the protein is cooked through (165°F for poultry, 145°F for pork and fish) and the vegetables are tender and browned.

Recipe: Mango Peanut Smoothie with Coconut Milk
Ingredients: Coconut Milk, Mango, Peanut Butter
Instructions: Blend the coconut milk, mango and peanut butter with ice until smooth.

Recipe: Pineapple Cashew Ham Fried Rice
Ingredients: Ham, Jasmine Rice, Pineapple, Cashews, Curry Powder, Soy Sauce, Eggs, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Use day-old cold cooked jasmine rice for the best texture. Dice the ham and warm it through in the pan, then set aside. Heat the oil in a large pan and stir-fry the aromatics and vegetables for 2 minutes. Add the rice and the curry powder and soy sauce and stir-fry until the rice is hot and lightly toasted. Fold in the ham and eggs and cook until everything is heated through.

Recipe: Greek Salad with Turkey (No Cheese)
Ingredients: Turkey Breast, Cucumber, Tomatoes, Red Onion, Olives, Olive Oil, Oregano, Red Wine Vinegar, Romaine Lettuce
Instructions: Season the turkey and roast or pan-sear until cooked through (165°F), then slice. Chop the cucumber, tomatoes and red onion and toss with the romaine and olives. Whisk the olive oil, oregano and red wine vinegar and dress the salad. Top with the turkey.

Recipe: Italian Lentil and Quinoa Stuffed Peppers
Ingredients: Lentils, Quinoa, Bell Pepper, Marinara Sauce, Garlic, Basil, Mozzarella
Instructions: Cook the lentils until tender (or use canned lentils, drained and rinsed). Mix with the cooked quinoa, marinara, garlic and basil. Stuff into halved bell peppers and top with the mozzarella. Bake at 375°F for 30 minutes until the peppers are tender and the cheese is golden.

Recipe: Three-Bean Chili with Smoked Paprika Spices and Cheddar Cheese
Ingredients: Kidney Beans, Black Beans, Pinto Beans, Diced Tomatoes, Smoked Paprika, Cumin, Chipotle Peppers in Adobo, Onion, Bell Pepper, Garlic, Cheddar Cheese
Instructions: Saute the onion, bell pepper and garlic with the spices. Add the remaining ingredients with a cup of water and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes. Serve topped with cheddar cheese.

Recipe: Tomato Basil Soup with Chicken (Dairy-Free)
Ingredients: Crushed Tomatoes, Vegetable Broth, Onion, Garlic, Basil, Coconut Milk, Olive Oil, Chicken Breast
Instructions: Saute the onion and garlic in the olive oil. Add the crushed tomatoes and vegetable broth and simmer for 20 minutes. Blend until smooth. Stir in the coconut milk and basil. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F) and add to the soup.

Recipe: Sheet-Pan Smoky Paprika Tofu with Potatoes and Green Beans
Ingredients: Tofu, Potatoes, Green Beans, Smoked Paprika, Garlic, Olive Oil
Instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the potatoes and green beans with half of the smoked paprika and garlic and olive oil on a sheet pan. Coat the tofu with the remaining seasoning and add to the pan. Roast until the protein is cooked through (165°F for poultry, 145°F for pork and fish) and the vegetables are tender and browned.

Recipe: Tuscan White Bean and Spinach Soup with Bacon
Ingredients: White Beans, Vegetable Broth, Spinach, Onion, Carrots, Celery, Garlic, Rosemary, Olive Oil, Bacon
Instructions: Saute the onion, carrots, celery and garlic in the olive oil. Add the vegetable broth, white beans and rosemary and simmer for 20 minutes. Cook the bacon until crisp, then crumble it. Stir in the spinach until wilted.

Recipe: Chana Masala with Green Beans over Brown Rice
Ingredients: Chickpeas, Crushed Tomatoes, Onion, Garlic, Ginger, Garam Masala, Cumin, Cilantro, Brown Rice, Green Beans
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger, then add the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the main ingredients, the green beans and a splash of water and simmer until tender and saucy. Serve over the brown rice with cilantro.

Recipe: Lemon Olive Oil Chicken Salad with Strawberries and Pecans on Mixed Greens
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Mixed Greens, Strawberries, Pecans, Lemon Olive Oil Dressing
Instructions: Season the chicken and grill or pan-sear until cooked through (165°F), then slice. Toss the mixed greens with the strawberries and pecans. Top with the chicken and drizzle with the lemon olive oil dressing.

Recipe: Cumin Coriander Chicken Couscous Bowl with Garlic Yogurt Sauce
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Couscous, Cucumber, Cherry Tomatoes, Cumin, Coriander, Paprika, Garlic, Olive Oil, Garlic Yogurt Sauce
Instructions: Cook the couscous according to package directions. Toss the chicken with the cumin, coriander, paprika and garlic and olive oil. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Fill the bowls with the couscous, cucumber and cherry tomatoes. Top with the chicken and drizzle with the garlic yogurt sauce.

Recipe: Honey Garlic Chicken Rice Bowl with Pineapple
Ingredients: Chicken Thighs, Jasmine Rice, Honey, Soy Sauce, Garlic, Ginger, Sesame Seeds, Broccoli, Pineapple
Instructions: Cook the jasmine rice according to package directions. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Add the honey, soy sauce, garlic and ginger and simmer until sticky. Steam the broccoli until tender-crisp. Serve over the rice sprinkled with the sesame seeds and pineapple.

Recipe: Tabbouleh-Style Salad with Shrimp and Parsley
Ingredients: Shrimp, Bulgur, Tomatoes, Cucumber, Parsley, Lemon Juice, Olive Oil, Red Onion
Instructions: Soak the bulgur in hot water until tender, then drain well. Season the shrimp and cook in a hot pan or on the grill for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Toss the bulgur with the chopped tomatoes, cucumber, red onion and plenty of parsley. Dress with the lemon juice and olive oil and top with the shrimp.

Recipe: Almond Dates Energy Bites with Dried Cranberries
Ingredients: Rolled Oats, Almond Butter, Dates, Dried Cranberries
Instructions: Mix the oats, almond butter, dates and dried cranberries in a bowl. Roll into bite-sized balls and refrigerate until firm.

Recipe: Sesame Ginger Bacon Salad with Apple and Walnuts on Arugula
Ingredients: Bacon, Arugula, Apple, Walnuts, Sesame Ginger Dressing
Instructions: Cook the bacon until crisp and crumble it. Toss the arugula with the apple and walnuts. Top with the bacon and drizzle with the sesame ginger dressing.

Recipe: Shrimp Fresh Spring Rolls with Basil and Cucumber
Ingredients: Shrimp, Rice Paper Wrappers, Rice Noodles, Mixed Greens, Cucumber, Basil, Peanut Dipping Sauce
Instructions: Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque, then slice thinly. Soak the rice paper wrappers one at a time in warm water until pliable. Layer each wrapper with the rice noodles, mixed greens, cucumber, basil and the shrimp. Fold in the sides and roll tightly. Serve with the peanut dipping sauce.

Recipe: Pulled Pork Sandwich with Hummus and Red Onion and Pickles
Ingredients: Pork Shoulder, Bread, Hummus, Red Onion, Pickles
Instructions: Braise or slow-cook the pork until very tender (at least 145°F, ideally much longer for shredding), then shred it. Toast the bread or warm the tortilla. Spread with the hummus. Layer the pulled pork with the red onion and pickles.

Recipe: Sheet-Pan Maple Mustard Shrimp with Sweet Potatoes and Brussels Sprouts
Ingredients: Shrimp, Sweet Potatoes, Brussels Sprouts, Maple Syrup, Dijon Mustard, Olive Oil
Instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the sweet potatoes and brussels sprouts with half of the maple syrup and dijon mustard and olive oil on a sheet pan. Coat the shrimp with the remaining seasoning and add to the pan. Roast until the protein is cooked through (165°F for poultry, 145°F for pork and fish) and the vegetables are tender and browned.

Recipe: Italian Beef and Brown Stuffed Peppers
Ingredients: Ground Beef, Brown Rice, Bell Pepper, Marinara Sauce, Garlic, Basil, Mozzarella
Instructions: Brown the ground beef in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (160°F). Mix with the cooked brown rice, marinara, garlic and basil. Stuff into halved bell peppers and top with the mozzarella. Bake at 375°F for 30 minutes until the peppers are tender and the cheese is golden.

Recipe: Avgolemono-Style Lemon Chicken Soup with Brown
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Chicken Broth, Brown Rice, Eggs, Lemon Juice, Dill, Carrots, Onion
Instructions: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Simmer the chicken broth with the carrots, onion and brown rice until tender. Whisk the eggs with the lemon juice, then slowly whisk in a ladle of hot broth to temper them. Stir the egg mixture back into the soup over low heat until slightly thickened (do not boil). Top with dill.

Recipe: Black Beans and Salsa Omelet (Dairy-Free)
Ingredients: Eggs, Black Beans, Salsa, Olive Oil
Instructions: Saute the black beans and salsa in the oil until tender. Whisk the eggs and pour into the pan. Cook gently, stirring (scramble) or folding (omelet), until the eggs are fully set.

Recipe: Primavera Asparagus Fettuccine
Ingredients: Fettuccine, Olive Oil, Garlic, Zucchini, Asparagus, Parmesan, Lemon Juice
Instructions: Cook the fettuccine according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Saute the garlic and zucchini in the olive oil for 3 minutes. Add the asparagus and cook until just tender. Toss with the pasta, lemon juice and a splash of pasta water and top with parmesan.

Recipe: Tofu Fresh Spring Rolls with Basil and Carrots
Ingredients: Tofu, Rice Paper Wrappers, Rice Noodles, Mixed Greens, Carrots, Basil, Peanut Dipping Sauce
Instructions: Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides, then slice thinly. Soak the rice paper wrappers one at a time in warm water until pliable. Layer each wrapper with the rice noodles, mixed greens, carrots, basil and the tofu. Fold in the sides and roll tightly. Serve with the peanut dipping sauce.

Recipe: Garlic Herb Halloumi Pita with Hummus
Ingredients: Halloumi, Pita Bread, Cucumber, Lettuce, Garlic, Parsley, Thyme, Olive Oil, Hummus
Instructions: Toss the halloumi with the garlic, parsley and thyme and olive oil. Slice the halloumi and grill or pan-fry until golden on both sides. Warm the pita bread. Stuff the pita with the halloumi, cucumber and lettuce and spoon over the hummus.

Recipe: Hot and Sour Chicken Soup with Bok Choy
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Bok Choy, Soy Sauce, Rice Vinegar, Black Pepper, Cornstarch, Eggs, Mushrooms, Ginger, Chicken Broth
Instructions: Bring the chicken broth to a simmer with the ginger and mushrooms. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Stir in the soy sauce and rice vinegar, then thicken with the cornstarch mixed with water. Drizzle in the beaten eggs while stirring slowly to make ribbons. Finish with black pepper and the bok choy.

Recipe: Thai Coconut-Lime Shrimp Rice Bowl with Pickled Onions
Ingredients: Shrimp, Jasmine Rice, Coconut Milk, Fish Sauce, Lime Juice, Cilantro, Bell Pepper, Peanuts, Pickled Onions
Instructions: Cook the jasmine rice according to package directions. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Add the coconut milk, fish sauce and lime juice and simmer for 5 minutes. Stir in the bell pepper and cook until just tender. Serve over the rice topped with the peanuts, cilantro and pickled onions.

Recipe: Avocado Lime Chicken Salad with Corn and Black Beans on Mixed Greens
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Mixed Greens, Corn, Black Beans, Avocado Lime Dressing
Instructions: Season the chicken and grill or pan-sear until cooked through (165°F), then slice. Toss the mixed greens with the corn and black beans. Top with the chicken and drizzle with the avocado lime dressing.

Recipe: Garlic-Cumin Beef Tacos with Cabbage Slaw and Lime Crema on Flour Tortillas
Ingredients: Ground Beef, Flour Tortillas, Garlic, Cumin, Oregano, Lime Juice, Coleslaw Mix, Lime Crema, Cilantro
Instructions: Season the beef with the garlic, cumin, oregano and lime juice. Brown the ground beef in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (160°F). Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the beef and top with coleslaw mix, lime crema, cilantro and lime juice.

Recipe: Honey Mustard Tuna Salad with Apple and Walnuts on Kale
Ingredients: Canned Tuna, Kale, Apple, Walnuts, Honey Mustard Vinaigrette
Instructions: Flake the canned tuna. Toss the kale with the apple and walnuts. Top with the tuna and drizzle with the honey mustard vinaigrette.

Recipe: Baked Spinach Rice Pasta with Mozzarella
Ingredients: Spinach, Brown Rice Pasta, Marinara Sauce, Garlic, Basil, Mozzarella, Parmesan
Instructions: Cook the brown rice pasta until just shy of tender and drain. Saute the spinach until tender. Stir the marinara sauce, garlic and basil into the pan. Combine with the pasta and half the mozzarella and transfer to a baking dish. Top with the remaining mozzarella and the parmesan and bake at 375°F for 20 to 25 minutes until bubbling.

Recipe: Al Pastor-Style Sweet Potato Tacos with Salsa Verde and Red Onion
Ingredients: Sweet Potatoes, Corn Tortillas, Pineapple, Chili Powder, Cumin, Garlic, Oregano, Salsa Verde, Red Onion, Cilantro
Instructions: Season the sweet potatoes with the pineapple, chili powder, cumin, garlic and oregano. Cube the sweet potatoes and roast at 425°F until tender and caramelized (about 25 minutes). Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the sweet potatoes and top with salsa verde, red onion and cilantro.

Recipe: Grilled Halloumi Sandwich with Dijon and Bacon
Ingredients: Halloumi, Bread, Dijon Mustard, Bacon, Lettuce
Instructions: Slice the halloumi and grill or pan-fry until golden on both sides. Toast the bread or warm the tortilla. Spread with the dijon mustard. Layer the grilled halloumi with the bacon and lettuce.

Recipe: Mushrooms and Onion Omelet (Dairy-Free)
Ingredients: Eggs, Mushrooms, Onion, Olive Oil
Instructions: Saute the mushrooms and onion in the oil until tender. Whisk the eggs and pour into the pan. Cook gently, stirring (scramble) or folding (omelet), until the eggs are fully set.

Recipe: Garlic Herb Lamb Quinoa Bowl with Hummus
Ingredients: Lamb Leg, Quinoa, Kale, Cherry Tomatoes, Garlic, Parsley, Thyme, Olive Oil, Hummus
Instructions: Cook the quinoa according to package directions. Toss the lamb with the garlic, parsley and thyme and olive oil. Cut the lamb into bite-sized pieces and sear in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (at least 145°F). Fill the bowls with the quinoa, kale and cherry tomatoes. Top with the lamb and drizzle with the hummus.

Recipe: Taco-Seasoned Chicken Burrito Bowl with Black Beans and Avocado
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, White Rice, Black Beans, Avocado, Taco Seasoning, Tomato Paste, Olive Oil
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Season the chicken with the taco seasoning and tomato paste. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Drain and rinse the black beans, then warm them through in a pan. Build the bowls with the rice, beans, chicken and avocado.

Recipe: Pulled Pork Sandwich on Gluten-Free Bread with Pesto and Bacon
Ingredients: Pork Shoulder, Gluten-Free Bread, Pesto, Bacon, Lettuce
Instructions: Braise or slow-cook the pork until very tender (at least 145°F, ideally much longer for shredding), then shred it. Toast the bread or warm the tortilla. Spread with the pesto. Layer the pulled pork with the bacon and lettuce.

Recipe: Blueberries Coconut Parfait with Almond Granola and Honey
Ingredients: Coconut Milk, Blueberries, Almond Granola, Honey
Instructions: Spoon the coconut milk into a bowl. Top with the blueberries, granola and honey.

Recipe: Dark Chocolate Dipped Apple with dark chocolate chips

Instructions: Prepare the apple. Add the toppings and chill until set. Serve once cool.

Recipe: Bolognese-Style Pork Penne
Ingredients: Ground Pork, Penne, Crushed Tomatoes, Onion, Carrots, Celery, Garlic, Olive Oil, Tomato Paste
Instructions: Cook the penne according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Brown the ground pork in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (160°F), then set aside. Recipe: Creamy Alfredo Scallop Linguine
Ingredients: Scallops, Linguine, Heavy Cream, Butter, Parmesan, Garlic, Black Pepper

Recipe: Honey Garlic Chicken Rice Bowl with Edamame
Ingredients: Chicken Thighs, Brown Rice, Honey, Soy Sauce, Garlic, Ginger, Sesame Seeds, Broccoli, Edamame
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Recipe: Sesame Ginger Chickpea Salad with Cherry Tomatoes and Cucumber on Mixed Greens
Ingredients: Chickpeas, Mixed Greens, Cherry Tomatoes, Cucumber, Sesame Ginger Dressing
Instructions: Drain and rinse the chickpeas. Toss the mixed greens with the cherry tomatoes and cucumber. Top with the chickpeas and drizzle with the sesame ginger dressing.

Recipe: Banana Almond Butter Overnight Oats with Coconut Milk
Ingredients: Rolled Oats, Coconut Milk, Banana, Almond Butter, Maple Syrup
Instructions: Stir the oats with the coconut milk in a jar and refrigerate overnight. Top with the banana, almond butter and maple syrup.

Recipe: Spicy Arrabbiata Turkey Rigatoni

Ingredients: Flank Steak, Spinach, Blue Cheese, Dried Cranberries, Ranch Dressing
Instructions: Season the steak and grill or sear to at least 145°F, rest for 5 minutes, then slice against the grain. Toss the spinach with the blue cheese and dried cranberries. Top with the steak and drizzle with the ranch dressing.

Recipe: Mixed Berries Almond Smoothie with Milk
Ingredients: Milk, Mixed Berries, Almond Butter
Instructions: Blend the milk, mixed berries and almond butter with ice until smooth.

Recipe: Broccoli Cheddar Soup with Croutons

Recipe: Baked Mushrooms Penne with Ricotta

Stir-fry the cabbage and carrots until tender-crisp. Add the noodles and the soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic and ginger, return the shrimp, and toss until everything is coated and hot.

Recipe: Singapore-Style Tofu Noodles with Bell Pepper
Ingredients: Tofu, Rice Noodles, Curry Powder, Soy Sauce, Eggs, Garlic, Cooking Oil, Bell Pepper, Bean Sprouts

Stir-fry the bell pepper, bean sprouts and garlic, add the curry powder and soy sauce, then toss in the noodles, tofu and eggs until hot.

Recipe: Miso-Glazed Salmon Rice Bowl with Green Onions
Ingredients: Salmon Fillet, White Rice, Miso Paste, Rice Vinegar, Honey, Ginger, Green Beans, Carrots, Green Onions

Recipe: Shrimp Ramen Bowl with Mushrooms
