Recipe: Smoky Paprika Chicken Brown Rice Bowl with Tzatziki
Ingredients: Chicken Thighs, Brown Rice, Kale, Cherry Tomatoes, Smoked Paprika, Garlic, Lemon Juice, Olive Oil, Tzatziki
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Toss the chicken with the smoked paprika, garlic and lemon juice and olive oil. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Fill the bowls with the brown rice, kale and cherry tomatoes. Top with the chicken and drizzle with the tzatziki.

Recipe: Sheet-Pan Cajun Tofu with Sweet Potatoes and Brussels Sprouts
Ingredients: Tofu, Sweet Potatoes, Brussels Sprouts, Cajun Seasoning, Olive Oil
Instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the sweet potatoes and brussels sprouts with half of the cajun seasoning and olive oil on a sheet pan. Coat the tofu with the remaining seasoning and add to the pan. Roast until the protein is cooked through (165°F for poultry, 145°F for pork and fish) and the vegetables are tender and browned.

Recipe: Classic Beef Chili with Smoked Paprika Spices and Cheddar Cheese
Ingredients: Ground Beef, Kidney Beans, Diced Tomatoes, Smoked Paprika, Cumin, Chipotle Peppers in Adobo, Onion, Bell Pepper, Garlic, Cheddar Cheese
Instructions: Saute the onion, bell pepper and garlic with the spices. Brown the ground beef in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (160°F). Add the remaining ingredients with a cup of water and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes. Serve topped with cheddar cheese.

Recipe: Spicy Arrabbiata Chicken Penne
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Penne, Crushed Tomatoes, Chili Flakes, Garlic, Olive Oil, Basil
Instructions: Cook the penne according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Simmer the crushed tomatoes, chili flakes, garlic and olive oil in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and chicken with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed.

Recipe: Mulligatawny-Style Sweet Potato Soup with Carrots
Ingredients: Sweet Potatoes, Vegetable Broth, Lentils, Coconut Milk, Curry Powder, Onion, Garlic, Carrots
Instructions: Saute the onion and garlic with the curry powder. Add the vegetable broth, lentils and carrots and simmer for 25 minutes. Cube the sweet potatoes and roast at 425°F until tender and caramelized (about 25 minutes). Stir in the coconut milk and blend partly for a thick texture.

Recipe: Black Pepper Edamame Stir-Fry with Green Beans and Red Onion
Ingredients: Edamame, Jasmine Rice, Green Beans, Red Onion, Soy Sauce, Black Pepper, Garlic, Butter, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the jasmine rice according to package directions. Boil or steam the edamame for 4 to 5 minutes until tender, then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the green beans and red onion for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the edamame to the pan, add the soy sauce, black pepper, garlic and butter and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the jasmine rice.

Recipe: Thai Basil Tofu Stir-Fry with Asparagus and Mushrooms
Ingredients: Tofu, Jasmine Rice, Asparagus, Mushrooms, Fish Sauce, Oyster Sauce, Thai Basil, Dried Chilies, Garlic, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the jasmine rice according to package directions. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides, then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the asparagus and mushrooms for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the tofu to the pan, add the fish sauce, oyster sauce, thai basil, dried chilies and garlic and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the jasmine rice.

Recipe: Garlic-Cumin Shrimp Tacos with Cabbage Slaw and Lime Crema
Ingredients: Shrimp, Corn Tortillas, Garlic, Cumin, Oregano, Lime Juice, Coleslaw Mix, Lime Crema, Cilantro
Instructions: Season the shrimp with the garlic, cumin, oregano and lime juice. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the shrimp and top with coleslaw mix, lime crema, cilantro and lime juice.

Recipe: Black Bean Enchiladas with Monterey and Lime Juice
Ingredients: Black Beans, Corn Tortillas, Monterey Jack Cheese, Crushed Tomatoes, Chili Powder, Cumin, Garlic, Onion, Lime Juice
Instructions: Drain and rinse the black beans, then warm them through in a pan. Simmer the crushed tomatoes with the chili powder, cumin, garlic and onion for 10 minutes to make a flour-free sauce. Fill the corn tortillas with the black beans and some of the monterey jack cheese, roll, and place seam-side down in a baking dish. Pour the sauce over the top, sprinkle with the remaining cheese, and bake at 375°F for 20 minutes until bubbly.

Recipe: Panzanella Bread Salad with White Bean and Mozzarella
Ingredients: Bread, Tomatoes, Cucumber, Red Onion, Basil, Olive Oil, Red Wine Vinegar, Mozzarella, White Beans
Instructions: Toast the bread cubes in the oven until crisp. Drain and rinse the white beans, then warm them through in a pan. Toss the bread with the tomatoes, cucumber, red onion and basil. Dress with the olive oil and red wine vinegar and top with mozzarella.

Recipe: Sheet-Pan BBQ Chickpea with Potatoes and Green Beans
Ingredients: Chickpeas, Potatoes, Green Beans, BBQ Sauce, Olive Oil
Instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the potatoes and green beans with half of the bbq sauce and olive oil on a sheet pan. Coat the chickpeas with the remaining seasoning and add to the pan. Roast until the protein is cooked through (165°F for poultry, 145°F for pork and fish) and the vegetables are tender and browned.

Recipe: Shrimp Taco Salad with Cheddar and Lime Crema
Ingredients: Shrimp, Romaine Lettuce, Corn, Black Beans, Cherry Tomatoes, Cheddar Cheese, Tortilla Chips, Taco Seasoning, Lime Crema
Instructions: Season the shrimp with the taco seasoning. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Toss the romaine, corn, black beans and tomatoes in a large bowl. Top with the shrimp, cheddar cheese and crushed tortilla chips and drizzle with the lime crema.

Recipe: Honey Mustard Steak Salad with Bell Pepper and Cucumber on Arugula
Ingredients: Flank Steak, Arugula, Bell Pepper, Cucumber, Honey Mustard Vinaigrette
Instructions: Season the steak and grill or sear to at least 145°F, rest for 5 minutes, then slice against the grain. Toss the arugula with the bell pepper and cucumber. Top with the steak and drizzle with the honey mustard vinaigrette.

Recipe: Shrimp Ramen Bowl with Corn
Ingredients: Shrimp, Ramen Noodles, Vegetable Broth, Miso Paste, Soy Sauce, Ginger, Garlic, Soft-Boiled Egg, Green Onions, Nori, Corn, Spinach
Instructions: Simmer the vegetable broth with the ginger and garlic, then whisk in the miso and soy sauce (do not boil after adding the miso). Cook the ramen noodles separately and drain. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Divide the noodles and broth between bowls and top with the shrimp, corn, spinach, soft-boiled egg, green onions and nori.

Recipe: Egg Salad Sub with Mozzarella and Basil
Ingredients: Eggs, Mayonnaise, Celery, Mustard, Hoagie Roll, Mozzarella, Basil
Instructions: Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool, and chop. Mix with the mayonnaise, celery and mustard. Fill the bread with the egg salad and mozzarella and basil.

Recipe: Grilled Chicken Sandwich on Gluten-Free Bread with Avocado and Cheddar
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Gluten-Free Bread, Avocado, Cheddar Cheese, Lettuce
Instructions: Season the chicken and grill or pan-sear until cooked through (165°F), then slice. Toast the bread or warm the tortilla. Spread with the avocado. Layer the grilled chicken with the cheddar cheese and lettuce.

Recipe: Smoky Tofu Wrap with Honey Mustard and Spinach and Cucumber
Ingredients: Tofu, Flour Tortillas, Dijon Mustard, Honey, Spinach, Cucumber
Instructions: Press the tofu, slice it, and pan-fry or bake until golden and firm. Toast the bread or warm the tortilla. Spread with the dijon mustard and honey. Layer the smoky tofu with the spinach and cucumber.

Recipe: Smoky Paprika Chicken Tacos with Lettuce, Cheddar and Salsa
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Corn Tortillas, Smoked Paprika, Garlic, Cumin, Olive Oil, Romaine Lettuce, Cheddar Cheese, Salsa
Instructions: Season the chicken with the smoked paprika, garlic and cumin. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the chicken and top with romaine lettuce, cheddar cheese and salsa.

Recipe: Thai Basil Shrimp Fried Rice
Ingredients: Shrimp, Jasmine Rice, Fish Sauce, Thai Basil, Garlic, Dried Chilies, Eggs, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Use day-old cold cooked jasmine rice for the best texture. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque, then set aside. Heat the oil in a large pan and stir-fry the aromatics and vegetables for 2 minutes. Add the rice and the fish sauce and stir-fry until the rice is hot and lightly toasted. Fold in the shrimp and eggs and cook until everything is heated through.

Recipe: Avocado Toast with Chili Flakes and Lemon
Ingredients: Bread, Avocado, Lemon Juice, Chili Flakes
Instructions: Toast the bread. Mash the avocado and spread on the toast. Top with lemon juice and chili flakes.

Recipe: Sweet Potato and Spinach Quesadilla with Cheddar
Ingredients: Sweet Potatoes, Flour Tortillas, Cheddar Cheese, Spinach, Onion, Salsa
Instructions: Cube the sweet potatoes and roast at 425°F until tender and caramelized (about 25 minutes). Saute the spinach and onion until soft. Fill half of each flour tortilla with the sweet potatoes, vegetables and cheddar cheese, then fold over. Cook in a dry pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until crisp and the cheese melts. Serve with salsa.

Recipe: Kung Pao-Style Tofu Stir-Fry with Snow Peas and Carrots
Ingredients: Tofu, White Rice, Snow Peas, Carrots, Soy Sauce, Peanuts, Dried Chilies, Rice Vinegar, Garlic, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides, then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the snow peas and carrots for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the tofu to the pan, add the soy sauce, peanuts, dried chilies, rice vinegar and garlic and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the white rice.

Recipe: Thai Basil Chicken Stir-Fry with Zucchini and Bell Pepper
Ingredients: Chicken Thighs, Jasmine Rice, Zucchini, Bell Pepper, Fish Sauce, Oyster Sauce, Thai Basil, Dried Chilies, Garlic, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the jasmine rice according to package directions. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the zucchini and bell pepper for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the chicken to the pan, add the fish sauce, oyster sauce, thai basil, dried chilies and garlic and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the jasmine rice.

Recipe: Spicy Basil Pork Noodles with Green Beans
Ingredients: Pork Tenderloin, Rice Noodles, Soy Sauce, Oyster Sauce, Thai Basil, Dried Chilies, Garlic, Cooking Oil, Green Beans, Onion
Instructions: Soak the rice noodles in hot water until tender and drain. Slice the pork into thin pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (145°F), then set aside. Stir-fry the garlic, chilies, green beans and onion for 2 minutes. Add the noodles, soy sauce, oyster sauce and pork and toss until hot, then fold in the Thai basil.

Recipe: Lemon Oregano Beef Brown Rice Bowl with Lemon Herb Vinaigrette
Ingredients: Beef Sirloin Strips, Brown Rice, Cucumber, Cherry Tomatoes, Lemon Juice, Oregano, Garlic, Olive Oil, Lemon Olive Oil Dressing, Parsley
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Toss the beef with the lemon juice, oregano and garlic and olive oil. Sear the beef strips in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (at least 145°F). Fill the bowls with the brown rice, cucumber and cherry tomatoes. Top with the beef and drizzle with the lemon herb vinaigrette.

Recipe: Chicken and Pea Risotto
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Peas, Arborio Rice, Onion, Garlic, Olive Oil, Chicken Broth, Parmesan
Instructions: Saute the onion and garlic in the olive oil until soft. Add the arborio rice and stir for 1 minute until lightly toasted. Add the warm chicken broth one ladleful at a time, stirring until each is absorbed (about 20 minutes). Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Stir in the peas and cook until tender. Stir in the parmesan and serve immediately.

Recipe: Banana Greek Parfait with Almond Granola and Peanut Butter
Ingredients: Greek Yogurt, Banana, Almond Granola, Peanut Butter
Instructions: Spoon the greek yogurt into a bowl. Top with the banana, granola and peanut butter.

Recipe: Salmon Burger with Guacamole and Salsa
Ingredients: Salmon Fillet, Breadcrumbs, Eggs, Guacamole, Salsa, Lettuce, Burger Bun
Instructions: Finely chop the salmon, mix with the breadcrumbs and egg, shape into patties, and pan-sear until cooked through (145°F). Toast the bun. Assemble with the guacamole, salsa and lettuce.

Recipe: Banana and Sunflower Butter Snack with Chia Seeds
Ingredients: Banana, Sunflower Seed Butter, Chia Seeds
Instructions: Slice the banana. Spread or dip with the sunflower seed butter. Sprinkle with chia seeds.

Recipe: Teriyaki Edamame Stir-Fry with Broccoli and Carrots
Ingredients: Edamame, Jasmine Rice, Broccoli, Carrots, Teriyaki Sauce, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the jasmine rice according to package directions. Boil or steam the edamame for 4 to 5 minutes until tender, then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the broccoli and carrots for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the edamame to the pan, add the teriyaki sauce, garlic and ginger and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the jasmine rice.

Recipe: Miso-Glazed Salmon Rice Bowl with Cabbage
Ingredients: Salmon Fillet, Jasmine Rice, Miso Paste, Rice Vinegar, Honey, Ginger, Green Beans, Carrots, Cabbage
Instructions: Whisk the miso, rice vinegar, honey and ginger into a glaze. Cook the jasmine rice according to package directions. Cut the salmon into chunks and gently cook in a pan until opaque and flaky (145°F), brushing with the glaze in the last few minutes. Steam the green beans and carrots until tender-crisp. Serve over the rice with cabbage.

Recipe: Poke-Style Tofu Rice Bowl with Avocado
Ingredients: Tofu, Jasmine Rice, Soy Sauce, Sesame Oil, Sesame Seeds, Rice Vinegar, Avocado, Cucumber, Edamame, Green Onions
Instructions: Cook the jasmine rice according to package directions and season with the rice vinegar. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides, then let cool slightly. Toss the tofu with the soy sauce and sesame oil. Top the rice with the tofu, avocado, cucumber, edamame, sesame seeds and avocado.

Recipe: Portobello Burger with BBQ Sauce and Red Onion on Gluten-Free Bread
Ingredients: Portobello Mushrooms, BBQ Sauce, Red Onion, Lettuce, Gluten-Free Bread
Instructions: Brush the mushroom caps with oil and grill or roast until tender. Toast the bread. Assemble with the bbq sauce, red onion and lettuce.

Recipe: Miso Soup with Tofu and Cabbage
Ingredients: Tofu, Cabbage, Miso Paste, Dashi Stock, Seaweed, Green Onions
Instructions: Heat the dashi stock until barely simmering. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Add the cabbage and cook for 2 minutes. Whisk in the miso paste off the boil and add the seaweed. Top with green onions and the tofu.

Recipe: Grilled Halloumi Sandwich with Honey Mustard and Red Onion and Pickles
Ingredients: Halloumi, Bread, Dijon Mustard, Honey, Red Onion, Pickles
Instructions: Slice the halloumi and grill or pan-fry until golden on both sides. Toast the bread or warm the tortilla. Spread with the dijon mustard and honey. Layer the grilled halloumi with the red onion and pickles.

Recipe: Italian Egg Salad with Bell Pepper and Cucumber on Mixed Greens
Ingredients: Eggs, Mixed Greens, Bell Pepper, Cucumber, Italian Vinaigrette
Instructions: Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool, and slice. Toss the mixed greens with the bell pepper and cucumber. Top with the egg and drizzle with the italian vinaigrette.

Recipe: Miso Soup with Shrimp and Bok Choy
Ingredients: Shrimp, Bok Choy, Miso Paste, Dashi Stock, Seaweed, Green Onions
Instructions: Heat the dashi stock until barely simmering. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Add the bok choy and cook for 2 minutes. Whisk in the miso paste off the boil and add the seaweed. Top with green onions and the shrimp.

Recipe: Coconut Lime Tofu Soup with Carrots
Ingredients: Tofu, Carrots, Coconut Milk, Fish Sauce, Lemongrass, Ginger, Lime Juice, Mushrooms, Cilantro, Vegetable Broth
Instructions: Simmer the vegetable broth with the lemongrass and ginger for 10 minutes. Add the coconut milk, mushrooms and carrots. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Season with the fish sauce and lime juice and finish with cilantro.

Recipe: Hibachi-Style Shrimp Fried Rice (Brown Rice)
Ingredients: Shrimp, Brown Rice, Butter, Soy Sauce, Eggs, Garlic, Onion, Carrots, Peas
Instructions: Use day-old cold cooked brown rice for the best texture. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque, then set aside. Heat the oil in a large pan and stir-fry the aromatics and vegetables for 2 minutes. Add the rice and the butter and soy sauce and stir-fry until the rice is hot and lightly toasted. Fold in the shrimp and eggs and cook until everything is heated through.

Recipe: White Chicken Chili with Smoked Paprika Spices and Sour Cream
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, White Beans, Chicken Broth, Smoked Paprika, Cumin, Chipotle Peppers in Adobo, Onion, Bell Pepper, Garlic, Sour Cream
Instructions: Saute the onion, bell pepper and garlic with the spices. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Add the remaining ingredients with a cup of water and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes. Serve topped with sour cream.

Recipe: Chipotle Turkey Tacos with Guacamole and Pico de Gallo
Ingredients: Ground Turkey, Corn Tortillas, Chipotle Peppers in Adobo, Garlic, Cumin, Lime Juice, Guacamole, Pico de Gallo
Instructions: Season the turkey with the chipotle peppers in adobo, garlic, cumin and lime juice. Brown the ground turkey in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (165°F). Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the turkey and top with guacamole and pico de gallo.

Recipe: Hibachi-Style Chicken Fried Rice (Brown Rice)
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Brown Rice, Butter, Soy Sauce, Eggs, Garlic, Onion, Carrots, Peas
Instructions: Use day-old cold cooked brown rice for the best texture. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Heat the oil in a large pan and stir-fry the aromatics and vegetables for 2 minutes. Add the rice and the butter and soy sauce and stir-fry until the rice is hot and lightly toasted. Fold in the chicken and eggs and cook until everything is heated through.

Recipe: Tomato Basil Soup
Ingredients: Crushed Tomatoes, Vegetable Broth, Onion, Garlic, Basil, Heavy Cream, Olive Oil
Instructions: Saute the onion and garlic in the olive oil. Add the crushed tomatoes and vegetable broth and simmer for 20 minutes. Blend until smooth. Stir in the heavy cream and basil.

Recipe: Avocado Lime Egg Salad with Feta Cheese and Sunflower Seeds on Arugula
Ingredients: Eggs, Arugula, Feta Cheese, Sunflower Seeds, Avocado Lime Dressing
Instructions: Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool, and slice. Toss the arugula with the feta cheese and sunflower seeds. Top with the egg and drizzle with the avocado lime dressing.

Recipe: Bolognese-Style Beef Penne
Ingredients: Ground Beef, Penne, Crushed Tomatoes, Onion, Carrots, Celery, Garlic, Olive Oil, Tomato Paste
Instructions: Cook the penne according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Brown the ground beef in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (160°F), then set aside. Simmer the crushed tomatoes, onion, carrots and celery in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and beef with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed.

Recipe: Sesame Ginger Shrimp Fried Rice
Ingredients: Shrimp, Jasmine Rice, Soy Sauce, Sesame Oil, Ginger, Eggs, Green Onions
Instructions: Use day-old cold cooked jasmine rice for the best texture. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque, then set aside. Heat the oil in a large pan and stir-fry the aromatics and vegetables for 2 minutes. Add the rice and the soy sauce and sesame oil and stir-fry until the rice is hot and lightly toasted. Fold in the shrimp and eggs and cook until everything is heated through.

Recipe: Smoky Paprika Cauliflower Tacos with Cotija and Pickled Onions
Ingredients: Cauliflower, Corn Tortillas, Smoked Paprika, Garlic, Cumin, Olive Oil, Cotija, Pickled Onions, Cilantro
Instructions: Season the cauliflower with the smoked paprika, garlic and cumin. Cut the cauliflower into florets and roast or saute until tender and lightly browned. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the cauliflower and top with cotija, pickled onions and cilantro.

Recipe: Sheet-Pan Lemon Herb Chicken with Sweet Potatoes and Brussels Sprouts
Ingredients: Chicken Thighs, Sweet Potatoes, Brussels Sprouts, Lemon Juice, Garlic, Thyme, Olive Oil
Instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the sweet potatoes and brussels sprouts with half of the lemon juice, garlic and thyme and olive oil on a sheet pan. Coat the chicken with the remaining seasoning and add to the pan. Roast until the protein is cooked through (165°F for poultry, 145°F for pork and fish) and the vegetables are tender and browned.

Recipe: Black Bean Enchiladas with Monterey and Chipotle Peppers in Adobo
Ingredients: Black Beans, Corn Tortillas, Monterey Jack Cheese, Crushed Tomatoes, Chili Powder, Cumin, Garlic, Onion, Chipotle Peppers in Adobo
Instructions: Drain and rinse the black beans, then warm them through in a pan. Simmer the crushed tomatoes with the chili powder, cumin, garlic and onion for 10 minutes to make a flour-free sauce. Fill the corn tortillas with the black beans and some of the monterey jack cheese, roll, and place seam-side down in a baking dish. Pour the sauce over the top, sprinkle with the remaining cheese, and bake at 375°F for 20 minutes until bubbly.

Recipe: Pozole-Style White Bean Stew with Cabbage
Ingredients: White Beans, Vegetable Broth, Hominy, Chili Powder, Garlic, Onion, Oregano, Lime Juice, Cabbage
Instructions: Saute the onion and garlic with the chili powder and oregano. Add the vegetable broth and hominy. Drain and rinse the white beans, then warm them through in a pan. Simmer until the flavors come together, about 30 minutes. Serve with lime juice and cabbage.

Recipe: Chipotle Cauliflower Tacos with Cotija and Pickled Onions on Flour Tortillas
Ingredients: Cauliflower, Flour Tortillas, Chipotle Peppers in Adobo, Garlic, Cumin, Lime Juice, Cotija, Pickled Onions, Cilantro
Instructions: Season the cauliflower with the chipotle peppers in adobo, garlic, cumin and lime juice. Cut the cauliflower into florets and roast or saute until tender and lightly browned. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the cauliflower and top with cotija, pickled onions and cilantro.

Recipe: Tabbouleh-Style Salad with Lamb and Parsley
Ingredients: Lamb Leg, Bulgur, Tomatoes, Cucumber, Parsley, Lemon Juice, Olive Oil, Red Onion
Instructions: Soak the bulgur in hot water until tender, then drain well. Cut the lamb into bite-sized pieces and sear in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (at least 145°F). Toss the bulgur with the chopped tomatoes, cucumber, red onion and plenty of parsley. Dress with the lemon juice and olive oil and top with the lamb.

Recipe: Caesar Tuna Salad with Strawberries and Pecans on Arugula
Ingredients: Canned Tuna, Arugula, Strawberries, Pecans, Caesar Dressing
Instructions: Flake the canned tuna. Toss the arugula with the strawberries and pecans. Top with the tuna and drizzle with the caesar dressing.

Recipe: Bolognese-Style Lentil Linguine
Ingredients: Lentils, Linguine, Crushed Tomatoes, Onion, Carrots, Celery, Garlic, Olive Oil, Tomato Paste
Instructions: Cook the linguine according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Cook the lentils until tender (or use canned lentils, drained and rinsed), then set aside. Simmer the crushed tomatoes, onion, carrots and celery in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and lentil with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed.

Recipe: Hoisin Turkey Lettuce Cups with Mushrooms
Ingredients: Ground Turkey, Butter Lettuce, Hoisin Sauce, Water Chestnuts, Green Onions, Garlic, Rice Vinegar, Mushrooms, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Brown the ground turkey in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Saute the garlic and mushrooms for 2 minutes. Return the turkey to the pan with the hoisin sauce, rice vinegar and water chestnuts and cook until glazed. Spoon into the lettuce leaves and top with green onions.

Recipe: Banana Almond Butter Oatmeal with Soy Milk
Ingredients: Rolled Oats, Soy Milk, Banana, Almond Butter, Maple Syrup
Instructions: Simmer the oats in the soy milk for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring, until creamy. Top with the banana, almond butter and maple syrup.

Recipe: Cottage Cheese Bowl with Blueberries and Pumpkin Seeds
Ingredients: Cottage Cheese, Blueberries, Pumpkin Seeds
Instructions: Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl. Top with the blueberries and pumpkin seeds.

Recipe: Mango Coconut Parfait with Seed Granola and Almond Butter
Ingredients: Coconut Milk, Mango, Seed Granola, Almond Butter
Instructions: Spoon the coconut milk into a bowl. Top with the mango, granola and almond butter.

Recipe: Ham Sub with Avocado and Bacon
Ingredients: Ham, Hoagie Roll, Avocado, Bacon, Lettuce
Instructions: Dice the ham and warm it through in the pan. Toast the bread or warm the tortilla. Spread with the avocado. Layer the ham with the bacon and lettuce.

Recipe: Sheet-Pan Rosemary Garlic Tofu with Potatoes and Green Beans
Ingredients: Tofu, Potatoes, Green Beans, Rosemary, Garlic, Olive Oil
Instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the potatoes and green beans with half of the rosemary and garlic and olive oil on a sheet pan. Coat the tofu with the remaining seasoning and add to the pan. Roast until the protein is cooked through (165°F for poultry, 145°F for pork and fish) and the vegetables are tender and browned.

Recipe: Puttanesca-Style Shrimp Fettuccine
Ingredients: Shrimp, Fettuccine, Crushed Tomatoes, Olives, Capers, Anchovy Fillets, Garlic, Chili Flakes
Instructions: Cook the fettuccine according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque, then set aside. Simmer the crushed tomatoes, olives, capers and anchovy fillets in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and shrimp with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed.

Recipe: Shrimp Fresh Spring Rolls with Basil and Carrots
Ingredients: Shrimp, Rice Paper Wrappers, Rice Noodles, Mixed Greens, Carrots, Basil, Peanut Dipping Sauce
Instructions: Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque, then slice thinly. Soak the rice paper wrappers one at a time in warm water until pliable. Layer each wrapper with the rice noodles, mixed greens, carrots, basil and the shrimp. Fold in the sides and roll tightly. Serve with the peanut dipping sauce.

Recipe: Carrot Ginger Soup with Thyme
Ingredients: Carrots, Ginger, Coconut Milk, Onion, Vegetable Broth, Thyme
Instructions: Saute the aromatics in butter or oil until soft. Add the main vegetables or proteins, then the broth or milk, and simmer until tender. Blend until smooth or leave chunky, depending on the soup. Season to taste and top with thyme.

Recipe: Chili-Lime Beef Tacos with Cotija and Pickled Onions
Ingredients: Ground Beef, Corn Tortillas, Chili Powder, Lime Juice, Garlic, Cumin, Cotija, Pickled Onions, Cilantro
Instructions: Season the beef with the chili powder, lime juice, garlic and cumin. Brown the ground beef in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (160°F). Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the beef and top with cotija, pickled onions and cilantro.

Recipe: Garlic Olive Oil Chicken Spaghetti
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Spaghetti, Olive Oil, Garlic, Chili Flakes, Parsley, Lemon Juice
Instructions: Cook the spaghetti according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Simmer the olive oil, garlic, chili flakes and parsley in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and chicken with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed.

Recipe: Butter-Style Paneer Curry over Brown Rice
Ingredients: Paneer, Brown Rice, Butter, Crushed Tomatoes, Heavy Cream, Garam Masala, Garlic, Ginger
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Cube the paneer and pan-fry until golden on all sides, then set aside. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil until soft, then stir in the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the butter, crushed tomatoes and heavy cream and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Return the paneer to the sauce and simmer until heated through, then serve over the rice.

Recipe: Cumin Coriander Beef Pita with Tzatziki
Ingredients: Beef Sirloin Strips, Pita Bread, Cucumber, Tomatoes, Cumin, Coriander, Paprika, Garlic, Olive Oil, Tzatziki
Instructions: Toss the beef with the cumin, coriander, paprika and garlic and olive oil. Season the beef and sear until browned and cooked through (at least 145°F), then slice. Warm the pita bread. Stuff the pita with the beef, cucumber and tomatoes and spoon over the tzatziki.

Recipe: Taco-Seasoned Sweet Potato Burrito Bowl with Pinto Beans and Romaine Lettuce
Ingredients: Sweet Potatoes, White Rice, Pinto Beans, Romaine Lettuce, Taco Seasoning, Tomato Paste, Olive Oil
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Season the sweet potatoes with the taco seasoning and tomato paste. Cube the sweet potatoes and roast at 425°F until tender and caramelized (about 25 minutes). Drain and rinse the pinto beans, then warm them through in a pan. Build the bowls with the rice, beans, sweet potato and romaine lettuce.

Recipe: Sunflower Dates Energy Bites with Dried Cranberries
Ingredients: Rolled Oats, Sunflower Seed Butter, Dates, Dried Cranberries
Instructions: Mix the oats, sunflower seed butter, dates and dried cranberries in a bowl. Roll into bite-sized balls and refrigerate until firm.

Recipe: Lemon Herb Breadcrumb Baked Cod with Broccoli
Ingredients: Cod Fillet, Broccoli, Breadcrumbs, Lemon Juice, Parsley, Olive Oil
Instructions: Heat the oven to 400°F. Brush the cod with the mustard or oil and press the crust mixture on top. Bake until opaque and flaky (145°F) and serve with broccoli.

Recipe: Caesar Tuna Salad with Apple and Walnuts on Mixed Greens
Ingredients: Canned Tuna, Mixed Greens, Apple, Walnuts, Caesar Dressing
Instructions: Flake the canned tuna. Toss the mixed greens with the apple and walnuts. Top with the tuna and drizzle with the caesar dressing.

Recipe: Egg Drop Soup with Shrimp and Mushrooms
Ingredients: Shrimp, Mushrooms, Eggs, Cornstarch, Green Onions, Ginger, Soy Sauce, Vegetable Broth
Instructions: Bring the vegetable broth to a simmer with the ginger and soy sauce. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Add the mushrooms and thicken lightly with cornstarch mixed with water. Drizzle in the beaten eggs while stirring to make ribbons and top with green onions.

Recipe: Hoisin Tofu Lettuce Cups with Carrots
Ingredients: Tofu, Butter Lettuce, Hoisin Sauce, Water Chestnuts, Green Onions, Garlic, Rice Vinegar, Carrots, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides, then set aside. Saute the garlic and carrots for 2 minutes. Return the tofu to the pan with the hoisin sauce, rice vinegar and water chestnuts and cook until glazed. Spoon into the lettuce leaves and top with green onions.

Recipe: Pesto Chicken Rigatoni
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Rigatoni, Pesto, Cherry Tomatoes, Olive Oil
Instructions: Cook the rigatoni according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Simmer the pesto, cherry tomatoes and olive oil in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and chicken with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed.

Recipe: Salsa Verde Steak Burrito Bowl with Pinto Beans and Salsa
Ingredients: Flank Steak, White Rice, Pinto Beans, Salsa, Salsa Verde, Cilantro, Lime Juice
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Season the steak with the salsa verde, cilantro and lime juice. Slice the steak thinly against the grain and sear in a hot pan until browned (at least 145°F). Drain and rinse the pinto beans, then warm them through in a pan. Build the bowls with the rice, beans, steak and salsa.

Recipe: Carbonara-Style Peas Spaghetti
Ingredients: Bacon, Spaghetti, Eggs, Parmesan, Black Pepper, Peas
Instructions: Cook the spaghetti according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Cook the bacon until crisp. Saute the peas in the bacon fat until tender. Whisk the eggs with the parmesan and black pepper. Toss the hot pasta with the bacon and vegetables off the heat, then stir in the egg mixture with a splash of pasta water. Warm gently over low heat, stirring constantly, until the sauce thickens and reaches 160°F (do not let it scramble).

Recipe: Beef Enchiladas with Monterey and Lime Juice
Ingredients: Ground Beef, Corn Tortillas, Monterey Jack Cheese, Crushed Tomatoes, Chili Powder, Cumin, Garlic, Onion, Lime Juice
Instructions: Brown the ground beef in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (160°F). Simmer the crushed tomatoes with the chili powder, cumin, garlic and onion for 10 minutes to make a flour-free sauce. Fill the corn tortillas with the beef and some of the monterey jack cheese, roll, and place seam-side down in a baking dish. Pour the sauce over the top, sprinkle with the remaining cheese, and bake at 375°F for 20 minutes until bubbly.

Recipe: Spicy Gochujang Shrimp Stir-Fry with Snow Peas and Carrots
Ingredients: Shrimp, Jasmine Rice, Snow Peas, Carrots, Gochujang, Soy Sauce, Garlic, Sesame Oil, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the jasmine rice according to package directions. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque, then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the snow peas and carrots for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the shrimp to the pan, add the gochujang, soy sauce, garlic and sesame oil and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the jasmine rice.

Recipe: Banh Mi-Style Beef Sandwich with Cilantro
Ingredients: Beef Sirloin Strips, Hoagie Roll, Mayonnaise, Soy Sauce, Garlic, Carrots, Cucumber, Cilantro, Rice Vinegar
Instructions: Marinate the beef in soy sauce and garlic for at least 15 minutes. Sear the beef strips in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (at least 145°F). Toast the hoagie roll and spread with the mayonnaise. Fill with the beef, quick-pickled carrots, cucumber and cilantro.

Recipe: Greek Salad with Halloumi and Feta
Ingredients: Halloumi, Cucumber, Tomatoes, Red Onion, Olives, Olive Oil, Oregano, Red Wine Vinegar, Romaine Lettuce, Feta Cheese
Instructions: Slice the halloumi and grill or pan-fry until golden on both sides. Chop the cucumber, tomatoes and red onion and toss with the romaine and olives. Whisk the olive oil, oregano and red wine vinegar and dress the salad. Top with the halloumi and crumbled feta.

Recipe: Smoky Tofu Sub with Hummus and Swiss-Style Gruyere
Ingredients: Tofu, Hoagie Roll, Hummus, Gruyere, Tomatoes
Instructions: Press the tofu, slice it, and pan-fry or bake until golden and firm. Toast the bread or warm the tortilla. Spread with the hummus. Layer the smoky tofu with the gruyere and tomatoes.

Recipe: Coconut Tofu Curry over Basmati Rice
Ingredients: Tofu, Basmati Rice, Coconut Milk, Curry Powder, Ginger, Garlic, Lime Juice, Onion, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the basmati rice according to package directions. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides, then set aside. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil until soft, then stir in the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the coconut milk and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Return the tofu to the sauce and simmer until heated through, then serve over the rice.

Recipe: Smoky Paprika Halloumi Couscous Bowl with Hummus
Ingredients: Halloumi, Couscous, Cucumber, Red Onion, Smoked Paprika, Garlic, Lemon Juice, Olive Oil, Hummus
Instructions: Cook the couscous according to package directions. Toss the halloumi with the smoked paprika, garlic and lemon juice and olive oil. Slice the halloumi and pan-fry until golden on both sides. Fill the bowls with the couscous, cucumber and red onion. Top with the halloumi and drizzle with the hummus.

Recipe: Chana Masala with Lime Juice over Basmati Rice
Ingredients: Chickpeas, Crushed Tomatoes, Onion, Garlic, Ginger, Garam Masala, Cumin, Cilantro, Basmati Rice, Lime Juice
Instructions: Cook the basmati rice according to package directions. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger, then add the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the main ingredients, the lime juice and a splash of water and simmer until tender and saucy. Serve over the basmati rice with cilantro.

Recipe: Steak Sandwich with Pesto and Bacon
Ingredients: Beef Sirloin Strips, Bread, Pesto, Bacon, Lettuce
Instructions: Season the beef and sear until browned and cooked through (at least 145°F), then slice. Toast the bread or warm the tortilla. Spread with the pesto. Layer the steak with the bacon and lettuce.

Recipe: Cumin Coriander Chicken White Rice Bowl with Tahini Lemon Sauce
Ingredients: Chicken Thighs, White Rice, Cucumber, Red Onion, Cumin, Coriander, Paprika, Garlic, Olive Oil, Tahini, Lemon Juice
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Toss the chicken with the cumin, coriander, paprika and garlic and olive oil. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Fill the bowls with the white rice, cucumber and red onion. Top with the chicken and drizzle with the tahini lemon sauce.

Recipe: Marinara White Bean Linguine
Ingredients: White Beans, Linguine, Marinara Sauce, Garlic, Basil, Olive Oil, Parmesan
Instructions: Cook the linguine according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Drain and rinse the white beans, then warm them through in a pan, then set aside. Simmer the marinara sauce, garlic, basil and olive oil in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and white bean with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed, and finish with parmesan.

Recipe: Baked Chicken Rigatoni with Ricotta
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Rigatoni, Marinara Sauce, Garlic, Basil, Ricotta, Parmesan, Mozzarella
Instructions: Cook the rigatoni until just shy of tender and drain. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Stir the marinara sauce, garlic and basil into the pan. Combine with the pasta and half the ricotta and transfer to a baking dish. Top with the remaining ricotta and the parmesan and bake at 375°F for 20 to 25 minutes until bubbling.

Recipe: Bolognese-Style Portobello Rigatoni
Ingredients: Portobello Mushrooms, Rigatoni, Crushed Tomatoes, Onion, Carrots, Celery, Garlic, Olive Oil, Tomato Paste
Instructions: Cook the rigatoni according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Slice the mushrooms and saute until browned and tender, then set aside. Simmer the crushed tomatoes, onion, carrots and celery in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and portobello with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed.

Recipe: Pineapple Cashew Chicken Fried Rice
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Jasmine Rice, Pineapple, Cashews, Curry Powder, Soy Sauce, Eggs, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Use day-old cold cooked jasmine rice for the best texture. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Heat the oil in a large pan and stir-fry the aromatics and vegetables for 2 minutes. Add the rice and the curry powder and soy sauce and stir-fry until the rice is hot and lightly toasted. Fold in the chicken and eggs and cook until everything is heated through.

Recipe: Smoky Paprika Cauliflower Tacos with Pico de Gallo and Avocado
Ingredients: Cauliflower, Corn Tortillas, Smoked Paprika, Garlic, Cumin, Olive Oil, Pico de Gallo, Avocado, Cilantro
Instructions: Season the cauliflower with the smoked paprika, garlic and cumin. Cut the cauliflower into florets and roast or saute until tender and lightly browned. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the cauliflower and top with pico de gallo, avocado and cilantro.

Recipe: Thai Coconut-Lime Tofu Rice Bowl with Pickled Onions
Ingredients: Tofu, Brown Rice, Coconut Milk, Fish Sauce, Lime Juice, Cilantro, Bell Pepper, Peanuts, Pickled Onions
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Add the coconut milk, fish sauce and lime juice and simmer for 5 minutes. Stir in the bell pepper and cook until just tender. Serve over the rice topped with the peanuts, cilantro and pickled onions.

Recipe: Chipotle Chicken Burrito Bowl with Black Beans and Cheddar Cheese
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Brown Rice, Black Beans, Cheddar Cheese, Chipotle Peppers in Adobo, Garlic, Lime Juice, Olive Oil
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Season the chicken with the chipotle peppers in adobo, garlic and lime juice. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Drain and rinse the black beans, then warm them through in a pan. Build the bowls with the rice, beans, chicken and cheddar cheese.

Recipe: Black Bean Tortilla Soup with Cotija
Ingredients: Black Beans, Vegetable Broth, Corn Tortillas, Diced Tomatoes, Onion, Garlic, Cumin, Chili Powder, Lime Juice, Cilantro, Cotija
Instructions: Bake or toast the corn tortilla strips until crisp. Saute the onion and garlic, then add the cumin, chili powder and diced tomatoes. Add the vegetable broth and simmer for 15 minutes. Drain and rinse the black beans, then warm them through in a pan. Ladle into bowls and top with the tortilla strips, cotija, cilantro and lime juice.

Recipe: Garlic-Cumin Steak Tacos with Salsa Verde and Red Onion
Ingredients: Flank Steak, Corn Tortillas, Garlic, Cumin, Oregano, Lime Juice, Salsa Verde, Red Onion, Cilantro
Instructions: Season the steak with the garlic, cumin, oregano and lime juice. Slice the steak thinly against the grain and sear in a hot pan until browned (at least 145°F). Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the steak and top with salsa verde, red onion and cilantro.

Recipe: Steak and Bell Pepper Quesadilla with Monterey
Ingredients: Flank Steak, Flour Tortillas, Monterey Jack Cheese, Bell Pepper, Onion, Salsa
Instructions: Slice the steak thinly against the grain and sear in a hot pan until browned (at least 145°F). Saute the bell pepper and onion until soft. Fill half of each flour tortilla with the steak, vegetables and monterey jack cheese, then fold over. Cook in a dry pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until crisp and the cheese melts. Serve with salsa.

Recipe: Baked Spinach Penne with Ricotta
Ingredients: Spinach, Penne, Marinara Sauce, Garlic, Basil, Ricotta, Parmesan, Mozzarella
Instructions: Cook the penne until just shy of tender and drain. Saute the spinach until tender. Stir the marinara sauce, garlic and basil into the pan. Combine with the pasta and half the ricotta and transfer to a baking dish. Top with the remaining ricotta and the parmesan and bake at 375°F for 20 to 25 minutes until bubbling.

Recipe: Cumin Coriander Beef White Rice Bowl with Tahini Lemon Sauce
Ingredients: Beef Sirloin Strips, White Rice, Red Onion, Olives, Cumin, Coriander, Paprika, Garlic, Olive Oil, Tahini, Lemon Juice
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Toss the beef with the cumin, coriander, paprika and garlic and olive oil. Sear the beef strips in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (at least 145°F). Fill the bowls with the white rice, red onion and olives. Top with the beef and drizzle with the tahini lemon sauce.

Recipe: Puttanesca-Style White Bean over Brown Rice Pasta
Ingredients: White Beans, Brown Rice Pasta, Crushed Tomatoes, Olives, Capers, Anchovy Fillets, Garlic, Chili Flakes
Instructions: Cook the brown rice pasta according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Drain and rinse the white beans, then warm them through in a pan, then set aside. Simmer the crushed tomatoes, olives, capers and anchovy fillets in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and white bean with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed.

Recipe: Honey Mustard Bacon Salad with Bell Pepper and Cucumber on Kale
Ingredients: Bacon, Kale, Bell Pepper, Cucumber, Honey Mustard Vinaigrette
Instructions: Cook the bacon until crisp and crumble it. Toss the kale with the bell pepper and cucumber. Top with the bacon and drizzle with the honey mustard vinaigrette.

Recipe: Al Pastor-Style Chicken Tacos with Salsa Verde and Red Onion on Flour Tortillas
Ingredients: Chicken Thighs, Flour Tortillas, Pineapple, Chili Powder, Cumin, Garlic, Oregano, Salsa Verde, Red Onion, Cilantro
Instructions: Season the chicken with the pineapple, chili powder, cumin, garlic and oregano. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the chicken and top with salsa verde, red onion and cilantro.

Recipe: Sheet-Pan BBQ Salmon with Cauliflower and Red Onion
Ingredients: Salmon Fillet, Cauliflower, Red Onion, BBQ Sauce, Olive Oil
Instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the cauliflower and red onion with half of the bbq sauce and olive oil on a sheet pan. Coat the salmon with the remaining seasoning and add to the pan. Roast until the protein is cooked through (165°F for poultry, 145°F for pork and fish) and the vegetables are tender and browned.

Recipe: Sheet-Pan Lemon Herb Tofu with Zucchini and Bell Pepper
Ingredients: Tofu, Zucchini, Bell Pepper, Lemon Juice, Garlic, Thyme, Olive Oil
Instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the zucchini and bell pepper with half of the lemon juice, garlic and thyme and olive oil on a sheet pan. Coat the tofu with the remaining seasoning and add to the pan. Roast until the protein is cooked through (165°F for poultry, 145°F for pork and fish) and the vegetables are tender and browned.

Recipe: Steak Sandwich with Honey Mustard and Lettuce and Tomato
Ingredients: Beef Sirloin Strips, Bread, Dijon Mustard, Honey, Lettuce, Tomatoes
Instructions: Season the beef and sear until browned and cooked through (at least 145°F), then slice. Toast the bread or warm the tortilla. Spread with the dijon mustard and honey. Layer the steak with the lettuce and tomatoes.

Recipe: Creamy Mushroom Soup with Green Onions
Ingredients: Mushrooms, Heavy Cream, Flour, Butter, Onion, Thyme, Vegetable Broth, Green Onions
Instructions: Saute the aromatics in butter or oil until soft. Add the main vegetables or proteins, then the broth or milk, and simmer until tender. Blend until smooth or leave chunky, depending on the soup. Season to taste and top with green onions.

Recipe: Shrimp Yakisoba-Style Noodles with Cabbage and Carrots
Ingredients: Shrimp, Ramen Noodles, Soy Sauce, Ketchup, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking Oil, Cabbage, Carrots
Instructions: Cook the noodles according to package directions and drain. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque, then set aside. Stir-fry the cabbage and carrots until tender-crisp. Add the noodles, shrimp, soy sauce and ketchup and toss until glazed and hot.

Recipe: Carbonara-Style Mushrooms Fettuccine
Ingredients: Bacon, Fettuccine, Eggs, Parmesan, Black Pepper, Mushrooms
Instructions: Cook the fettuccine according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Cook the bacon until crisp. Saute the mushrooms in the bacon fat until tender. Whisk the eggs with the parmesan and black pepper. Toss the hot pasta with the bacon and vegetables off the heat, then stir in the egg mixture with a splash of pasta water. Warm gently over low heat, stirring constantly, until the sauce thickens and reaches 160°F (do not let it scramble).

Recipe: Tikka Masala-Style Shrimp Curry over Brown Rice
Ingredients: Shrimp, Brown Rice, Crushed Tomatoes, Heavy Cream, Greek Yogurt, Garam Masala, Garlic, Ginger, Onion, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque, then set aside. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil until soft, then stir in the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the crushed tomatoes, heavy cream and greek yogurt and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Return the shrimp to the sauce and simmer until heated through, then serve over the rice.

Recipe: Aloo Gobi with Spinach over Quinoa
Ingredients: Potatoes, Cauliflower, Onion, Garlic, Ginger, Turmeric, Cumin, Cooking Oil, Quinoa, Spinach
Instructions: Cook the quinoa according to package directions. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger, then add the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the main ingredients, the spinach and a splash of water and simmer until tender and saucy. Serve over the quinoa with cilantro.

Recipe: Sizzling Tofu Fajitas with Guacamole (Corn Tortillas)
Ingredients: Tofu, Corn Tortillas, Bell Pepper, Onion, Chili Powder, Cumin, Garlic, Lime Juice, Guacamole, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Toss the tofu with the chili powder, cumin, garlic and lime juice. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Cook the bell pepper and onion in a very hot pan until charred at the edges. Serve the tofu and vegetables with the warm tortillas and guacamole.

Recipe: Chickpea Tortilla Soup with Avocado
Ingredients: Chickpeas, Vegetable Broth, Corn Tortillas, Diced Tomatoes, Onion, Garlic, Cumin, Chili Powder, Lime Juice, Cilantro, Avocado
Instructions: Bake or toast the corn tortilla strips until crisp. Saute the onion and garlic, then add the cumin, chili powder and diced tomatoes. Add the vegetable broth and simmer for 15 minutes. Drain and rinse the chickpeas, then warm them through (or crisp them in a hot pan). Ladle into bowls and top with the tortilla strips, avocado, cilantro and lime juice.

Recipe: Garlic Shrimp Fried Rice (Brown Rice)
Ingredients: Shrimp, Brown Rice, Eggs, Soy Sauce, Garlic, Green Onions, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Use day-old cold cooked brown rice for the best texture. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque, then set aside. Heat the oil in a large pan and stir-fry the aromatics and vegetables for 2 minutes. Add the rice and the soy sauce and stir-fry until the rice is hot and lightly toasted. Fold in the shrimp and eggs and cook until everything is heated through.

Recipe: Thai Coconut-Lime Chicken Rice Bowl with Edamame
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, White Rice, Coconut Milk, Fish Sauce, Lime Juice, Cilantro, Bell Pepper, Peanuts, Edamame

Recipe: Hearty Beef Stew with Mushrooms
Ingredients: Beef Sirloin Strips, Mushrooms, Beef Broth, Potatoes, Carrots, Onion, Tomato Paste, Thyme, Bay Leaf, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Brown the beef in the oil in a large pot. Add the onion, carrots and potatoes and cook for 3 minutes. Add the tomato paste, thyme, bay leaf and beef broth and simmer until the beef is tender (about 1 hour for meat, 25 minutes for lentils). Add the mushrooms for the last 10 minutes.

Recipe: Dal Tadka with Spinach over Brown Rice
Ingredients: Lentils, Onion, Garlic, Ginger, Turmeric, Cumin, Cooking Oil, Cilantro, Brown Rice, Spinach
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger, then add the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the main ingredients, the spinach and a splash of water and simmer until tender and saucy. Serve over the brown rice with cilantro.

Recipe: Strawberries Coconut Parfait with Almond Granola and Peanut Butter
Ingredients: Coconut Milk, Strawberries, Almond Granola, Peanut Butter
Instructions: Spoon the coconut milk into a bowl. Top with the strawberries, granola and peanut butter.

Recipe: Miso Soup with Shrimp and Mushrooms
Ingredients: Shrimp, Mushrooms, Miso Paste, Dashi Stock, Seaweed, Green Onions
Instructions: Heat the dashi stock until barely simmering. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Add the mushrooms and cook for 2 minutes. Whisk in the miso paste off the boil and add the seaweed. Top with green onions and the shrimp.

Recipe: Avocado and Tomatoes Omelet with Feta
Ingredients: Eggs, Avocado, Tomatoes, Olive Oil, Feta Cheese
Instructions: Saute the avocado and tomatoes in the oil until tender. Whisk the eggs and pour into the pan. Cook gently, stirring (scramble) or folding (omelet), until the eggs are fully set, adding the feta cheese at the end.

Recipe: Thai Coconut-Lime Shrimp Rice Bowl with Cabbage
Ingredients: Shrimp, White Rice, Coconut Milk, Fish Sauce, Lime Juice, Cilantro, Bell Pepper, Peanuts, Cabbage
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Add the coconut milk, fish sauce and lime juice and simmer for 5 minutes. Stir in the bell pepper and cook until just tender. Serve over the rice topped with the peanuts, cilantro and cabbage.

Recipe: Pork Ramen Bowl with Corn
Ingredients: Pork Tenderloin, Ramen Noodles, Vegetable Broth, Miso Paste, Soy Sauce, Ginger, Garlic, Soft-Boiled Egg, Green Onions, Nori, Corn, Spinach
Instructions: Simmer the vegetable broth with the ginger and garlic, then whisk in the miso and soy sauce (do not boil after adding the miso). Cook the ramen noodles separately and drain. Slice the pork into thin pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (145°F). Divide the noodles and broth between bowls and top with the pork, corn, spinach, soft-boiled egg, green onions and nori.

Recipe: Puttanesca-Style Shrimp Linguine
Ingredients: Shrimp, Linguine, Crushed Tomatoes, Olives, Capers, Anchovy Fillets, Garlic, Chili Flakes
Instructions: Cook the linguine according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque, then set aside. Simmer the crushed tomatoes, olives, capers and anchovy fillets in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and shrimp with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed.

Recipe: Poke-Style Shrimp Rice Bowl with Cabbage
Ingredients: Shrimp, Brown Rice, Soy Sauce, Sesame Oil, Sesame Seeds, Rice Vinegar, Avocado, Cucumber, Edamame, Green Onions, Cabbage
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions and season with the rice vinegar. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque, then let cool slightly. Toss the shrimp with the soy sauce and sesame oil. Top the rice with the shrimp, avocado, cucumber, edamame, sesame seeds and cabbage.

Recipe: Blueberries Walnuts Overnight Oats with Coconut Milk
Ingredients: Rolled Oats, Coconut Milk, Blueberries, Walnuts, Maple Syrup
Instructions: Stir the oats with the coconut milk in a jar and refrigerate overnight. Top with the blueberries, walnuts and maple syrup.

Recipe: Baked Beef Rigatoni with Ricotta

Stir the marinara sauce, garlic and basil into the pan. Combine with the pasta and half the ricotta and transfer to a baking dish. Top with the remaining ricotta and the parmesan and bake at 375°F for 20 to 25 minutes until bubbling.

Recipe: Sweet Chili Shrimp Stir-Fry with Zucchini and Bell Pepper
Ingredients: Shrimp, Jasmine Rice, Zucchini, Bell Pepper, Sweet Chili Sauce, Lime Juice, Garlic, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the jasmine rice according to package directions. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque, then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the zucchini and bell pepper for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the shrimp to the pan, add the sweet chili sauce, lime juice and garlic and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the jasmine rice.

Recipe: Garlic Herb Lamb Gyro with Roasted Red Pepper Sauce
Ingredients: Ground Lamb, Pita Bread, Cucumber, Lettuce, Garlic, Parsley, Thyme, Olive Oil, Roasted Red Peppers
Instructions: Toss the lamb with the garlic, parsley and thyme and olive oil. Mix the ground lamb with the spices, shape into patties or a loaf, and cook until browned and cooked through (160°F), then slice. Warm the pita bread. Stuff the pita with the lamb, cucumber and lettuce and spoon over the roasted red pepper sauce.

Recipe: Cauliflower Biryani-Style Rice with Cashews
Ingredients: Cauliflower, Basmati Rice, Greek Yogurt, Onion, Garam Masala, Turmeric, Garlic, Ginger, Cilantro, Cashews, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Marinate the cauliflower in the yogurt and half the spices for at least 30 minutes. Cook the onion in the oil until deep golden. Cut the cauliflower into florets and roast or saute until tender and lightly browned. Layer with the partly cooked basmati rice and the cashews, cover tightly, and steam on low heat for 15 to 20 minutes. Fluff and top with cilantro.

Recipe: Cottage Cheese Bowl with Mango and Pumpkin Seeds
Ingredients: Cottage Cheese, Mango, Pumpkin Seeds
Instructions: Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl. Top with the mango and pumpkin seeds.

Recipe: Chili-Lime Shrimp Tacos with Cabbage Slaw and Lime Crema
Ingredients: Shrimp, Corn Tortillas, Chili Powder, Lime Juice, Garlic, Cumin, Coleslaw Mix, Lime Crema, Cilantro
Instructions: Season the shrimp with the chili powder, lime juice, garlic and cumin. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the shrimp and top with coleslaw mix, lime crema, cilantro and lime juice.

Recipe: Sheet-Pan Lemon Herb Pork with Broccoli and Carrots
Ingredients: Pork Tenderloin, Broccoli, Carrots, Lemon Juice, Garlic, Thyme, Olive Oil
Instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the broccoli and carrots with half of the lemon juice, garlic and thyme and olive oil on a sheet pan. Coat the pork with the remaining seasoning and add to the pan. Roast until the protein is cooked through (165°F for poultry, 145°F for pork and fish) and the vegetables are tender and browned.

Recipe: Garlic Herb Tofu Pita with Lemon Herb Vinaigrette
Ingredients: Tofu, Pita Bread, Tomatoes, Red Onion, Garlic, Parsley, Thyme, Olive Oil, Lemon Olive Oil Dressing
Instructions: Toss the tofu with the garlic, parsley and thyme and olive oil. Press the tofu, slice it, and pan-fry or bake until golden and firm. Warm the pita bread. Stuff the pita with the tofu, tomatoes and red onion and spoon over the lemon herb vinaigrette.

Recipe: Banana Greek Parfait with Almond Granola and Almond Butter
Ingredients: Greek Yogurt, Banana, Almond Granola, Almond Butter
Instructions: Spoon the greek yogurt into a bowl. Top with the banana, granola and almond butter.

Recipe: Shrimp Udon Stir-Fry with Bell Pepper and Bok Choy
Ingredients: Shrimp, Udon Noodles, Soy Sauce, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking Oil, Bell Pepper, Bok Choy
Instructions: Cook the udon noodles according to package directions and drain. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque, then set aside. Stir-fry the bell pepper and bok choy with the garlic and ginger until tender-crisp. Add the noodles, soy sauce and shrimp and toss until heated through.

Recipe: Taco-Seasoned Pork Burrito Bowl with Pinto Beans and Guacamole
Ingredients: Pork Shoulder, White Rice, Pinto Beans, Guacamole, Taco Seasoning, Tomato Paste, Olive Oil
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Season the pork with the taco seasoning and tomato paste. Braise or slow-cook the pork until very tender (at least 145°F, ideally much longer for shredding), then shred it. Drain and rinse the pinto beans, then warm them through in a pan. Build the bowls with the rice, beans, pork and guacamole.

Recipe: Lemongrass Coconut Pork Stir-Fry with Green Beans and Red Onion
Ingredients: Pork Tenderloin, Brown Rice, Green Beans, Red Onion, Coconut Milk, Fish Sauce, Lemongrass, Lime Juice, Garlic, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Slice the pork into thin pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (145°F), then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the green beans and red onion for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the pork to the pan, add the coconut milk, fish sauce, lemongrass, lime juice and garlic and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the brown rice.

Recipe: Ginger Rice Soup with Chicken and Bok Choy
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Bok Choy, White Rice, Ginger, Soy Sauce, Green Onions, Chicken Broth
Instructions: Simmer the rice in the chicken broth with the ginger until very soft and thick. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Stir in the bok choy and cook until tender. Season with soy sauce and top with green onions.

Recipe: Classic Chicken Fried Rice
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Jasmine Rice, Eggs, Soy Sauce, Green Onions, Peas, Carrots, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Use day-old cold cooked jasmine rice for the best texture. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Heat the oil in a large pan and stir-fry the aromatics and vegetables for 2 minutes. Add the rice and the soy sauce and stir-fry until the rice is hot and lightly toasted. Fold in the chicken and eggs and cook until everything is heated through.

Recipe: Garlic Shrimp Polenta Bowl (Dairy-Free)
Ingredients: Polenta, Vegetable Broth, Shrimp, Garlic, Cherry Tomatoes, Olive Oil
Instructions: Whisk the polenta into the simmering vegetable broth and cook, stirring often, until thick and creamy (about 20 minutes). Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Cook the remaining toppings in a pan until tender and combined. Spoon the polenta into bowls and top with the garlic shrimp.

Recipe: Balsamic Salmon Salad with Cherry Tomatoes and Cucumber on Spinach
Ingredients: Salmon Fillet, Spinach, Cherry Tomatoes, Cucumber, Balsamic Vinaigrette
Instructions: Season the salmon and bake or pan-sear until opaque and flaky (145°F). Toss the spinach with the cherry tomatoes and cucumber. Top with the salmon and drizzle with the balsamic vinaigrette.

Recipe: Paneer Biryani-Style Rice with Carrots
Ingredients: Paneer, Basmati Rice, Greek Yogurt, Onion, Garam Masala, Turmeric, Garlic, Ginger, Cilantro, Carrots, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Marinate the paneer in the yogurt and half the spices for at least 30 minutes. Cook the onion in the oil until deep golden. Cube the paneer and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Layer with the partly cooked basmati rice and the carrots, cover tightly, and steam on low heat for 15 to 20 minutes. Fluff and top with cilantro.

Recipe: Thai Basil Tofu Fried Rice
Ingredients: Tofu, Jasmine Rice, Fish Sauce, Thai Basil, Garlic, Dried Chilies, Eggs, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Use day-old cold cooked jasmine rice for the best texture. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides, then set aside. Heat the oil in a large pan and stir-fry the aromatics and vegetables for 2 minutes. Add the rice and the fish sauce and stir-fry until the rice is hot and lightly toasted. Fold in the tofu and eggs and cook until everything is heated through.

Recipe: Black Pepper Steak Stir-Fry with Green Beans and Red Onion
Ingredients: Flank Steak, Brown Rice, Green Beans, Red Onion, Soy Sauce, Black Pepper, Garlic, Butter, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Slice the steak thinly against the grain and sear in a hot pan until browned (at least 145°F), then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the green beans and red onion for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the steak to the pan, add the soy sauce, black pepper, garlic and butter and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the brown rice.

Recipe: Carbonara-Style Spinach over Brown Rice Pasta
Ingredients: Bacon, Brown Rice Pasta, Eggs, Parmesan, Black Pepper, Spinach
Instructions: Cook the brown rice pasta according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Cook the bacon until crisp. Saute the spinach in the bacon fat until tender. Whisk the eggs with the parmesan and black pepper. Toss the hot pasta with the bacon and vegetables off the heat, then stir in the egg mixture with a splash of pasta water. Warm gently over low heat, stirring constantly, until the sauce thickens and reaches 160°F (do not let it scramble).

Recipe: Clam Chowder with Pumpkin Seeds
Ingredients: Clams, Bacon, Potatoes, Heavy Cream, Flour, Onion, Celery, Pumpkin Seeds
Instructions: Saute the aromatics in butter or oil until soft. Add the main vegetables or proteins, then the broth or milk, and simmer until tender. Blend until smooth or leave chunky, depending on the soup. Season to taste and top with pumpkin seeds.

Recipe: Hummus Rice Crackers Bites with Strawberries
Ingredients: Rice Crackers, Hummus, Strawberries
Instructions: Spread the hummus on the rice crackers. Top with sliced strawberries.

Recipe: Sweet Potato Enchiladas with Cheddar and Chipotle Peppers in Adobo
Ingredients: Sweet Potatoes, Corn Tortillas, Cheddar Cheese, Crushed Tomatoes, Chili Powder, Cumin, Garlic, Onion, Chipotle Peppers in Adobo
Instructions: Cube the sweet potatoes and roast at 425°F until tender and caramelized (about 25 minutes). Simmer the crushed tomatoes with the chili powder, cumin, garlic and onion for 10 minutes to make a flour-free sauce. Fill the corn tortillas with the sweet potatoes and some of the cheddar cheese, roll, and place seam-side down in a baking dish. Pour the sauce over the top, sprinkle with the remaining cheese, and bake at 375°F for 20 minutes until bubbly.

Recipe: Italian Egg Salad with Avocado and Red Onion on Kale
Ingredients: Eggs, Kale, Avocado, Red Onion, Italian Vinaigrette
Instructions: Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool, and slice. Toss the kale with the avocado and red onion. Top with the egg and drizzle with the italian vinaigrette.

Recipe: Singapore-Style Tofu Noodles with Cabbage
Ingredients: Tofu, Rice Noodles, Curry Powder, Soy Sauce, Eggs, Garlic, Cooking Oil, Cabbage, Bean Sprouts
Instructions: Soak the rice noodles until tender and drain. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides, then set aside. Scramble the eggs and set aside. Stir-fry the cabbage, bean sprouts and garlic, add the curry powder and soy sauce, then toss in the noodles, tofu and eggs until hot.

Recipe: Garlic Ginger Chicken Stir-Fry with Snow Peas and Carrots
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Jasmine Rice, Snow Peas, Carrots, Soy Sauce, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the jasmine rice according to package directions. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the snow peas and carrots for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the chicken to the pan, add the soy sauce, garlic and ginger and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the jasmine rice.

Recipe: Thai Basil Edamame Stir-Fry with Asparagus and Mushrooms
Ingredients: Edamame, White Rice, Asparagus, Mushrooms, Fish Sauce, Oyster Sauce, Thai Basil, Dried Chilies, Garlic, Cooking Oil

Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the asparagus and mushrooms for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the edamame to the pan, add the fish sauce, oyster sauce, thai basil, dried chilies and garlic and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the white rice.

Recipe: Panzanella Bread Salad with Chicken and Mozzarella
Ingredients: Bread, Tomatoes, Cucumber, Red Onion, Basil, Olive Oil, Red Wine Vinegar, Mozzarella, Chicken Breast
Instructions: Toast the bread cubes in the oven until crisp. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Toss the bread with the tomatoes, cucumber, red onion and basil. Dress with the olive oil and red wine vinegar and top with mozzarella.

Recipe: Tikka Masala-Style Shrimp Curry over Basmati Rice
Ingredients: Shrimp, Basmati Rice, Crushed Tomatoes, Heavy Cream, Greek Yogurt, Garam Masala, Garlic, Ginger, Onion, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the basmati rice according to package directions. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque, then set aside. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil until soft, then stir in the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the crushed tomatoes, heavy cream and greek yogurt and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Return the shrimp to the sauce and simmer until heated through, then serve over the rice.

Recipe: Chicken Pho-Style Noodle Soup
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Rice Noodles, Chicken Broth, Fish Sauce, Ginger, Cinnamon, Bean Sprouts, Basil, Lime Juice, Green Onions
Instructions: Simmer the chicken broth with the ginger, cinnamon and fish sauce for 15 minutes. Soak the rice noodles in hot water until tender and drain. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Divide the noodles between bowls, add the chicken, ladle over the hot broth, and top with the bean sprouts, basil, lime and green onions.

Recipe: Hoisin Pork Lettuce Cups with Green Onions
Ingredients: Ground Pork, Butter Lettuce, Hoisin Sauce, Water Chestnuts, Green Onions, Garlic, Rice Vinegar, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Brown the ground pork in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (160°F), then set aside. Saute the garlic and green onions for 2 minutes. Return the pork to the pan with the hoisin sauce, rice vinegar and water chestnuts and cook until glazed. Spoon into the lettuce leaves and top with green onions.

Recipe: Primavera Spinach Penne
Ingredients: Penne, Olive Oil, Garlic, Zucchini, Spinach, Parmesan, Lemon Juice
Instructions: Cook the penne according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Saute the garlic and zucchini in the olive oil for 3 minutes. Add the spinach and cook until just tender. Toss with the pasta, lemon juice and a splash of pasta water and top with parmesan.

Recipe: Pesto Shrimp over Brown Rice Pasta
Ingredients: Shrimp, Brown Rice Pasta, Pesto, Cherry Tomatoes, Olive Oil
Instructions: Cook the brown rice pasta according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Toss the pasta and shrimp with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed.

Recipe: Tofu Taco Salad with Cotija and Lime Crema
Ingredients: Tofu, Romaine Lettuce, Corn, Black Beans, Cherry Tomatoes, Cotija, Tortilla Chips, Taco Seasoning, Lime Crema
Instructions: Season the tofu with the taco seasoning. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Toss the romaine, corn, black beans and tomatoes in a large bowl. Top with the tofu, cotija and crushed tortilla chips and drizzle with the lime crema.

Recipe: Hoisin Shrimp Stir-Fry with Green Beans and Red Onion
Ingredients: Shrimp, Brown Rice, Green Beans, Red Onion, Hoisin Sauce, Rice Vinegar, Garlic, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque, then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the green beans and red onion for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the shrimp to the pan, add the hoisin sauce, rice vinegar and garlic and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the brown rice.

Recipe: Chicken Lo Mein with Bok Choy and Snow Peas
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Egg Noodles, Soy Sauce, Sesame Oil, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking Oil, Bok Choy, Snow Peas
Instructions: Cook the noodles, drain, and toss with a little oil. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Stir-fry the bok choy and snow peas until tender-crisp. Add the noodles and the soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic and ginger, return the chicken, and toss until everything is coated and hot.

Recipe: Chicken Fresh Spring Rolls with Mint and Carrots
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Rice Paper Wrappers, Rice Noodles, Mixed Greens, Carrots, Mint, Peanut Dipping Sauce
Instructions: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F), then slice thinly. Soak the rice paper wrappers one at a time in warm water until pliable. Layer each wrapper with the rice noodles, mixed greens, carrots, mint and the chicken. Fold in the sides and roll tightly. Serve with the peanut dipping sauce.

Ingredients: Shrimp, Brown Rice, Honey, Soy Sauce, Garlic, Ginger, Sesame Seeds, Broccoli, Cucumber
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Recipe: Thai Basil Chicken Stir-Fry with Asparagus and Mushrooms
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Jasmine Rice, Asparagus, Mushrooms, Fish Sauce, Oyster Sauce, Thai Basil, Dried Chilies, Garlic, Cooking Oil

Recipe: Chicken Tortilla Soup with Lime Crema
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Chicken Broth, Corn Tortillas, Diced Tomatoes, Onion, Garlic, Cumin, Chili Powder, Lime Juice, Cilantro, Lime Crema
Instructions: Bake or toast the corn tortilla strips until crisp. Saute the onion and garlic, then add the cumin, chili powder and diced tomatoes. Add the chicken broth and simmer for 15 minutes. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Ladle into bowls and top with the tortilla strips, lime crema, cilantro and lime juice.

Recipe: Thai Basil Chicken Fried Rice (Brown Rice)
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Brown Rice, Fish Sauce, Thai Basil, Garlic, Dried Chilies, Eggs, Cooking Oil

Heat the oil in a large pan and stir-fry the aromatics and vegetables for 2 minutes. Add the rice and the fish sauce and stir-fry until the rice is hot and lightly toasted. Fold in the chicken and eggs and cook until everything is heated through.

Recipe: Antipasto Salad with Tuna and Italian Dressing
Ingredients: Canned Tuna, Mixed Greens, Olives, Roasted Red Peppers, Mozzarella, Chickpeas, Cherry Tomatoes, Italian Vinaigrette
Instructions: Drain the canned tuna and flake it with a fork. Toss the greens, olives, roasted red peppers, mozzarella and tomatoes. Top with the tuna and dress with the italian vinaigrette.

Recipe: Yogurt Dipped Pineapple with greek yogurt and honey
Ingredients: Pineapple, Greek Yogurt, Honey

Recipe: Sizzling Pork Fajitas with Salsa (Corn Tortillas)

Recipe: Lemon Quinoa Salad with White Bean, Spinach and Olives
Ingredients: Quinoa, White Beans, Spinach, Olives, Lemon Juice, Olive Oil, Parsley
Instructions: Cook the quinoa and let it cool. Drain and rinse the white beans, then warm them through in a pan. Toss the quinoa with the spinach, olives and white bean. Dress with the lemon juice, olive oil and parsley.

Recipe: Baked Spinach Rice Pasta with Ricotta
Ingredients: Spinach, Brown Rice Pasta, Marinara Sauce, Garlic, Basil, Ricotta, Parmesan, Mozzarella
Instructions: Cook the brown rice pasta until just shy of tender and drain. Saute the spinach until tender. Stir the marinara sauce, garlic and basil into the pan. Combine with the pasta and half the ricotta and transfer to a baking dish. Top with the remaining ricotta and the parmesan and bake at 375°F for 20 to 25 minutes until bubbling.

Recipe: Cilantro-Lime Pork Burrito Bowl with Pinto Beans and Corn
Ingredients: Pork Shoulder, White Rice, Pinto Beans, Corn, Lime Juice, Cilantro, Garlic, Olive Oil

Recipe: Egg Drop Soup with Tofu and Corn
Ingredients: Tofu, Corn, Eggs, Cornstarch, Green Onions, Ginger, Soy Sauce, Vegetable Broth
Instructions: Bring the vegetable broth to a simmer with the ginger and soy sauce. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Add the corn and thicken lightly with cornstarch mixed with water. Drizzle in the beaten eggs while stirring to make ribbons and top with green onions.

Recipe: Creamy Alfredo Scallop over Brown Rice Pasta
Ingredients: Scallops, Brown Rice Pasta, Heavy Cream, Butter, Parmesan, Garlic, Black Pepper
Instructions: Cook the brown rice pasta according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Sear the scallops for 1 to 2 minutes per side until golden and opaque, then set aside. Simmer the heavy cream, butter and garlic in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and scallop with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed, and finish with parmesan.

Recipe: Classic Shrimp Fried Rice
Ingredients: Shrimp, Jasmine Rice, Eggs, Soy Sauce, Green Onions, Peas, Carrots, Cooking Oil

Recipe: Garlic Olive Oil White Bean over Brown Rice Pasta
Ingredients: White Beans, Brown Rice Pasta, Olive Oil, Garlic, Chili Flakes, Parsley, Lemon Juice
Instructions: Cook the brown rice pasta according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Drain and rinse the white beans, then warm them through in a pan, then set aside. Recipe: Orange Ginger Edamame Stir-Fry with Bok Choy and Mushrooms
Ingredients: Edamame, White Rice, Bok Choy, Mushrooms, Orange Juice, Soy Sauce, Ginger, Cornstarch, Cooking Oil

Ingredients: Spinach, Rigatoni, Marinara Sauce, Garlic, Basil, Ricotta, Parmesan, Mozzarella

Ingredients: Halloumi, Brown Rice, Cucumber, Red Onion, Garlic, Parsley, Thyme, Olive Oil, Lemon Olive Oil Dressing
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Toss the halloumi with the garlic, parsley and thyme and olive oil. Slice the halloumi and pan-fry until golden on both sides.
