Fill the bowls with the brown rice, cucumber and red onion. Top with the halloumi and drizzle with the lemon herb vinaigrette.

Recipe: Marinara Chickpea Spaghetti
Ingredients: Chickpeas, Spaghetti, Marinara Sauce, Garlic, Basil, Olive Oil, Parmesan
Instructions: Cook the spaghetti according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Drain and rinse the chickpeas, then warm them through (or crisp them in a hot pan), then set aside. Simmer the marinara sauce, garlic, basil and olive oil in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and chickpea with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed, and finish with parmesan.

Recipe: Shrimp Biryani-Style Rice with Cashews
Ingredients: Shrimp, Basmati Rice, Greek Yogurt, Onion, Garam Masala, Turmeric, Garlic, Ginger, Cilantro, Cashews, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Marinate the shrimp in the yogurt and half the spices for at least 30 minutes. Cook the onion in the oil until deep golden. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Layer with the partly cooked basmati rice and the cashews, cover tightly, and steam on low heat for 15 to 20 minutes. Fluff and top with cilantro.

Recipe: Garlic-Cumin Cod Tacos with Lettuce, Cheddar and Salsa
Ingredients: Cod Fillet, Corn Tortillas, Garlic, Cumin, Oregano, Lime Juice, Romaine Lettuce, Cheddar Cheese, Salsa
Instructions: Season the cod with the garlic, cumin, oregano and lime juice. Cut the cod into chunks and gently cook in a pan until opaque and flaky (145°F). Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the cod and top with romaine lettuce, cheddar cheese and salsa.

Recipe: Smoky Paprika Beef Tacos with Salsa Verde and Red Onion
Ingredients: Ground Beef, Corn Tortillas, Smoked Paprika, Garlic, Cumin, Olive Oil, Salsa Verde, Red Onion, Cilantro
Instructions: Season the beef with the smoked paprika, garlic and cumin. Brown the ground beef in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (160°F). Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the beef and top with salsa verde, red onion and cilantro.

Recipe: Tofu Fresh Spring Rolls with Cilantro and Cucumber
Ingredients: Tofu, Rice Paper Wrappers, Rice Noodles, Mixed Greens, Cucumber, Cilantro, Peanut Dipping Sauce
Instructions: Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides, then slice thinly. Soak the rice paper wrappers one at a time in warm water until pliable. Layer each wrapper with the rice noodles, mixed greens, cucumber, cilantro and the tofu. Fold in the sides and roll tightly. Serve with the peanut dipping sauce.

Recipe: Fajita-Style Tofu Burrito Bowl with Black Beans and Lime Crema
Ingredients: Tofu, Brown Rice, Black Beans, Lime Crema, Bell Pepper, Onion, Chili Powder, Cumin, Lime Juice, Olive Oil
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Season the tofu with the bell pepper, onion, chili powder, cumin and lime juice. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Drain and rinse the black beans, then warm them through in a pan. Build the bowls with the rice, beans, tofu and lime crema.

Recipe: Beef Lo Mein with Broccoli and Carrots
Ingredients: Beef Sirloin Strips, Egg Noodles, Soy Sauce, Sesame Oil, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking Oil, Broccoli, Carrots
Instructions: Cook the noodles, drain, and toss with a little oil. Sear the beef strips in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (at least 145°F), then set aside. Stir-fry the broccoli and carrots until tender-crisp. Add the noodles and the soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic and ginger, return the beef, and toss until everything is coated and hot.

Recipe: Marinara Eggplant Fettuccine
Ingredients: Eggplant, Fettuccine, Marinara Sauce, Garlic, Basil, Olive Oil, Parmesan
Instructions: Cook the fettuccine according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Cube the eggplant and roast or saute until soft and golden, then set aside. Simmer the marinara sauce, garlic, basil and olive oil in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and eggplant with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed, and finish with parmesan.

Recipe: Thai Basil Pork Fried Rice (Brown Rice)
Ingredients: Pork Tenderloin, Brown Rice, Fish Sauce, Thai Basil, Garlic, Dried Chilies, Eggs, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Use day-old cold cooked brown rice for the best texture. Slice the pork into thin pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (145°F), then set aside. Heat the oil in a large pan and stir-fry the aromatics and vegetables for 2 minutes. Add the rice and the fish sauce and stir-fry until the rice is hot and lightly toasted. Fold in the pork and eggs and cook until everything is heated through.

Recipe: Hibachi-Style Ham Fried Rice
Ingredients: Ham, Jasmine Rice, Butter, Soy Sauce, Eggs, Garlic, Onion, Carrots, Peas
Instructions: Use day-old cold cooked jasmine rice for the best texture. Dice the ham and warm it through in the pan, then set aside. Heat the oil in a large pan and stir-fry the aromatics and vegetables for 2 minutes. Add the rice and the butter and soy sauce and stir-fry until the rice is hot and lightly toasted. Fold in the ham and eggs and cook until everything is heated through.

Recipe: Chicken Udon Stir-Fry with Carrots and Green Onions
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Udon Noodles, Soy Sauce, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking Oil, Carrots, Green Onions
Instructions: Cook the udon noodles according to package directions and drain. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Stir-fry the carrots and green onions with the garlic and ginger until tender-crisp. Add the noodles, soy sauce and chicken and toss until heated through.

Recipe: Garlic Herb Turkey Brown Rice Bowl with Lemon Herb Vinaigrette
Ingredients: Turkey Breast, Brown Rice, Red Onion, Olives, Garlic, Parsley, Thyme, Olive Oil, Lemon Olive Oil Dressing
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Toss the turkey with the garlic, parsley and thyme and olive oil. Cut the turkey into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until cooked through (165°F). Fill the bowls with the brown rice, red onion and olives. Top with the turkey and drizzle with the lemon herb vinaigrette.

Recipe: Mulligatawny-Style Sweet Potato Soup with Apple
Ingredients: Sweet Potatoes, Vegetable Broth, Lentils, Coconut Milk, Curry Powder, Onion, Garlic, Apple
Instructions: Saute the onion and garlic with the curry powder. Add the vegetable broth, lentils and apple and simmer for 25 minutes. Cube the sweet potatoes and roast at 425°F until tender and caramelized (about 25 minutes). Stir in the coconut milk and blend partly for a thick texture.

Recipe: Spiced Tofu Kathi Roll with Tzatziki
Ingredients: Tofu, Flour Tortillas, Tzatziki, Red Onion, Cucumber, Cilantro, Garam Masala, Lemon Juice, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Toss the tofu with the garam masala and lemon juice. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Warm the tortillas. Fill with the tofu, red onion, cucumber and cilantro and drizzle with the tzatziki.

Recipe: Creamy Alfredo Scallop Fettuccine
Ingredients: Scallops, Fettuccine, Heavy Cream, Butter, Parmesan, Garlic, Black Pepper
Instructions: Cook the fettuccine according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Sear the scallops for 1 to 2 minutes per side until golden and opaque, then set aside. Simmer the heavy cream, butter and garlic in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and scallop with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed, and finish with parmesan.

Recipe: Tuscan White Bean and Kale Soup with Chicken
Ingredients: White Beans, Chicken Broth, Kale, Onion, Carrots, Celery, Garlic, Rosemary, Olive Oil, Chicken Breast
Instructions: Saute the onion, carrots, celery and garlic in the olive oil. Add the chicken broth, white beans and rosemary and simmer for 20 minutes. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Stir in the kale until wilted.

Recipe: Hot and Sour Chicken Soup with Cabbage
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Cabbage, Soy Sauce, Rice Vinegar, Black Pepper, Cornstarch, Eggs, Mushrooms, Ginger, Chicken Broth
Instructions: Bring the chicken broth to a simmer with the ginger and mushrooms. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Stir in the soy sauce and rice vinegar, then thicken with the cornstarch mixed with water. Drizzle in the beaten eggs while stirring slowly to make ribbons. Finish with black pepper and the cabbage.

Recipe: Baked Pork Rice Pasta with Mozzarella
Ingredients: Ground Pork, Brown Rice Pasta, Marinara Sauce, Garlic, Basil, Mozzarella, Parmesan
Instructions: Cook the brown rice pasta until just shy of tender and drain. Brown the ground pork in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (160°F). Stir the marinara sauce, garlic and basil into the pan. Combine with the pasta and half the mozzarella and transfer to a baking dish. Top with the remaining mozzarella and the parmesan and bake at 375°F for 20 to 25 minutes until bubbling.

Recipe: Harira-Style Chickpea and Lentil Soup with Chicken and Cilantro
Ingredients: Chickpeas, Lentils, Diced Tomatoes, Chicken Broth, Onion, Celery, Cinnamon, Turmeric, Cilantro, Chicken Breast
Instructions: Saute the onion and celery with the cinnamon and turmeric. Add the tomatoes, chickpeas, lentils and chicken broth and simmer for 30 minutes. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F) and add to the pot. Finish with cilantro.

Recipe: Baked Mushrooms Rigatoni with Ricotta
Ingredients: Mushrooms, Rigatoni, Marinara Sauce, Garlic, Basil, Ricotta, Parmesan, Mozzarella
Instructions: Cook the rigatoni until just shy of tender and drain. Saute the mushrooms until tender. Stir the marinara sauce, garlic and basil into the pan. Combine with the pasta and half the ricotta and transfer to a baking dish. Top with the remaining ricotta and the parmesan and bake at 375°F for 20 to 25 minutes until bubbling.

Recipe: Cilantro-Lime Chicken Burrito Bowl with Black Beans and Avocado
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, White Rice, Black Beans, Avocado, Lime Juice, Cilantro, Garlic, Olive Oil
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Season the chicken with the lime juice, cilantro and garlic. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Drain and rinse the black beans, then warm them through in a pan. Build the bowls with the rice, beans, chicken and avocado.

Recipe: Sheet-Pan BBQ Cod with Potatoes and Green Beans
Ingredients: Cod Fillet, Potatoes, Green Beans, BBQ Sauce, Olive Oil
Instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the potatoes and green beans with half of the bbq sauce and olive oil on a sheet pan. Coat the cod with the remaining seasoning and add to the pan. Roast until the protein is cooked through (165°F for poultry, 145°F for pork and fish) and the vegetables are tender and browned.

Recipe: Spiced Chickpea Kathi Roll with Garlic
Ingredients: Chickpeas, Flour Tortillas, Garlic Yogurt Sauce, Red Onion, Cucumber, Cilantro, Garam Masala, Lemon Juice, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Toss the chickpeas with the garam masala and lemon juice. Drain and rinse the chickpeas, then warm them through (or crisp them in a hot pan). Warm the tortillas. Fill with the chickpeas, red onion, cucumber and cilantro and drizzle with the garlic yogurt sauce.

Recipe: Marinara Turkey Rigatoni
Ingredients: Ground Turkey, Rigatoni, Marinara Sauce, Garlic, Basil, Olive Oil, Parmesan
Instructions: Cook the rigatoni according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Brown the ground turkey in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Simmer the marinara sauce, garlic, basil and olive oil in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and turkey with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed, and finish with parmesan.

Recipe: Hearty Chicken Stew with Kale
Ingredients: Chicken Thighs, Kale, Chicken Broth, Potatoes, Carrots, Onion, Tomato Paste, Thyme, Bay Leaf, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Brown the chicken in the oil in a large pot. Add the onion, carrots and potatoes and cook for 3 minutes. Add the tomato paste, thyme, bay leaf and chicken broth and simmer until the chicken is tender (about 1 hour for meat, 25 minutes for lentils). Add the kale for the last 10 minutes.

Recipe: Greek Salad with Beef (No Cheese)
Ingredients: Beef Sirloin Strips, Cucumber, Tomatoes, Red Onion, Olives, Olive Oil, Oregano, Red Wine Vinegar, Romaine Lettuce
Instructions: Season the beef and sear until browned and cooked through (at least 145°F), then slice. Chop the cucumber, tomatoes and red onion and toss with the romaine and olives. Whisk the olive oil, oregano and red wine vinegar and dress the salad. Top with the beef.

Recipe: Taco-Seasoned Shrimp Burrito Bowl with Black Beans and Salsa
Ingredients: Shrimp, Brown Rice, Black Beans, Salsa, Taco Seasoning, Tomato Paste, Olive Oil
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Season the shrimp with the taco seasoning and tomato paste. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Drain and rinse the black beans, then warm them through in a pan. Build the bowls with the rice, beans, shrimp and salsa.

Recipe: Bolognese-Style Beef Linguine
Ingredients: Ground Beef, Linguine, Crushed Tomatoes, Onion, Carrots, Celery, Garlic, Olive Oil, Tomato Paste
Instructions: Cook the linguine according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Brown the ground beef in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (160°F), then set aside. Simmer the crushed tomatoes, onion, carrots and celery in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and beef with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed.

Recipe: Classic Beef Fried Rice (Brown Rice)
Ingredients: Beef Sirloin Strips, Brown Rice, Eggs, Soy Sauce, Green Onions, Peas, Carrots, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Use day-old cold cooked brown rice for the best texture. Sear the beef strips in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (at least 145°F), then set aside. Heat the oil in a large pan and stir-fry the aromatics and vegetables for 2 minutes. Add the rice and the soy sauce and stir-fry until the rice is hot and lightly toasted. Fold in the beef and eggs and cook until everything is heated through.

Recipe: Sizzling Tofu Fajitas with Salsa (Flour Tortillas)
Ingredients: Tofu, Flour Tortillas, Bell Pepper, Onion, Chili Powder, Cumin, Garlic, Lime Juice, Salsa, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Toss the tofu with the chili powder, cumin, garlic and lime juice. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Cook the bell pepper and onion in a very hot pan until charred at the edges. Serve the tofu and vegetables with the warm tortillas and salsa.

Recipe: Ginger Rice Soup with Pork and Carrots
Ingredients: Pork Tenderloin, Carrots, White Rice, Ginger, Soy Sauce, Green Onions, Vegetable Broth
Instructions: Simmer the rice in the vegetable broth with the ginger until very soft and thick. Slice the pork into thin pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (145°F). Stir in the carrots and cook until tender. Season with soy sauce and top with green onions.

Recipe: Coconut Chicken Curry over Basmati Rice
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Basmati Rice, Coconut Milk, Curry Powder, Ginger, Garlic, Lime Juice, Onion, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the basmati rice according to package directions. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil until soft, then stir in the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the coconut milk and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Return the chicken to the sauce and simmer until heated through, then serve over the rice.

Recipe: Korma-Style Tofu Curry over Brown Rice
Ingredients: Tofu, Brown Rice, Cashews, Coconut Milk, Onion, Garam Masala, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides, then set aside. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil until soft, then stir in the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the cashews and coconut milk and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Return the tofu to the sauce and simmer until heated through, then serve over the rice.

Recipe: Egg Salad Wrap with Spinach and Cucumber
Ingredients: Eggs, Mayonnaise, Celery, Mustard, Flour Tortillas, Spinach, Cucumber
Instructions: Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool, and chop. Mix with the mayonnaise, celery and mustard. Fill the bread with the egg salad and spinach and cucumber.

Recipe: Sheet-Pan Cajun Cod with Asparagus and Cherry Tomatoes
Ingredients: Cod Fillet, Asparagus, Cherry Tomatoes, Cajun Seasoning, Olive Oil
Instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the asparagus and cherry tomatoes with half of the cajun seasoning and olive oil on a sheet pan. Coat the cod with the remaining seasoning and add to the pan. Roast until the protein is cooked through (165°F for poultry, 145°F for pork and fish) and the vegetables are tender and browned.

Recipe: Chipotle Tofu Burrito Bowl with Black Beans and Lime Crema
Ingredients: Tofu, White Rice, Black Beans, Lime Crema, Chipotle Peppers in Adobo, Garlic, Lime Juice, Olive Oil
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Season the tofu with the chipotle peppers in adobo, garlic and lime juice. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Drain and rinse the black beans, then warm them through in a pan. Build the bowls with the rice, beans, tofu and lime crema.

Recipe: Panzanella Bread Salad with White Bean and Parmesan
Ingredients: Bread, Tomatoes, Cucumber, Red Onion, Basil, Olive Oil, Red Wine Vinegar, Parmesan, White Beans
Instructions: Toast the bread cubes in the oven until crisp. Drain and rinse the white beans, then warm them through in a pan. Toss the bread with the tomatoes, cucumber, red onion and basil. Dress with the olive oil and red wine vinegar and top with parmesan.

Recipe: Fajita-Style Turkey Burrito Bowl with Black Beans and Salsa
Ingredients: Ground Turkey, White Rice, Black Beans, Salsa, Bell Pepper, Onion, Chili Powder, Cumin, Lime Juice, Olive Oil
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Season the turkey with the bell pepper, onion, chili powder, cumin and lime juice. Brown the ground turkey in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (165°F). Drain and rinse the black beans, then warm them through in a pan. Build the bowls with the rice, beans, turkey and salsa.

Recipe: Turkey and White Soup with Spinach
Ingredients: Turkey Breast, White Rice, Spinach, Chicken Broth, Onion, Carrots, Celery, Garlic, Thyme, Cooking Oil, Black Pepper
Instructions: Saute the onion, carrots and celery in the oil. Add the chicken broth, garlic and thyme and bring to a simmer. Cut the turkey into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until cooked through (165°F). Add the white rice and cook until tender. Stir in the spinach and season with salt and black pepper.

Recipe: Teriyaki Beef Rice Bowl with Edamame
Ingredients: Beef Sirloin Strips, Jasmine Rice, Teriyaki Sauce, Garlic, Ginger, Broccoli, Carrots, Green Onions, Edamame
Instructions: Cook the jasmine rice according to package directions. Sear the beef strips in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (at least 145°F). Add the teriyaki sauce, garlic and ginger and simmer until glazed. Steam the broccoli and carrots until tender-crisp. Serve over the rice with edamame.

Recipe: Baked Turkey Rice Pasta with Ricotta
Ingredients: Ground Turkey, Brown Rice Pasta, Marinara Sauce, Garlic, Basil, Ricotta, Parmesan, Mozzarella
Instructions: Cook the brown rice pasta until just shy of tender and drain. Brown the ground turkey in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (165°F). Stir the marinara sauce, garlic and basil into the pan. Combine with the pasta and half the ricotta and transfer to a baking dish. Top with the remaining ricotta and the parmesan and bake at 375°F for 20 to 25 minutes until bubbling.

Recipe: Marinara Beef Spaghetti
Ingredients: Ground Beef, Spaghetti, Marinara Sauce, Garlic, Basil, Olive Oil, Parmesan
Instructions: Cook the spaghetti according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Brown the ground beef in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (160°F), then set aside. Simmer the marinara sauce, garlic, basil and olive oil in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and beef with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed, and finish with parmesan.

Recipe: Shrimp Yakisoba-Style Noodles with Bell Pepper and Cabbage
Ingredients: Shrimp, Ramen Noodles, Soy Sauce, Ketchup, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking Oil, Bell Pepper, Cabbage
Instructions: Cook the noodles according to package directions and drain. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque, then set aside. Stir-fry the bell pepper and cabbage until tender-crisp. Add the noodles, shrimp, soy sauce and ketchup and toss until glazed and hot.

Recipe: White Chicken Chili with Smoked Paprika Spices and Cheddar Cheese
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, White Beans, Chicken Broth, Smoked Paprika, Cumin, Chipotle Peppers in Adobo, Onion, Bell Pepper, Garlic, Cheddar Cheese
Instructions: Saute the onion, bell pepper and garlic with the spices. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Add the remaining ingredients with a cup of water and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes. Serve topped with cheddar cheese.

Recipe: Chicken Enchiladas with Cotija and Cilantro
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Corn Tortillas, Cotija, Crushed Tomatoes, Chili Powder, Cumin, Garlic, Onion, Cilantro
Instructions: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Simmer the crushed tomatoes with the chili powder, cumin, garlic and onion for 10 minutes to make a flour-free sauce. Fill the corn tortillas with the chicken and some of the cotija, roll, and place seam-side down in a baking dish. Pour the sauce over the top, sprinkle with the remaining cheese, and bake at 375°F for 20 minutes until bubbly.

Recipe: Corn Chowder with Thyme
Ingredients: Potatoes, Corn, Milk, Bacon, Flour, Butter, Onion, Chicken Broth, Thyme
Instructions: Saute the aromatics in butter or oil until soft. Add the main vegetables or proteins, then the broth or milk, and simmer until tender. Blend until smooth or leave chunky, depending on the soup. Season to taste and top with thyme.

Recipe: Garlic Herb Lamb Gyro with Tahini Lemon Sauce
Ingredients: Ground Lamb, Pita Bread, Cucumber, Lettuce, Garlic, Parsley, Thyme, Olive Oil, Tahini, Lemon Juice
Instructions: Toss the lamb with the garlic, parsley and thyme and olive oil. Mix the ground lamb with the spices, shape into patties or a loaf, and cook until browned and cooked through (160°F), then slice. Warm the pita bread. Stuff the pita with the lamb, cucumber and lettuce and spoon over the tahini lemon sauce.

Recipe: Italian Turkey Salad with Strawberries and Pecans on Arugula
Ingredients: Turkey Breast, Arugula, Strawberries, Pecans, Italian Vinaigrette
Instructions: Season the turkey and roast or pan-sear until cooked through (165°F), then slice. Toss the arugula with the strawberries and pecans. Top with the turkey and drizzle with the italian vinaigrette.

Recipe: Grilled Chicken Sandwich with Honey Mustard and Mozzarella and Basil
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Bread, Dijon Mustard, Honey, Mozzarella, Basil
Instructions: Season the chicken and grill or pan-sear until cooked through (165°F), then slice. Toast the bread or warm the tortilla. Spread with the dijon mustard and honey. Layer the grilled chicken with the mozzarella and basil.

Recipe: Vindaloo-Style Pork Curry over Brown Rice
Ingredients: Pork Shoulder, Brown Rice, Red Wine Vinegar, Chili Powder, Garlic, Ginger, Cumin, Crushed Tomatoes, Onion, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Braise or slow-cook the pork until very tender (at least 145°F, ideally much longer for shredding), then shred it, then set aside. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil until soft, then stir in the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the crushed tomatoes and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Return the pork to the sauce and simmer until heated through, then serve over the rice.

Recipe: Pineapple Cashew Beef Fried Rice
Ingredients: Beef Sirloin Strips, Jasmine Rice, Pineapple, Cashews, Curry Powder, Soy Sauce, Eggs, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Use day-old cold cooked jasmine rice for the best texture. Sear the beef strips in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (at least 145°F), then set aside. Heat the oil in a large pan and stir-fry the aromatics and vegetables for 2 minutes. Add the rice and the curry powder and soy sauce and stir-fry until the rice is hot and lightly toasted. Fold in the beef and eggs and cook until everything is heated through.

Recipe: Sesame Peanut Chicken Noodles with Cucumber and Carrots
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Soba Noodles, Peanut Butter, Soy Sauce, Sesame Oil, Rice Vinegar, Garlic, Lime Juice, Cucumber, Carrots
Instructions: Cook the soba noodles, drain, and rinse under cold water. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, garlic and lime juice with a splash of warm water until smooth. Toss the noodles with the sauce, the cucumber and the carrots, then top with the chicken.

Recipe: Coconut Sweet Potato Curry over Basmati Rice
Ingredients: Sweet Potatoes, Basmati Rice, Coconut Milk, Curry Powder, Ginger, Garlic, Lime Juice, Onion, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the basmati rice according to package directions. Cube the sweet potatoes and roast at 425°F until tender and caramelized (about 25 minutes), then set aside. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil until soft, then stir in the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the coconut milk and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Return the sweet potatoes to the sauce and simmer until heated through, then serve over the rice.

Recipe: Sesame Ginger Beef Stir-Fry with Asparagus and Mushrooms
Ingredients: Beef Sirloin Strips, Brown Rice, Asparagus, Mushrooms, Soy Sauce, Sesame Oil, Sesame Seeds, Ginger, Garlic, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Sear the beef strips in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (at least 145°F), then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the asparagus and mushrooms for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the beef to the pan, add the soy sauce, sesame oil, sesame seeds, ginger and garlic and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the brown rice.

Recipe: Honey Soy Chicken Stir-Fry with Broccoli and Carrots
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Jasmine Rice, Broccoli, Carrots, Soy Sauce, Honey, Garlic, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the jasmine rice according to package directions. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the broccoli and carrots for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the chicken to the pan, add the soy sauce, honey and garlic and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the jasmine rice.

Recipe: Primavera Cherry Tomatoes Spaghetti
Ingredients: Spaghetti, Olive Oil, Garlic, Zucchini, Cherry Tomatoes, Parmesan, Lemon Juice
Instructions: Cook the spaghetti according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Saute the garlic and zucchini in the olive oil for 3 minutes. Add the cherry tomatoes and cook until just tender. Toss with the pasta, lemon juice and a splash of pasta water and top with parmesan.

Recipe: Smoky Paprika Halloumi White Rice Bowl with Lemon Herb Vinaigrette
Ingredients: Halloumi, White Rice, Roasted Red Peppers, Spinach, Smoked Paprika, Garlic, Lemon Juice, Olive Oil, Lemon Olive Oil Dressing, Parsley
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Toss the halloumi with the smoked paprika, garlic and lemon juice and olive oil. Slice the halloumi and pan-fry until golden on both sides. Fill the bowls with the white rice, roasted red peppers and spinach. Top with the halloumi and drizzle with the lemon herb vinaigrette.

Recipe: Tabbouleh-Style Salad with Chickpea and Parsley
Ingredients: Chickpeas, Bulgur, Tomatoes, Cucumber, Parsley, Lemon Juice, Olive Oil, Red Onion
Instructions: Soak the bulgur in hot water until tender, then drain well. Drain and rinse the chickpeas. Toss the bulgur with the chopped tomatoes, cucumber, red onion and plenty of parsley. Dress with the lemon juice and olive oil and top with the chickpeas.

Recipe: Lemon Olive Oil Bacon Salad with Parmesan and Croutons on Spinach
Ingredients: Bacon, Spinach, Parmesan, Croutons, Lemon Olive Oil Dressing
Instructions: Cook the bacon until crisp and crumble it. Toss the spinach with the parmesan and croutons. Top with the bacon and drizzle with the lemon olive oil dressing.

Recipe: Chicken Enchiladas with Cheddar and Cilantro
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Corn Tortillas, Cheddar Cheese, Crushed Tomatoes, Chili Powder, Cumin, Garlic, Onion, Cilantro
Instructions: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Simmer the crushed tomatoes with the chili powder, cumin, garlic and onion for 10 minutes to make a flour-free sauce. Fill the corn tortillas with the chicken and some of the cheddar cheese, roll, and place seam-side down in a baking dish. Pour the sauce over the top, sprinkle with the remaining cheese, and bake at 375°F for 20 minutes until bubbly.

Recipe: Garlic Shrimp Polenta Bowl
Ingredients: Polenta, Vegetable Broth, Shrimp, Garlic, Cherry Tomatoes, Olive Oil, Parmesan
Instructions: Whisk the polenta into the simmering vegetable broth and cook, stirring often, until thick and creamy (about 20 minutes). Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Cook the remaining toppings in a pan until tender and combined. Spoon the polenta into bowls, stir in the parmesan, and top with the garlic shrimp.

Recipe: Hot and Sour Shrimp Soup with Bok Choy
Ingredients: Shrimp, Bok Choy, Soy Sauce, Rice Vinegar, Black Pepper, Cornstarch, Eggs, Mushrooms, Ginger, Vegetable Broth
Instructions: Bring the vegetable broth to a simmer with the ginger and mushrooms. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Stir in the soy sauce and rice vinegar, then thicken with the cornstarch mixed with water. Drizzle in the beaten eggs while stirring slowly to make ribbons. Finish with black pepper and the bok choy.

Recipe: Poke-Style Tuna Rice Bowl with Green Onions
Ingredients: Tuna Steak, Brown Rice, Soy Sauce, Sesame Oil, Sesame Seeds, Rice Vinegar, Avocado, Cucumber, Edamame, Green Onions
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions and season with the rice vinegar. Sear the tuna on all sides until cooked through (145°F), then cut into cubes, then let cool slightly. Toss the tuna with the soy sauce and sesame oil. Top the rice with the tuna, avocado, cucumber, edamame, sesame seeds and green onions.

Recipe: Avgolemono-Style Lemon Chicken Soup with Orzo
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Chicken Broth, Orzo, Eggs, Lemon Juice, Dill, Carrots, Onion
Instructions: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Simmer the chicken broth with the carrots, onion and orzo until tender. Whisk the eggs with the lemon juice, then slowly whisk in a ladle of hot broth to temper them. Stir the egg mixture back into the soup over low heat until slightly thickened (do not boil). Top with dill.

Recipe: Antipasto Salad with Chickpea and Balsamic Dressing
Ingredients: Chickpeas, Mixed Greens, Olives, Roasted Red Peppers, Mozzarella, Cherry Tomatoes, Balsamic Vinaigrette
Instructions: Drain and rinse the chickpeas. Toss the greens, olives, roasted red peppers, mozzarella and tomatoes. Top with the chickpeas and dress with the balsamic vinaigrette.

Recipe: Chili-Lime Steak Tacos with Cabbage Slaw and Lime Crema
Ingredients: Flank Steak, Corn Tortillas, Chili Powder, Lime Juice, Garlic, Cumin, Coleslaw Mix, Lime Crema, Cilantro
Instructions: Season the steak with the chili powder, lime juice, garlic and cumin. Slice the steak thinly against the grain and sear in a hot pan until browned (at least 145°F). Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the steak and top with coleslaw mix, lime crema, cilantro and lime juice.

Recipe: Saag-Style Tofu Curry over Brown Rice
Ingredients: Tofu, Brown Rice, Spinach, Onion, Garlic, Ginger, Cumin, Garam Masala, Cooking Oil, Coconut Milk
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides, then set aside. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil until soft, then stir in the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the spinach and coconut milk and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Return the tofu to the sauce and simmer until heated through, then serve over the rice.

Recipe: Madras-Style Chickpea Curry over Basmati Rice
Ingredients: Chickpeas, Basmati Rice, Curry Powder, Chili Powder, Tomato Paste, Onion, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking Oil, Coconut Milk
Instructions: Cook the basmati rice according to package directions. Drain and rinse the chickpeas, then warm them through (or crisp them in a hot pan), then set aside. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil until soft, then stir in the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the tomato paste and coconut milk and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Return the chickpeas to the sauce and simmer until heated through, then serve over the rice.

Recipe: Marinara Shrimp over Brown Rice Pasta
Ingredients: Shrimp, Brown Rice Pasta, Marinara Sauce, Garlic, Basil, Olive Oil, Parmesan
Instructions: Cook the brown rice pasta according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque, then set aside. Simmer the marinara sauce, garlic, basil and olive oil in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and shrimp with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed, and finish with parmesan.

Recipe: Sheet-Pan Maple Mustard Chicken with Zucchini and Bell Pepper
Ingredients: Chicken Thighs, Zucchini, Bell Pepper, Maple Syrup, Dijon Mustard, Olive Oil
Instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the zucchini and bell pepper with half of the maple syrup and dijon mustard and olive oil on a sheet pan. Coat the chicken with the remaining seasoning and add to the pan. Roast until the protein is cooked through (165°F for poultry, 145°F for pork and fish) and the vegetables are tender and browned.

Recipe: Hot and Sour Pork Soup with Cabbage
Ingredients: Pork Tenderloin, Cabbage, Soy Sauce, Rice Vinegar, Black Pepper, Cornstarch, Eggs, Mushrooms, Ginger, Vegetable Broth
Instructions: Bring the vegetable broth to a simmer with the ginger and mushrooms. Slice the pork into thin pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (145°F). Stir in the soy sauce and rice vinegar, then thicken with the cornstarch mixed with water. Drizzle in the beaten eggs while stirring slowly to make ribbons. Finish with black pepper and the cabbage.

Recipe: Ginger Rice Soup with Pork and Bok Choy
Ingredients: Pork Tenderloin, Bok Choy, White Rice, Ginger, Soy Sauce, Green Onions, Vegetable Broth
Instructions: Simmer the rice in the vegetable broth with the ginger until very soft and thick. Slice the pork into thin pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (145°F). Stir in the bok choy and cook until tender. Season with soy sauce and top with green onions.

Recipe: Saag-Style Chicken Curry over Basmati Rice
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Basmati Rice, Spinach, Onion, Garlic, Ginger, Cumin, Garam Masala, Cooking Oil, Coconut Milk
Instructions: Cook the basmati rice according to package directions. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil until soft, then stir in the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the spinach and coconut milk and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Return the chicken to the sauce and simmer until heated through, then serve over the rice.

Recipe: Primavera Asparagus Penne
Ingredients: Penne, Olive Oil, Garlic, Zucchini, Asparagus, Parmesan, Lemon Juice
Instructions: Cook the penne according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Saute the garlic and zucchini in the olive oil for 3 minutes. Add the asparagus and cook until just tender. Toss with the pasta, lemon juice and a splash of pasta water and top with parmesan.

Recipe: Dal Tadka with Green Beans over Basmati Rice
Ingredients: Lentils, Onion, Garlic, Ginger, Turmeric, Cumin, Cooking Oil, Cilantro, Basmati Rice, Green Beans
Instructions: Cook the basmati rice according to package directions. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger, then add the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the main ingredients, the green beans and a splash of water and simmer until tender and saucy. Serve over the basmati rice with cilantro.

Recipe: Shrimp Lo Mein with Bok Choy and Snow Peas
Ingredients: Shrimp, Egg Noodles, Soy Sauce, Sesame Oil, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking Oil, Bok Choy, Snow Peas
Instructions: Cook the noodles, drain, and toss with a little oil. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque, then set aside. Stir-fry the bok choy and snow peas until tender-crisp. Add the noodles and the soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic and ginger, return the shrimp, and toss until everything is coated and hot.

Recipe: Sesame Ginger Egg Fried Rice (Brown Rice)
Ingredients: Eggs, Brown Rice, Soy Sauce, Sesame Oil, Ginger, Green Onions
Instructions: Use day-old cold cooked brown rice for the best texture. Scramble the eggs and set aside. Heat the oil in a large pan and stir-fry the aromatics and vegetables for 2 minutes. Add the rice and the soy sauce and sesame oil and stir-fry until the rice is hot and lightly toasted. Fold in the egg and eggs and cook until everything is heated through.

Recipe: Pesto Shrimp Linguine
Ingredients: Shrimp, Linguine, Pesto, Cherry Tomatoes, Olive Oil
Instructions: Cook the linguine according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque, then set aside. Simmer the pesto, cherry tomatoes and olive oil in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and shrimp with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed.

Recipe: Tofu Udon Stir-Fry with Cabbage and Mushrooms
Ingredients: Tofu, Udon Noodles, Soy Sauce, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking Oil, Cabbage, Mushrooms
Instructions: Cook the udon noodles according to package directions and drain. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides, then set aside. Stir-fry the cabbage and mushrooms with the garlic and ginger until tender-crisp. Add the noodles, soy sauce and tofu and toss until heated through.

Recipe: Thai Basil Egg Fried Rice (Brown Rice)
Ingredients: Eggs, Brown Rice, Fish Sauce, Thai Basil, Garlic, Dried Chilies, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Use day-old cold cooked brown rice for the best texture. Scramble the eggs and set aside. Heat the oil in a large pan and stir-fry the aromatics and vegetables for 2 minutes. Add the rice and the fish sauce and stir-fry until the rice is hot and lightly toasted. Fold in the egg and eggs and cook until everything is heated through.

Recipe: Hoisin Shrimp Lettuce Cups with Bell Pepper
Ingredients: Shrimp, Butter Lettuce, Hoisin Sauce, Water Chestnuts, Green Onions, Garlic, Rice Vinegar, Bell Pepper, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque, then set aside. Saute the garlic and bell pepper for 2 minutes. Return the shrimp to the pan with the hoisin sauce, rice vinegar and water chestnuts and cook until glazed. Spoon into the lettuce leaves and top with green onions.

Recipe: Sesame Peanut Edamame Noodles with Green Onions and Cabbage
Ingredients: Edamame, Soba Noodles, Peanut Butter, Soy Sauce, Sesame Oil, Rice Vinegar, Garlic, Lime Juice, Green Onions, Cabbage
Instructions: Cook the soba noodles, drain, and rinse under cold water. Boil or steam the edamame for 4 to 5 minutes until tender. Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, garlic and lime juice with a splash of warm water until smooth. Toss the noodles with the sauce, the green onions and the cabbage, then top with the edamame.

Recipe: Hoisin Tofu Lettuce Cups with Cabbage
Ingredients: Tofu, Butter Lettuce, Hoisin Sauce, Water Chestnuts, Green Onions, Garlic, Rice Vinegar, Cabbage, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides, then set aside. Saute the garlic and cabbage for 2 minutes. Return the tofu to the pan with the hoisin sauce, rice vinegar and water chestnuts and cook until glazed. Spoon into the lettuce leaves and top with green onions.

Recipe: Salsa Verde Chicken Burrito Bowl with Pinto Beans and Pico de Gallo
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, White Rice, Pinto Beans, Pico de Gallo, Salsa Verde, Cilantro, Lime Juice
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Season the chicken with the salsa verde, cilantro and lime juice. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Drain and rinse the pinto beans, then warm them through in a pan. Build the bowls with the rice, beans, chicken and pico de gallo.

Recipe: Miso-Glazed Tofu Rice Bowl with Avocado
Ingredients: Tofu, Brown Rice, Miso Paste, Rice Vinegar, Honey, Ginger, Green Beans, Carrots, Avocado
Instructions: Whisk the miso, rice vinegar, honey and ginger into a glaze. Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides, brushing with the glaze in the last few minutes. Steam the green beans and carrots until tender-crisp. Serve over the rice with avocado.

Recipe: Hoisin Beef Lettuce Cups with Green Onions
Ingredients: Ground Beef, Butter Lettuce, Hoisin Sauce, Water Chestnuts, Green Onions, Garlic, Rice Vinegar, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Brown the ground beef in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (160°F), then set aside. Saute the garlic and green onions for 2 minutes. Return the beef to the pan with the hoisin sauce, rice vinegar and water chestnuts and cook until glazed. Spoon into the lettuce leaves and top with green onions.

Recipe: Caesar Egg Salad with Corn and Black Beans on Mixed Greens
Ingredients: Eggs, Mixed Greens, Corn, Black Beans, Caesar Dressing
Instructions: Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool, and slice. Toss the mixed greens with the corn and black beans. Top with the egg and drizzle with the caesar dressing.

Recipe: Greek Yogurt Bowl with Blueberries and Pumpkin Seeds
Ingredients: Greek Yogurt, Blueberries, Pumpkin Seeds
Instructions: Spoon the greek yogurt into a bowl. Top with the blueberries and pumpkin seeds.

Recipe: Turkey Chili with Chili Powder and Sour Cream
Ingredients: Ground Turkey, Kidney Beans, Diced Tomatoes, Chili Powder, Oregano, Cumin, Onion, Bell Pepper, Garlic, Sour Cream
Instructions: Saute the onion, bell pepper and garlic with the spices. Brown the ground turkey in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (165°F). Add the remaining ingredients with a cup of water and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes. Serve topped with sour cream.

Recipe: Pozole-Style Chicken Stew with Red Onion
Ingredients: Chicken Thighs, Chicken Broth, Hominy, Chili Powder, Garlic, Onion, Oregano, Lime Juice, Red Onion
Instructions: Saute the onion and garlic with the chili powder and oregano. Add the chicken broth and hominy. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Simmer until the flavors come together, about 30 minutes. Serve with lime juice and red onion.

Recipe: Honey Soy Tofu Stir-Fry with Asparagus and Mushrooms
Ingredients: Tofu, Jasmine Rice, Asparagus, Mushrooms, Soy Sauce, Honey, Garlic, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the jasmine rice according to package directions. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides, then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the asparagus and mushrooms for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the tofu to the pan, add the soy sauce, honey and garlic and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the jasmine rice.

Recipe: Mulligatawny-Style Lentil Soup with Apple
Ingredients: Lentils, Vegetable Broth, Coconut Milk, Curry Powder, Onion, Garlic, Apple
Instructions: Saute the onion and garlic with the curry powder. Add the vegetable broth, lentils and apple and simmer for 25 minutes. Cook the lentils until tender (or use canned lentils, drained and rinsed). Stir in the coconut milk and blend partly for a thick texture.

Recipe: Pork Lo Mein with Bell Pepper and Mushrooms
Ingredients: Pork Tenderloin, Egg Noodles, Soy Sauce, Sesame Oil, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking Oil, Bell Pepper, Mushrooms
Instructions: Cook the noodles, drain, and toss with a little oil. Slice the pork into thin pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (145°F), then set aside. Stir-fry the bell pepper and mushrooms until tender-crisp. Add the noodles and the soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic and ginger, return the pork, and toss until everything is coated and hot.

Recipe: Bibimbap-Style Pork Rice Bowl with Cucumber
Ingredients: Pork Tenderloin, Jasmine Rice, Gochujang, Sesame Oil, Soy Sauce, Spinach, Carrots, Zucchini, Mushrooms, Eggs, Cucumber
Instructions: Cook the jasmine rice according to package directions. Slice the pork into thin pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (145°F). Saute the spinach, carrots, zucchini and mushrooms separately until tender, seasoning with a little soy sauce and sesame oil. Fry the eggs until the whites are fully set. Assemble over the rice with the pork, vegetables and cucumber, and serve with the gochujang.

Recipe: Smoky Paprika Turkey Pita with Tzatziki
Ingredients: Turkey Breast, Pita Bread, Cucumber, Lettuce, Smoked Paprika, Garlic, Lemon Juice, Olive Oil, Tzatziki
Instructions: Toss the turkey with the smoked paprika, garlic and lemon juice and olive oil. Season the turkey and roast or pan-sear until cooked through (165°F), then slice. Warm the pita bread. Stuff the pita with the turkey, cucumber and lettuce and spoon over the tzatziki.

Recipe: Black Bean Dip with Tortilla Chips and Bell Pepper
Ingredients: Black Beans, Lime Juice, Cumin, Garlic, Tortilla Chips, Bell Pepper
Instructions: Prepare the black beans dip by mashing or blending the ingredients until smooth. Cut the bell pepper and arrange with the tortilla chips. Serve for dipping.

Recipe: Honey Garlic Tofu Rice Bowl with Avocado
Ingredients: Tofu, Brown Rice, Honey, Soy Sauce, Garlic, Ginger, Sesame Seeds, Broccoli, Avocado
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Add the honey, soy sauce, garlic and ginger and simmer until sticky. Steam the broccoli until tender-crisp. Serve over the rice sprinkled with the sesame seeds and avocado.

Recipe: Al Pastor-Style Cod Tacos with Salsa Verde and Red Onion on Flour Tortillas
Ingredients: Cod Fillet, Flour Tortillas, Pineapple, Chili Powder, Cumin, Garlic, Oregano, Salsa Verde, Red Onion, Cilantro
Instructions: Season the cod with the pineapple, chili powder, cumin, garlic and oregano. Cut the cod into chunks and gently cook in a pan until opaque and flaky (145°F). Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the cod and top with salsa verde, red onion and cilantro.

Recipe: Madras-Style Chicken Curry over Basmati Rice
Ingredients: Chicken Thighs, Basmati Rice, Curry Powder, Chili Powder, Tomato Paste, Onion, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking Oil, Coconut Milk
Instructions: Cook the basmati rice according to package directions. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil until soft, then stir in the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the tomato paste and coconut milk and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Return the chicken to the sauce and simmer until heated through, then serve over the rice.

Recipe: Bulgogi-Style Tofu Rice Bowl with Edamame
Ingredients: Tofu, White Rice, Soy Sauce, Brown Sugar, Sesame Oil, Garlic, Ginger, Green Onions, Edamame
Instructions: Marinate the tofu in the soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, garlic and ginger for at least 20 minutes. Cook the white rice according to package directions. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Serve over the rice topped with edamame and green onions.

Recipe: Al Pastor-Style Tilapia Tacos with Salsa Verde and Red Onion
Ingredients: Tilapia Fillet, Corn Tortillas, Pineapple, Chili Powder, Cumin, Garlic, Oregano, Salsa Verde, Red Onion, Cilantro
Instructions: Season the tilapia with the pineapple, chili powder, cumin, garlic and oregano. Cut the tilapia into chunks and gently cook in a pan until opaque and flaky (145°F). Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the tilapia and top with salsa verde, red onion and cilantro.

Recipe: Kung Pao-Style Tempeh Stir-Fry with Cabbage and Carrots
Ingredients: Tempeh, Brown Rice, Cabbage, Carrots, Soy Sauce, Peanuts, Dried Chilies, Rice Vinegar, Garlic, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Cube the tempeh and pan-fry until golden and crisp at the edges, then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the cabbage and carrots for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the tempeh to the pan, add the soy sauce, peanuts, dried chilies, rice vinegar and garlic and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the brown rice.

Recipe: Garlic-Cumin Tilapia Tacos with Lettuce, Cheddar and Salsa on Flour Tortillas
Ingredients: Tilapia Fillet, Flour Tortillas, Garlic, Cumin, Oregano, Lime Juice, Romaine Lettuce, Cheddar Cheese, Salsa
Instructions: Season the tilapia with the garlic, cumin, oregano and lime juice. Cut the tilapia into chunks and gently cook in a pan until opaque and flaky (145°F). Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the tilapia and top with romaine lettuce, cheddar cheese and salsa.

Recipe: Al Pastor-Style Chicken Tacos with Guacamole and Pico de Gallo on Flour Tortillas
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Flour Tortillas, Pineapple, Chili Powder, Cumin, Garlic, Oregano, Guacamole, Pico de Gallo
Instructions: Season the chicken with the pineapple, chili powder, cumin, garlic and oregano. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the chicken and top with guacamole and pico de gallo.

Recipe: Tofu Yakisoba-Style Noodles with Cabbage and Carrots
Ingredients: Tofu, Ramen Noodles, Soy Sauce, Ketchup, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking Oil, Cabbage, Carrots
Instructions: Cook the noodles according to package directions and drain. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides, then set aside. Stir-fry the cabbage and carrots until tender-crisp. Add the noodles, tofu, soy sauce and ketchup and toss until glazed and hot.

Recipe: Madras-Style Chickpea Curry over Brown Rice
Ingredients: Chickpeas, Brown Rice, Curry Powder, Chili Powder, Tomato Paste, Onion, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking Oil, Coconut Milk
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Drain and rinse the chickpeas, then warm them through (or crisp them in a hot pan), then set aside. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil until soft, then stir in the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the tomato paste and coconut milk and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Return the chickpeas to the sauce and simmer until heated through, then serve over the rice.

Recipe: Hearty Lamb Stew with Green Beans
Ingredients: Lamb Leg, Green Beans, Vegetable Broth, Potatoes, Carrots, Onion, Tomato Paste, Thyme, Bay Leaf, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Brown the lamb in the oil in a large pot. Add the onion, carrots and potatoes and cook for 3 minutes. Add the tomato paste, thyme, bay leaf and vegetable broth and simmer until the lamb is tender (about 1 hour for meat, 25 minutes for lentils). Add the green beans for the last 10 minutes.

Recipe: Pork Parmesan-Style Bake with Mixed Greens
Ingredients: Pork Tenderloin, Flour, Eggs, Breadcrumbs, Olive Oil, Marinara Sauce, Mozzarella, Parmesan, Basil, Mixed Greens
Instructions: Slice the pork into even cutlets. Dredge in the flour, dip in the beaten eggs, then coat in the breadcrumbs. Pan-fry in the olive oil until golden (the meat should reach 165°F for turkey, 145°F for pork). Top with the marinara and mozzarella and bake at 400°F until the cheese is bubbling and the meat is cooked through (165°F for turkey). Finish with the parmesan and basil and serve with mixed greens.

Recipe: Coconut Chickpea Curry over Brown Rice
Ingredients: Chickpeas, Brown Rice, Coconut Milk, Curry Powder, Ginger, Garlic, Lime Juice, Onion, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Drain and rinse the chickpeas, then warm them through (or crisp them in a hot pan), then set aside. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil until soft, then stir in the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the coconut milk and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Return the chickpeas to the sauce and simmer until heated through, then serve over the rice.

Recipe: Sheet-Pan Smoky Paprika Cod with Broccoli and Carrots
Ingredients: Cod Fillet, Broccoli, Carrots, Smoked Paprika, Garlic, Olive Oil
Instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the broccoli and carrots with half of the smoked paprika and garlic and olive oil on a sheet pan. Coat the cod with the remaining seasoning and add to the pan. Roast until the protein is cooked through (165°F for poultry, 145°F for pork and fish) and the vegetables are tender and browned.

Recipe: Aloo Gobi with Spinach over Brown Rice
Ingredients: Potatoes, Cauliflower, Onion, Garlic, Ginger, Turmeric, Cumin, Cooking Oil, Brown Rice, Spinach
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger, then add the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the main ingredients, the spinach and a splash of water and simmer until tender and saucy. Serve over the brown rice with cilantro.

Recipe: Banana Peanut Smoothie with Coconut Milk
Ingredients: Coconut Milk, Banana, Peanut Butter
Instructions: Blend the coconut milk, banana and peanut butter with ice until smooth.

Recipe: Italian Chicken and Quinoa Stuffed Peppers
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Quinoa, Bell Pepper, Marinara Sauce, Garlic, Basil, Mozzarella
Instructions: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Mix with the cooked quinoa, marinara, garlic and basil. Stuff into halved bell peppers and top with the mozzarella. Bake at 375°F for 30 minutes until the peppers are tender and the cheese is golden.

Recipe: Tikka Masala-Style Paneer Curry over Basmati Rice
Ingredients: Paneer, Basmati Rice, Crushed Tomatoes, Heavy Cream, Greek Yogurt, Garam Masala, Garlic, Ginger, Onion, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the basmati rice according to package directions. Cube the paneer and pan-fry until golden on all sides, then set aside. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil until soft, then stir in the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the crushed tomatoes, heavy cream and greek yogurt and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Return the paneer to the sauce and simmer until heated through, then serve over the rice.

Recipe: Tabbouleh-Style Salad with Tofu and Mint
Ingredients: Tofu, Bulgur, Tomatoes, Cucumber, Mint, Lemon Juice, Olive Oil, Red Onion
Instructions: Soak the bulgur in hot water until tender, then drain well. Press the tofu, slice it, and pan-fry or bake until golden and firm. Toss the bulgur with the chopped tomatoes, cucumber, red onion and plenty of mint. Dress with the lemon juice and olive oil and top with the tofu.

Recipe: Pineapple Cashew Egg Fried Rice
Ingredients: Eggs, Jasmine Rice, Pineapple, Cashews, Curry Powder, Soy Sauce, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Use day-old cold cooked jasmine rice for the best texture. Scramble the eggs and set aside. Heat the oil in a large pan and stir-fry the aromatics and vegetables for 2 minutes. Add the rice and the curry powder and soy sauce and stir-fry until the rice is hot and lightly toasted. Fold in the egg and eggs and cook until everything is heated through.

Recipe: Panzanella Bread Salad with Tuna and Mozzarella
Ingredients: Bread, Tomatoes, Cucumber, Red Onion, Basil, Olive Oil, Red Wine Vinegar, Mozzarella, Canned Tuna
Instructions: Toast the bread cubes in the oven until crisp. Drain the canned tuna and flake it with a fork. Toss the bread with the tomatoes, cucumber, red onion and basil. Dress with the olive oil and red wine vinegar and top with mozzarella.

Recipe: Primavera Spinach Spaghetti
Ingredients: Spaghetti, Olive Oil, Garlic, Zucchini, Spinach, Parmesan, Lemon Juice
Instructions: Cook the spaghetti according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Saute the garlic and zucchini in the olive oil for 3 minutes. Add the spinach and cook until just tender. Toss with the pasta, lemon juice and a splash of pasta water and top with parmesan.

Recipe: Honey Garlic Shrimp Rice Bowl with Carrots
Ingredients: Shrimp, Brown Rice, Honey, Soy Sauce, Garlic, Ginger, Sesame Seeds, Broccoli, Carrots
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Add the honey, soy sauce, garlic and ginger and simmer until sticky. Steam the broccoli until tender-crisp. Serve over the rice sprinkled with the sesame seeds and carrots.

Recipe: Pesto White Bean Penne
Ingredients: White Beans, Penne, Pesto, Cherry Tomatoes, Olive Oil
Instructions: Cook the penne according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Drain and rinse the white beans, then warm them through in a pan, then set aside. Simmer the pesto, cherry tomatoes and olive oil in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and white bean with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed.

Recipe: Butternut Squash Risotto with Butter
Ingredients: Butternut Squash, Rosemary, Arborio Rice, Onion, Garlic, Olive Oil, Vegetable Broth, Parmesan, Butter
Instructions: Saute the onion and garlic in the olive oil until soft. Add the arborio rice and stir for 1 minute until lightly toasted. Add the warm vegetable broth one ladleful at a time, stirring until each is absorbed (about 20 minutes). Stir in the butternut squash and cook until tender. Stir in the rosemary and cook until tender. Stir in the parmesan and butter and serve immediately.

Recipe: Chicken Vermicelli Bowl with Cucumber and Carrots
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Rice Noodles, Fish Sauce, Lime Juice, Brown Sugar, Garlic, Peanuts, Mint, Cilantro, Cucumber, Carrots
Instructions: Cook the rice noodles, drain, and rinse with cold water. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Whisk the fish sauce, lime juice, brown sugar and garlic into a dressing. Layer the noodles, cucumber, carrots and chicken in a bowl, drizzle with the dressing, and top with the peanuts, mint and cilantro.

Recipe: Bibimbap-Style Chicken Rice Bowl with Cabbage
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Brown Rice, Gochujang, Sesame Oil, Soy Sauce, Spinach, Carrots, Zucchini, Mushrooms, Eggs, Cabbage
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Saute the spinach, carrots, zucchini and mushrooms separately until tender, seasoning with a little soy sauce and sesame oil. Fry the eggs until the whites are fully set. Assemble over the rice with the chicken, vegetables and cabbage, and serve with the gochujang.

Recipe: Sesame Ginger Ham Fried Rice
Ingredients: Ham, Jasmine Rice, Soy Sauce, Sesame Oil, Ginger, Eggs, Green Onions
Instructions: Use day-old cold cooked jasmine rice for the best texture. Dice the ham and warm it through in the pan, then set aside. Heat the oil in a large pan and stir-fry the aromatics and vegetables for 2 minutes. Add the rice and the soy sauce and sesame oil and stir-fry until the rice is hot and lightly toasted. Fold in the ham and eggs and cook until everything is heated through.

Recipe: Tofu Vermicelli Bowl with Mixed Greens and Bean Sprouts
Ingredients: Tofu, Rice Noodles, Fish Sauce, Lime Juice, Brown Sugar, Garlic, Peanuts, Mint, Cilantro, Mixed Greens, Bean Sprouts
Instructions: Cook the rice noodles, drain, and rinse with cold water. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Whisk the fish sauce, lime juice, brown sugar and garlic into a dressing. Layer the noodles, mixed greens, bean sprouts and tofu in a bowl, drizzle with the dressing, and top with the peanuts, mint and cilantro.

Recipe: Chili-Lime Sweet Potato Tacos with Mango Salsa on Flour Tortillas
Ingredients: Sweet Potatoes, Flour Tortillas, Chili Powder, Lime Juice, Garlic, Cumin, Mango, Red Onion, Jalapeno, Cilantro
Instructions: Season the sweet potatoes with the chili powder, lime juice, garlic and cumin. Cube the sweet potatoes and roast at 425°F until tender and caramelized (about 25 minutes). Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the sweet potatoes and top with mango, red onion, jalapeno, lime juice and cilantro.

Recipe: Black Pepper Scallop Stir-Fry with Snow Peas and Carrots
Ingredients: Scallops, Brown Rice, Snow Peas, Carrots, Soy Sauce, Black Pepper, Garlic, Butter, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Sear the scallops for 1 to 2 minutes per side until golden and opaque, then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the snow peas and carrots for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the scallops to the pan, add the soy sauce, black pepper, garlic and butter and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the brown rice.

Recipe: Cumin Coriander Lamb Couscous Bowl with Garlic Yogurt Sauce
Ingredients: Lamb Leg, Couscous, Roasted Red Peppers, Spinach, Cumin, Coriander, Paprika, Garlic, Olive Oil, Garlic Yogurt Sauce
Instructions: Cook the couscous according to package directions. Toss the lamb with the cumin, coriander, paprika and garlic and olive oil. Cut the lamb into bite-sized pieces and sear in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (at least 145°F). Fill the bowls with the couscous, roasted red peppers and spinach. Top with the lamb and drizzle with the garlic yogurt sauce.

Recipe: Waffles with Blueberries and Honey
Ingredients: Flour, Eggs, Milk, Baking Powder, Butter, Blueberries, Honey
Instructions: Whisk the dry ingredients, then the eggs, milk and melted butter, and combine. Cook on a hot griddle until golden on both sides. Top with blueberries and honey.

Recipe: Cumin Coriander Tofu White Rice Bowl with Hummus
Ingredients: Tofu, White Rice, Roasted Red Peppers, Spinach, Cumin, Coriander, Paprika, Garlic, Olive Oil, Hummus
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Toss the tofu with the cumin, coriander, paprika and garlic and olive oil. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Fill the bowls with the white rice, roasted red peppers and spinach. Top with the tofu and drizzle with the hummus.

Recipe: Saag-Style Chickpea Curry over Basmati Rice
Ingredients: Chickpeas, Basmati Rice, Spinach, Onion, Garlic, Ginger, Cumin, Garam Masala, Cooking Oil, Coconut Milk
Instructions: Cook the basmati rice according to package directions. Drain and rinse the chickpeas, then warm them through (or crisp them in a hot pan), then set aside. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil until soft, then stir in the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the spinach and coconut milk and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Return the chickpeas to the sauce and simmer until heated through, then serve over the rice.

Recipe: Chickpea Biryani-Style Rice with Peas
Ingredients: Chickpeas, Basmati Rice, Greek Yogurt, Onion, Garam Masala, Turmeric, Garlic, Ginger, Cilantro, Peas, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Marinate the chickpeas in the yogurt and half the spices for at least 30 minutes. Cook the onion in the oil until deep golden. Drain and rinse the chickpeas, then warm them through (or crisp them in a hot pan). Layer with the partly cooked basmati rice and the peas, cover tightly, and steam on low heat for 15 to 20 minutes. Fluff and top with cilantro.

Recipe: Smoky Paprika Chicken Tacos with Cotija and Pickled Onions
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Corn Tortillas, Smoked Paprika, Garlic, Cumin, Olive Oil, Cotija, Pickled Onions, Cilantro
Instructions: Season the chicken with the smoked paprika, garlic and cumin. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the chicken and top with cotija, pickled onions and cilantro.

Recipe: Smoky Paprika Lamb Gyro with Tahini Lemon Sauce
Ingredients: Ground Lamb, Pita Bread, Tomatoes, Red Onion, Smoked Paprika, Garlic, Lemon Juice, Olive Oil, Tahini
Instructions: Toss the lamb with the smoked paprika, garlic and lemon juice and olive oil. Mix the ground lamb with the spices, shape into patties or a loaf, and cook until browned and cooked through (160°F), then slice. Warm the pita bread. Stuff the pita with the lamb, tomatoes and red onion and spoon over the tahini lemon sauce.

Recipe: Baked Turkey Rigatoni with Mozzarella
Ingredients: Ground Turkey, Rigatoni, Marinara Sauce, Garlic, Basil, Mozzarella, Parmesan
Instructions: Cook the rigatoni until just shy of tender and drain. Brown the ground turkey in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (165°F). Stir the marinara sauce, garlic and basil into the pan. Combine with the pasta and half the mozzarella and transfer to a baking dish. Top with the remaining mozzarella and the parmesan and bake at 375°F for 20 to 25 minutes until bubbling.

Recipe: Tikka Masala-Style Cauliflower Curry over Brown Rice
Ingredients: Cauliflower, Brown Rice, Crushed Tomatoes, Heavy Cream, Greek Yogurt, Garam Masala, Garlic, Ginger, Onion, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Cut the cauliflower into florets and roast or saute until tender and lightly browned, then set aside. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil until soft, then stir in the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the crushed tomatoes, heavy cream and greek yogurt and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Return the cauliflower to the sauce and simmer until heated through, then serve over the rice.

Recipe: Hoisin Tempeh Stir-Fry with Zucchini and Bell Pepper
Ingredients: Tempeh, White Rice, Zucchini, Bell Pepper, Hoisin Sauce, Rice Vinegar, Garlic, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Cube the tempeh and pan-fry until golden and crisp at the edges, then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the zucchini and bell pepper for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the tempeh to the pan, add the hoisin sauce, rice vinegar and garlic and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the white rice.

Recipe: Hot and Sour Pork Soup with Carrots
Ingredients: Pork Tenderloin, Carrots, Soy Sauce, Rice Vinegar, Black Pepper, Cornstarch, Eggs, Mushrooms, Ginger, Vegetable Broth
Instructions: Bring the vegetable broth to a simmer with the ginger and mushrooms. Slice the pork into thin pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (145°F). Stir in the soy sauce and rice vinegar, then thicken with the cornstarch mixed with water. Drizzle in the beaten eggs while stirring slowly to make ribbons. Finish with black pepper and the carrots.

Recipe: Beef Burger with BBQ Sauce and Red Onion
Ingredients: Ground Beef, BBQ Sauce, Red Onion, Lettuce, Burger Bun
Instructions: Shape the ground beef into patties and cook to 160°F. Toast the bun. Assemble with the bbq sauce, red onion and lettuce.

Recipe: Hoisin Shrimp Lettuce Cups with Green Onions
Ingredients: Shrimp, Butter Lettuce, Hoisin Sauce, Water Chestnuts, Green Onions, Garlic, Rice Vinegar, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque, then set aside. Saute the garlic and green onions for 2 minutes. Return the shrimp to the pan with the hoisin sauce, rice vinegar and water chestnuts and cook until glazed. Spoon into the lettuce leaves and top with green onions.

Recipe: Garlic Herb Tofu White Rice Bowl with Roasted Red Pepper Sauce
Ingredients: Tofu, White Rice, Red Onion, Olives, Garlic, Parsley, Thyme, Olive Oil, Roasted Red Peppers
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Toss the tofu with the garlic, parsley and thyme and olive oil. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Fill the bowls with the white rice, red onion and olives. Top with the tofu and drizzle with the roasted red pepper sauce.

Recipe: Garlic Ginger Chicken Stir-Fry with Broccoli and Bell Pepper
Ingredients: Chicken Thighs, White Rice, Broccoli, Bell Pepper, Soy Sauce, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the broccoli and bell pepper for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the chicken to the pan, add the soy sauce, garlic and ginger and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the white rice.

Recipe: Dal Tadka with Lime Juice over Quinoa
Ingredients: Lentils, Onion, Garlic, Ginger, Turmeric, Cumin, Cooking Oil, Cilantro, Quinoa, Lime Juice
Instructions: Cook the quinoa according to package directions. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger, then add the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the main ingredients, the lime juice and a splash of water and simmer until tender and saucy. Serve over the quinoa with cilantro.

Recipe: Garlic-Cumin Cauliflower Tacos with Mango Salsa on Flour Tortillas
Ingredients: Cauliflower, Flour Tortillas, Garlic, Cumin, Oregano, Lime Juice, Mango, Red Onion, Jalapeno, Cilantro
Instructions: Season the cauliflower with the garlic, cumin, oregano and lime juice. Cut the cauliflower into florets and roast or saute until tender and lightly browned. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the cauliflower and top with mango, red onion, jalapeno, lime juice and cilantro.

Recipe: Bulgogi-Style Pork Rice Bowl with Pickled Onions
Ingredients: Pork Tenderloin, White Rice, Soy Sauce, Brown Sugar, Sesame Oil, Garlic, Ginger, Green Onions, Pickled Onions
Instructions: Marinate the pork in the soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, garlic and ginger for at least 20 minutes. Cook the white rice according to package directions. Slice the pork into thin pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (145°F). Serve over the rice topped with pickled onions and green onions.

Recipe: Honey Soy Tofu Stir-Fry with Green Beans and Red Onion
Ingredients: Tofu, Jasmine Rice, Green Beans, Red Onion, Soy Sauce, Honey, Garlic, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the jasmine rice according to package directions. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides, then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the green beans and red onion for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the tofu to the pan, add the soy sauce, honey and garlic and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the jasmine rice.

Recipe: Ham Sandwich with Avocado and Red Onion and Pickles
Ingredients: Ham, Bread, Avocado, Red Onion, Pickles
Instructions: Dice the ham and warm it through in the pan. Toast the bread or warm the tortilla. Spread with the avocado. Layer the ham with the red onion and pickles.

Recipe: Orange Ginger Edamame Stir-Fry with Green Beans and Red Onion
Ingredients: Edamame, White Rice, Green Beans, Red Onion, Orange Juice, Soy Sauce, Ginger, Cornstarch, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Boil or steam the edamame for 4 to 5 minutes until tender, then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the green beans and red onion for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the edamame to the pan, add the orange juice, soy sauce, ginger and cornstarch and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the white rice.

Recipe: Black Beans and Salsa Omelet with Cheddar
Ingredients: Eggs, Black Beans, Salsa, Olive Oil, Cheddar Cheese
Instructions: Saute the black beans and salsa in the oil until tender. Whisk the eggs and pour into the pan. Cook gently, stirring (scramble) or folding (omelet), until the eggs are fully set, adding the cheddar cheese at the end.

Recipe: Mulligatawny-Style Sweet Potato Soup with Spinach
Ingredients: Sweet Potatoes, Vegetable Broth, Lentils, Coconut Milk, Curry Powder, Onion, Garlic, Spinach
Instructions: Saute the onion and garlic with the curry powder. Add the vegetable broth, lentils and spinach and simmer for 25 minutes. Cube the sweet potatoes and roast at 425°F until tender and caramelized (about 25 minutes). Stir in the coconut milk and blend partly for a thick texture.

Recipe: Chicken Taco Salad with Cotija and Salsa
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Romaine Lettuce, Corn, Black Beans, Cherry Tomatoes, Cotija, Tortilla Chips, Taco Seasoning, Salsa
Instructions: Season the chicken with the taco seasoning. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Toss the romaine, corn, black beans and tomatoes in a large bowl. Top with the chicken, cotija and crushed tortilla chips and drizzle with the salsa.

Recipe: Pork Vermicelli Bowl with Cucumber and Mixed Greens
Ingredients: Pork Tenderloin, Rice Noodles, Fish Sauce, Lime Juice, Brown Sugar, Garlic, Peanuts, Mint, Cilantro, Cucumber, Mixed Greens
Instructions: Cook the rice noodles, drain, and rinse with cold water. Slice the pork into thin pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (145°F). Whisk the fish sauce, lime juice, brown sugar and garlic into a dressing. Layer the noodles, cucumber, mixed greens and pork in a bowl, drizzle with the dressing, and top with the peanuts, mint and cilantro.

Recipe: Ham Sub with Dijon and Cheddar
Ingredients: Ham, Hoagie Roll, Dijon Mustard, Cheddar Cheese, Lettuce
Instructions: Dice the ham and warm it through in the pan. Toast the bread or warm the tortilla. Spread with the dijon mustard. Layer the ham with the cheddar cheese and lettuce.

Recipe: Lemon Oregano Shrimp Couscous Bowl with Roasted Red Pepper Sauce
Ingredients: Shrimp, Couscous, Roasted Red Peppers, Spinach, Lemon Juice, Oregano, Garlic, Olive Oil
Instructions: Cook the couscous according to package directions. Toss the shrimp with the lemon juice, oregano and garlic and olive oil. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Fill the bowls with the couscous, roasted red peppers and spinach. Top with the shrimp and drizzle with the roasted red pepper sauce.

Recipe: Kung Pao-Style Chicken Stir-Fry with Bok Choy and Mushrooms
Ingredients: Chicken Thighs, Jasmine Rice, Bok Choy, Mushrooms, Soy Sauce, Peanuts, Dried Chilies, Rice Vinegar, Garlic, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the jasmine rice according to package directions. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the bok choy and mushrooms for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the chicken to the pan, add the soy sauce, peanuts, dried chilies, rice vinegar and garlic and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the jasmine rice.

Recipe: Cumin Coriander Chickpea Pita with Lemon Herb Vinaigrette
Ingredients: Chickpeas, Pita Bread, Cucumber, Lettuce, Cumin, Coriander, Paprika, Garlic, Olive Oil, Lemon Olive Oil Dressing, Parsley
Instructions: Toss the chickpeas with the cumin, coriander, paprika and garlic and olive oil. Mash the chickpeas with the parsley, garlic and spices, shape into patties, and pan-fry until crisp. Warm the pita bread. Stuff the pita with the chickpeas, cucumber and lettuce and spoon over the lemon herb vinaigrette.

Recipe: Lemon Butter Chicken Rigatoni
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Rigatoni, Butter, Lemon Juice, Parsley, Garlic, Parmesan
Instructions: Cook the rigatoni according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Simmer the butter, lemon juice, parsley and garlic in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and chicken with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed, and finish with parmesan.

Recipe: Spiced Chicken Kathi Roll with Tzatziki
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Flour Tortillas, Tzatziki, Red Onion, Cucumber, Cilantro, Garam Masala, Lemon Juice, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Toss the chicken with the garam masala and lemon juice. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Warm the tortillas. Fill with the chicken, red onion, cucumber and cilantro and drizzle with the tzatziki.

Recipe: Garlic Olive Oil Chickpea Fettuccine
Ingredients: Chickpeas, Fettuccine, Olive Oil, Garlic, Chili Flakes, Parsley, Lemon Juice
Instructions: Cook the fettuccine according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Drain and rinse the chickpeas, then warm them through (or crisp them in a hot pan), then set aside. Simmer the olive oil, garlic, chili flakes and parsley in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and chickpea with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed.

Recipe: Turkey and Egg Soup with Green Beans
Ingredients: Turkey Breast, Egg Noodles, Green Beans, Chicken Broth, Onion, Carrots, Celery, Garlic, Thyme, Cooking Oil, Black Pepper
Instructions: Saute the onion, carrots and celery in the oil. Add the chicken broth, garlic and thyme and bring to a simmer. Cut the turkey into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until cooked through (165°F). Add the egg noodles and cook until tender. Stir in the green beans and season with salt and black pepper.

Recipe: Garlic Herb Turkey Quinoa Bowl with Roasted Red Pepper Sauce
