Ingredients: Turkey Breast, Quinoa, Cucumber, Red Onion, Garlic, Parsley, Thyme, Olive Oil, Roasted Red Peppers
Instructions: Cook the quinoa according to package directions. Toss the turkey with the garlic, parsley and thyme and olive oil. Cut the turkey into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until cooked through (165°F). Fill the bowls with the quinoa, cucumber and red onion. Top with the turkey and drizzle with the roasted red pepper sauce.

Recipe: Italian Steak Salad with Parmesan and Croutons on Kale
Ingredients: Flank Steak, Kale, Parmesan, Croutons, Italian Vinaigrette
Instructions: Season the steak and grill or sear to at least 145°F, rest for 5 minutes, then slice against the grain. Toss the kale with the parmesan and croutons. Top with the steak and drizzle with the italian vinaigrette.

Recipe: Taco-Seasoned Sweet Potato Burrito Bowl with Black Beans and Cheddar Cheese
Ingredients: Sweet Potatoes, White Rice, Black Beans, Cheddar Cheese, Taco Seasoning, Tomato Paste, Olive Oil
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Season the sweet potatoes with the taco seasoning and tomato paste. Cube the sweet potatoes and roast at 425°F until tender and caramelized (about 25 minutes). Drain and rinse the black beans, then warm them through in a pan. Build the bowls with the rice, beans, sweet potato and cheddar cheese.

Recipe: Garlic Herb Tofu Quinoa Bowl with Garlic Yogurt Sauce
Ingredients: Tofu, Quinoa, Roasted Red Peppers, Spinach, Garlic, Parsley, Thyme, Olive Oil, Garlic Yogurt Sauce
Instructions: Cook the quinoa according to package directions. Toss the tofu with the garlic, parsley and thyme and olive oil. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Fill the bowls with the quinoa, roasted red peppers and spinach. Top with the tofu and drizzle with the garlic yogurt sauce.

Recipe: Kimchi Ham Fried Rice
Ingredients: Ham, Jasmine Rice, Kimchi, Eggs, Soy Sauce, Sesame Oil, Green Onions
Instructions: Use day-old cold cooked jasmine rice for the best texture. Dice the ham and warm it through in the pan, then set aside. Heat the oil in a large pan and stir-fry the aromatics and vegetables for 2 minutes. Add the rice and the kimchi, soy sauce and sesame oil and stir-fry until the rice is hot and lightly toasted. Fold in the ham and eggs and cook until everything is heated through.

Recipe: Sheet-Pan Italian Herb Pork with Potatoes and Cherry Tomatoes
Ingredients: Pork Tenderloin, Potatoes, Cherry Tomatoes, Olive Oil, Italian Herbs, Garlic, Lemon Juice
Instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the potatoes and cherry tomatoes with the olive oil, Italian herbs, garlic and lemon juice on a sheet pan. Nestle the seasoned pork among the vegetables. Roast until the protein is cooked through (165°F for chicken, 145°F for pork and fish) and the vegetables are tender.

Recipe: Madras-Style Cauliflower Curry over Brown Rice
Ingredients: Cauliflower, Brown Rice, Curry Powder, Chili Powder, Tomato Paste, Onion, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking Oil, Coconut Milk
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Cut the cauliflower into florets and roast or saute until tender and lightly browned, then set aside. Saute the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil until soft, then stir in the spices and cook for 1 minute. Add the tomato paste and coconut milk and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Return the cauliflower to the sauce and simmer until heated through, then serve over the rice.

Recipe: Cauliflower Soup with Croutons
Ingredients: Cauliflower, Onion, Garlic, Vegetable Broth, Heavy Cream, Croutons
Instructions: Saute the aromatics in butter or oil until soft. Add the main vegetables or proteins, then the broth or milk, and simmer until tender. Blend until smooth or leave chunky, depending on the soup. Season to taste and top with croutons.

Recipe: Caesar Tuna Salad with Bell Pepper and Cucumber on Arugula
Ingredients: Canned Tuna, Arugula, Bell Pepper, Cucumber, Caesar Dressing
Instructions: Flake the canned tuna. Toss the arugula with the bell pepper and cucumber. Top with the tuna and drizzle with the caesar dressing.

Recipe: Spicy Basil Beef Noodles with Bell Pepper
Ingredients: Beef Sirloin Strips, Rice Noodles, Soy Sauce, Oyster Sauce, Thai Basil, Dried Chilies, Garlic, Cooking Oil, Bell Pepper, Green Beans
Instructions: Soak the rice noodles in hot water until tender and drain. Sear the beef strips in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (at least 145°F), then set aside. Stir-fry the garlic, chilies, bell pepper and green beans for 2 minutes. Add the noodles, soy sauce, oyster sauce and beef and toss until hot, then fold in the Thai basil.

Recipe: Antipasto Salad with Chicken and Balsamic Dressing
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Mixed Greens, Olives, Roasted Red Peppers, Mozzarella, Chickpeas, Cherry Tomatoes, Balsamic Vinaigrette
Instructions: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Toss the greens, olives, roasted red peppers, mozzarella and tomatoes. Top with the chicken and dress with the balsamic vinaigrette.

Recipe: Lemon Butter Chicken over Brown Rice Pasta
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Brown Rice Pasta, Butter, Lemon Juice, Parsley, Garlic, Parmesan
Instructions: Cook the brown rice pasta according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Simmer the butter, lemon juice, parsley and garlic in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and chicken with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed, and finish with parmesan.

Recipe: Steak Sandwich with Hummus and Bacon
Ingredients: Beef Sirloin Strips, Bread, Hummus, Bacon, Lettuce
Instructions: Season the beef and sear until browned and cooked through (at least 145°F), then slice. Toast the bread or warm the tortilla. Spread with the hummus. Layer the steak with the bacon and lettuce.

Recipe: Smoky Paprika Shrimp Pita with Roasted Red Pepper Sauce
Ingredients: Shrimp, Pita Bread, Red Onion, Lettuce, Smoked Paprika, Garlic, Lemon Juice, Olive Oil, Roasted Red Peppers
Instructions: Toss the shrimp with the smoked paprika, garlic and lemon juice and olive oil. Season the shrimp and cook in a hot pan or on the grill for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Warm the pita bread. Stuff the pita with the shrimp, red onion and lettuce and spoon over the roasted red pepper sauce.

Recipe: Garlic Olive Oil Shrimp Spaghetti
Ingredients: Shrimp, Spaghetti, Olive Oil, Garlic, Chili Flakes, Parsley, Lemon Juice
Instructions: Cook the spaghetti according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque, then set aside. Simmer the olive oil, garlic, chili flakes and parsley in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and shrimp with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed.

Recipe: Black Bean Enchiladas with Cheddar and Chipotle Peppers in Adobo
Ingredients: Black Beans, Corn Tortillas, Cheddar Cheese, Crushed Tomatoes, Chili Powder, Cumin, Garlic, Onion, Chipotle Peppers in Adobo
Instructions: Drain and rinse the black beans, then warm them through in a pan. Simmer the crushed tomatoes with the chili powder, cumin, garlic and onion for 10 minutes to make a flour-free sauce. Fill the corn tortillas with the black beans and some of the cheddar cheese, roll, and place seam-side down in a baking dish. Pour the sauce over the top, sprinkle with the remaining cheese, and bake at 375°F for 20 minutes until bubbly.

Recipe: Beef Taco Salad with Cotija and Avocado Lime Dressing
Ingredients: Ground Beef, Romaine Lettuce, Corn, Black Beans, Cherry Tomatoes, Cotija, Tortilla Chips, Taco Seasoning, Avocado Lime Dressing
Instructions: Season the beef with the taco seasoning. Brown the ground beef in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (160°F). Toss the romaine, corn, black beans and tomatoes in a large bowl. Top with the beef, cotija and crushed tortilla chips and drizzle with the avocado lime dressing.

Recipe: Turkey Taco Salad with Cheddar and Lime Crema
Ingredients: Ground Turkey, Romaine Lettuce, Corn, Black Beans, Cherry Tomatoes, Cheddar Cheese, Tortilla Chips, Taco Seasoning, Lime Crema
Instructions: Season the turkey with the taco seasoning. Brown the ground turkey in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (165°F). Toss the romaine, corn, black beans and tomatoes in a large bowl. Top with the turkey, cheddar cheese and crushed tortilla chips and drizzle with the lime crema.

Recipe: Shrimp Fresh Spring Rolls with Cilantro and Cucumber
Ingredients: Shrimp, Rice Paper Wrappers, Rice Noodles, Mixed Greens, Cucumber, Cilantro, Peanut Dipping Sauce
Instructions: Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque, then slice thinly. Soak the rice paper wrappers one at a time in warm water until pliable. Layer each wrapper with the rice noodles, mixed greens, cucumber, cilantro and the shrimp. Fold in the sides and roll tightly. Serve with the peanut dipping sauce.

Recipe: Sesame Ginger Steak Salad with Feta Cheese and Sunflower Seeds on Arugula
Ingredients: Flank Steak, Arugula, Feta Cheese, Sunflower Seeds, Sesame Ginger Dressing
Instructions: Season the steak and grill or sear to at least 145°F, rest for 5 minutes, then slice against the grain. Toss the arugula with the feta cheese and sunflower seeds. Top with the steak and drizzle with the sesame ginger dressing.

Recipe: Ham Breakfast Burrito with Monterey
Ingredients: Ham, Eggs, Flour Tortillas, Potatoes, Salsa, Monterey Jack Cheese
Instructions: Dice the ham and warm it through in the pan. Cook the diced potatoes until crisp. Scramble the eggs until just set. Fill a warm tortilla with the eggs, ham, potatoes and monterey jack cheese, then roll up and serve with salsa.

Recipe: Pork Ramen Bowl with Mushrooms
Ingredients: Pork Tenderloin, Ramen Noodles, Vegetable Broth, Miso Paste, Soy Sauce, Ginger, Garlic, Soft-Boiled Egg, Green Onions, Nori, Mushrooms, Bok Choy
Instructions: Simmer the vegetable broth with the ginger and garlic, then whisk in the miso and soy sauce (do not boil after adding the miso). Cook the ramen noodles separately and drain. Slice the pork into thin pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (145°F). Divide the noodles and broth between bowls and top with the pork, mushrooms, bok choy, soft-boiled egg, green onions and nori.

Recipe: Honey Garlic Tofu Rice Bowl with Green Onions
Ingredients: Tofu, Jasmine Rice, Honey, Soy Sauce, Garlic, Ginger, Sesame Seeds, Broccoli, Green Onions
Instructions: Cook the jasmine rice according to package directions. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Add the honey, soy sauce, garlic and ginger and simmer until sticky. Steam the broccoli until tender-crisp. Serve over the rice sprinkled with the sesame seeds and green onions.

Recipe: Dates Pecans Oatmeal with Milk
Ingredients: Rolled Oats, Milk, Dates, Pecans, Maple Syrup
Instructions: Simmer the oats in the milk for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring, until creamy. Top with the dates, pecans and maple syrup.

Recipe: Shrimp and Spinach Quesadilla with Cheddar
Ingredients: Shrimp, Flour Tortillas, Cheddar Cheese, Spinach, Onion, Salsa
Instructions: Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Saute the spinach and onion until soft. Fill half of each flour tortilla with the shrimp, vegetables and cheddar cheese, then fold over. Cook in a dry pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until crisp and the cheese melts. Serve with salsa.

Recipe: Puttanesca-Style Tuna Rigatoni
Ingredients: Tuna Steak, Rigatoni, Crushed Tomatoes, Olives, Capers, Anchovy Fillets, Garlic, Chili Flakes
Instructions: Cook the rigatoni according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Sear the tuna on all sides until cooked through (145°F), then cut into cubes, then set aside. Simmer the crushed tomatoes, olives, capers and anchovy fillets in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and tuna with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed.

Recipe: Al Pastor-Style Turkey Tacos with Mango Salsa on Flour Tortillas
Ingredients: Ground Turkey, Flour Tortillas, Pineapple, Chili Powder, Cumin, Garlic, Oregano, Mango, Red Onion, Jalapeno, Lime Juice, Cilantro
Instructions: Season the turkey with the pineapple, chili powder, cumin, garlic and oregano. Brown the ground turkey in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (165°F). Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the turkey and top with mango, red onion, jalapeno, lime juice and cilantro.

Recipe: Bibimbap-Style Chicken Rice Bowl with Avocado
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, White Rice, Gochujang, Sesame Oil, Soy Sauce, Spinach, Carrots, Zucchini, Mushrooms, Eggs, Avocado
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Saute the spinach, carrots, zucchini and mushrooms separately until tender, seasoning with a little soy sauce and sesame oil. Fry the eggs until the whites are fully set. Assemble over the rice with the chicken, vegetables and avocado, and serve with the gochujang.

Recipe: Sizzling Shrimp Fajitas with Pico de Gallo (Corn Tortillas)
Ingredients: Shrimp, Corn Tortillas, Bell Pepper, Onion, Chili Powder, Cumin, Garlic, Lime Juice, Pico de Gallo, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Toss the shrimp with the chili powder, cumin, garlic and lime juice. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Cook the bell pepper and onion in a very hot pan until charred at the edges. Serve the shrimp and vegetables with the warm tortillas and pico de gallo.

Recipe: Shrimp Udon Stir-Fry with Carrots and Green Onions
Ingredients: Shrimp, Udon Noodles, Soy Sauce, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking Oil, Carrots, Green Onions
Instructions: Cook the udon noodles according to package directions and drain. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque, then set aside. Stir-fry the carrots and green onions with the garlic and ginger until tender-crisp. Add the noodles, soy sauce and shrimp and toss until heated through.

Recipe: Tabbouleh-Style Salad with Chicken and Parsley
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Bulgur, Tomatoes, Cucumber, Parsley, Lemon Juice, Olive Oil, Red Onion
Instructions: Soak the bulgur in hot water until tender, then drain well. Season the chicken and grill or pan-sear until cooked through (165°F), then slice. Toss the bulgur with the chopped tomatoes, cucumber, red onion and plenty of parsley. Dress with the lemon juice and olive oil and top with the chicken.

Recipe: Hoisin Chicken Lettuce Cups with Bell Pepper
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Butter Lettuce, Hoisin Sauce, Water Chestnuts, Green Onions, Garlic, Rice Vinegar, Bell Pepper, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Saute the garlic and bell pepper for 2 minutes. Return the chicken to the pan with the hoisin sauce, rice vinegar and water chestnuts and cook until glazed. Spoon into the lettuce leaves and top with green onions.

Recipe: Garlic Herb Lamb Couscous Bowl with Garlic Yogurt Sauce
Ingredients: Lamb Leg, Couscous, Roasted Red Peppers, Spinach, Garlic, Parsley, Thyme, Olive Oil, Garlic Yogurt Sauce
Instructions: Cook the couscous according to package directions. Toss the lamb with the garlic, parsley and thyme and olive oil. Cut the lamb into bite-sized pieces and sear in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (at least 145°F). Fill the bowls with the couscous, roasted red peppers and spinach. Top with the lamb and drizzle with the garlic yogurt sauce.

Recipe: Chicken Tortilla Soup with Pico de Gallo
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Chicken Broth, Corn Tortillas, Diced Tomatoes, Onion, Garlic, Cumin, Chili Powder, Lime Juice, Cilantro, Pico de Gallo
Instructions: Bake or toast the corn tortilla strips until crisp. Saute the onion and garlic, then add the cumin, chili powder and diced tomatoes. Add the chicken broth and simmer for 15 minutes. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Ladle into bowls and top with the tortilla strips, pico de gallo, cilantro and lime juice.

Recipe: Lemon Herb Breadcrumb Baked Salmon with Broccoli
Ingredients: Salmon Fillet, Broccoli, Breadcrumbs, Lemon Juice, Parsley, Olive Oil
Instructions: Heat the oven to 400°F. Brush the salmon with the mustard or oil and press the crust mixture on top. Bake until opaque and flaky (145°F) and serve with broccoli.

Recipe: Beef Taco Salad with Cotija and Lime Crema
Ingredients: Ground Beef, Romaine Lettuce, Corn, Black Beans, Cherry Tomatoes, Cotija, Tortilla Chips, Taco Seasoning, Lime Crema
Instructions: Season the beef with the taco seasoning. Brown the ground beef in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (160°F). Toss the romaine, corn, black beans and tomatoes in a large bowl. Top with the beef, cotija and crushed tortilla chips and drizzle with the lime crema.

Recipe: Pozole-Style Pork Stew with Cilantro
Ingredients: Pork Shoulder, Vegetable Broth, Hominy, Chili Powder, Garlic, Onion, Oregano, Lime Juice, Cilantro
Instructions: Saute the onion and garlic with the chili powder and oregano. Add the vegetable broth and hominy. Braise or slow-cook the pork until very tender (at least 145°F, ideally much longer for shredding), then shred it. Simmer until the flavors come together, about 30 minutes. Serve with lime juice and cilantro.

Recipe: Bibimbap-Style Beef Rice Bowl with Cabbage
Ingredients: Beef Sirloin Strips, Jasmine Rice, Gochujang, Sesame Oil, Soy Sauce, Spinach, Carrots, Zucchini, Mushrooms, Eggs, Cabbage
Instructions: Cook the jasmine rice according to package directions. Sear the beef strips in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (at least 145°F). Saute the spinach, carrots, zucchini and mushrooms separately until tender, seasoning with a little soy sauce and sesame oil. Fry the eggs until the whites are fully set. Assemble over the rice with the beef, vegetables and cabbage, and serve with the gochujang.

Recipe: Chipotle Cod Tacos with Cabbage Slaw and Lime Crema
Ingredients: Cod Fillet, Corn Tortillas, Chipotle Peppers in Adobo, Garlic, Cumin, Lime Juice, Coleslaw Mix, Lime Crema, Cilantro
Instructions: Season the cod with the chipotle peppers in adobo, garlic, cumin and lime juice. Cut the cod into chunks and gently cook in a pan until opaque and flaky (145°F). Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the cod and top with coleslaw mix, lime crema, cilantro and lime juice.

Recipe: Egg Drop Soup with Chicken and Corn
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Corn, Eggs, Cornstarch, Green Onions, Ginger, Soy Sauce, Chicken Broth
Instructions: Bring the chicken broth to a simmer with the ginger and soy sauce. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Add the corn and thicken lightly with cornstarch mixed with water. Drizzle in the beaten eggs while stirring to make ribbons and top with green onions.

Recipe: Dan Dan-Style Beef Noodles
Ingredients: Ground Beef, Udon Noodles, Tahini, Soy Sauce, Chili Flakes, Peanuts, Garlic, Rice Vinegar, Cooking Oil, Bok Choy, Green Onions
Instructions: Cook the noodles and drain. Brown the ground beef in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (160°F). Stir in the garlic and chili flakes and cook for 1 minute. Whisk the tahini, soy sauce and rice vinegar into a sauce, toss with the noodles and beef, and top with the peanuts and bok choy.

Recipe: Strawberries Sliced Almonds Oatmeal with Soy Milk
Ingredients: Rolled Oats, Soy Milk, Strawberries, Sliced Almonds, Maple Syrup
Instructions: Simmer the oats in the soy milk for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring, until creamy. Top with the strawberries, sliced almonds and maple syrup.

Recipe: Lemon Oregano Lamb Kofta White Rice Bowl with Hummus
Ingredients: Ground Lamb, White Rice, Cucumber, Red Onion, Lemon Juice, Oregano, Garlic, Olive Oil, Hummus
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Toss the lamb kofta with the lemon juice, oregano and garlic and olive oil. Mix the ground lamb with the marinade ingredients, shape into small oval patties, and cook until browned and cooked through (160°F). Fill the bowls with the white rice, cucumber and red onion. Top with the lamb kofta and drizzle with the hummus.

Recipe: Black Pepper Steak Stir-Fry with Zucchini and Bell Pepper
Ingredients: Flank Steak, White Rice, Zucchini, Bell Pepper, Soy Sauce, Black Pepper, Garlic, Butter, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Slice the steak thinly against the grain and sear in a hot pan until browned (at least 145°F), then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the zucchini and bell pepper for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the steak to the pan, add the soy sauce, black pepper, garlic and butter and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the white rice.

Recipe: Spiced Chickpea Kathi Roll with Tzatziki
Ingredients: Chickpeas, Flour Tortillas, Tzatziki, Red Onion, Cucumber, Cilantro, Garam Masala, Lemon Juice, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Toss the chickpeas with the garam masala and lemon juice. Drain and rinse the chickpeas, then warm them through (or crisp them in a hot pan). Warm the tortillas. Fill with the chickpeas, red onion, cucumber and cilantro and drizzle with the tzatziki.

Recipe: Mixed Berries Whey Smoothie with Milk
Ingredients: Milk, Mixed Berries, Whey Protein Powder
Instructions: Blend the milk, mixed berries and whey protein powder with ice until smooth.

Recipe: Stuffed Sweet Potato with Chicken and Greek Yogurt
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Sweet Potatoes, Greek Yogurt, Olive Oil
Instructions: Bake the sweet potatoes at 400°F until very tender (45 to 60 minutes). Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Split the potatoes and fill with the chicken. Top with greek yogurt.

Recipe: Chickpea Biryani-Style Rice with Cashews
Ingredients: Chickpeas, Basmati Rice, Greek Yogurt, Onion, Garam Masala, Turmeric, Garlic, Ginger, Cilantro, Cashews, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Marinate the chickpeas in the yogurt and half the spices for at least 30 minutes. Cook the onion in the oil until deep golden. Drain and rinse the chickpeas, then warm them through (or crisp them in a hot pan). Layer with the partly cooked basmati rice and the cashews, cover tightly, and steam on low heat for 15 to 20 minutes. Fluff and top with cilantro.

Recipe: Sheet-Pan BBQ Chickpea with Broccoli and Carrots
Ingredients: Chickpeas, Broccoli, Carrots, BBQ Sauce, Olive Oil
Instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the broccoli and carrots with half of the bbq sauce and olive oil on a sheet pan. Coat the chickpeas with the remaining seasoning and add to the pan. Roast until the protein is cooked through (165°F for poultry, 145°F for pork and fish) and the vegetables are tender and browned.

Recipe: Smoky Black Bean Soup with Spinach
Ingredients: Black Beans, Spinach, Vegetable Broth, Onion, Garlic, Cumin, Chili Powder, Lime Juice, Cilantro
Instructions: Saute the onion and garlic with the cumin and chili powder. Add the black beans, spinach and vegetable broth. Simmer for 20 minutes, then partly blend for a thick texture. Finish with lime juice and cilantro.

Recipe: Pesto Salmon Fettuccine
Ingredients: Salmon Fillet, Fettuccine, Pesto, Cherry Tomatoes, Olive Oil
Instructions: Cook the fettuccine according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Cut the salmon into chunks and gently cook in a pan until opaque and flaky (145°F), then set aside. Simmer the pesto, cherry tomatoes and olive oil in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and salmon with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed.

Recipe: Orange Ginger Beef Stir-Fry with Asparagus and Mushrooms
Ingredients: Beef Sirloin Strips, Jasmine Rice, Asparagus, Mushrooms, Orange Juice, Soy Sauce, Ginger, Cornstarch, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the jasmine rice according to package directions. Sear the beef strips in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (at least 145°F), then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the asparagus and mushrooms for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the beef to the pan, add the orange juice, soy sauce, ginger and cornstarch and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the jasmine rice.

Recipe: Smoky Paprika Tofu Tacos with Mango Salsa
Ingredients: Tofu, Corn Tortillas, Smoked Paprika, Garlic, Cumin, Olive Oil, Mango, Red Onion, Jalapeno, Lime Juice, Cilantro
Instructions: Season the tofu with the smoked paprika, garlic and cumin. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the tofu and top with mango, red onion, jalapeno, lime juice and cilantro.

Recipe: Chili-Lime Black Bean Tacos with Cabbage Slaw and Lime Crema
Ingredients: Black Beans, Corn Tortillas, Chili Powder, Lime Juice, Garlic, Cumin, Coleslaw Mix, Lime Crema, Cilantro
Instructions: Season the black beans with the chili powder, lime juice, garlic and cumin. Drain and rinse the black beans, then warm them through in a pan. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the black beans and top with coleslaw mix, lime crema, cilantro and lime juice.

Recipe: Sesame Peanut Tofu Noodles with Green Onions and Cabbage
Ingredients: Tofu, Soba Noodles, Peanut Butter, Soy Sauce, Sesame Oil, Rice Vinegar, Garlic, Lime Juice, Green Onions, Cabbage
Instructions: Cook the soba noodles, drain, and rinse under cold water. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, garlic and lime juice with a splash of warm water until smooth. Toss the noodles with the sauce, the green onions and the cabbage, then top with the tofu.

Recipe: Egg Salad Sub with Red Onion and Pickles
Ingredients: Eggs, Mayonnaise, Celery, Mustard, Hoagie Roll, Red Onion, Pickles
Instructions: Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool, and chop. Mix with the mayonnaise, celery and mustard. Fill the bread with the egg salad and red onion and pickles.

Recipe: Tofu Vermicelli Bowl with Cucumber and Carrots
Ingredients: Tofu, Rice Noodles, Fish Sauce, Lime Juice, Brown Sugar, Garlic, Peanuts, Mint, Cilantro, Cucumber, Carrots
Instructions: Cook the rice noodles, drain, and rinse with cold water. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Whisk the fish sauce, lime juice, brown sugar and garlic into a dressing. Layer the noodles, cucumber, carrots and tofu in a bowl, drizzle with the dressing, and top with the peanuts, mint and cilantro.

Recipe: Mango and Almond Butter Snack with Cinnamon
Ingredients: Mango, Almond Butter, Cinnamon
Instructions: Slice the mango. Spread or dip with the almond butter. Sprinkle with cinnamon.

Recipe: Sheet-Pan Garlic Parmesan Shrimp with Sweet Potatoes and Brussels Sprouts
Ingredients: Shrimp, Sweet Potatoes, Brussels Sprouts, Parmesan, Garlic, Olive Oil
Instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the sweet potatoes and brussels sprouts with half of the parmesan and garlic and olive oil on a sheet pan. Coat the shrimp with the remaining seasoning and add to the pan. Roast until the protein is cooked through (165°F for poultry, 145°F for pork and fish) and the vegetables are tender and browned.

Recipe: Avocado Lime Shrimp Salad with Avocado and Red Onion on Spinach
Ingredients: Shrimp, Spinach, Avocado, Red Onion, Avocado Lime Dressing
Instructions: Season the shrimp and cook in a hot pan or on the grill for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Toss the spinach with the avocado and red onion. Top with the shrimp and drizzle with the avocado lime dressing.

Recipe: Honey Garlic Salmon Rice Bowl with Cabbage
Ingredients: Salmon Fillet, White Rice, Honey, Soy Sauce, Garlic, Ginger, Sesame Seeds, Broccoli, Cabbage
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Cut the salmon into chunks and gently cook in a pan until opaque and flaky (145°F). Add the honey, soy sauce, garlic and ginger and simmer until sticky. Steam the broccoli until tender-crisp. Serve over the rice sprinkled with the sesame seeds and cabbage.

Recipe: Tofu Taco Salad with Cheddar and Avocado Lime Dressing
Ingredients: Tofu, Romaine Lettuce, Corn, Black Beans, Cherry Tomatoes, Cheddar Cheese, Tortilla Chips, Taco Seasoning, Avocado Lime Dressing
Instructions: Season the tofu with the taco seasoning. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Toss the romaine, corn, black beans and tomatoes in a large bowl. Top with the tofu, cheddar cheese and crushed tortilla chips and drizzle with the avocado lime dressing.

Recipe: Sheet-Pan Honey Dijon Cod with Sweet Potatoes and Brussels Sprouts
Ingredients: Cod Fillet, Sweet Potatoes, Brussels Sprouts, Dijon Mustard, Honey, Garlic, Olive Oil
Instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the sweet potatoes and brussels sprouts with half of the dijon mustard, honey and garlic and olive oil on a sheet pan. Coat the cod with the remaining seasoning and add to the pan. Roast until the protein is cooked through (165°F for poultry, 145°F for pork and fish) and the vegetables are tender and browned.

Recipe: Spiced Paneer Kathi Roll with Garlic
Ingredients: Paneer, Flour Tortillas, Garlic Yogurt Sauce, Red Onion, Cucumber, Cilantro, Garam Masala, Lemon Juice, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Toss the paneer with the garam masala and lemon juice. Cube the paneer and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Warm the tortillas. Fill with the paneer, red onion, cucumber and cilantro and drizzle with the garlic yogurt sauce.

Recipe: Hot and Sour Tofu Soup with Bok Choy
Ingredients: Tofu, Bok Choy, Soy Sauce, Rice Vinegar, Black Pepper, Cornstarch, Eggs, Mushrooms, Ginger, Vegetable Broth
Instructions: Bring the vegetable broth to a simmer with the ginger and mushrooms. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Stir in the soy sauce and rice vinegar, then thicken with the cornstarch mixed with water. Drizzle in the beaten eggs while stirring slowly to make ribbons. Finish with black pepper and the bok choy.

Recipe: Pesto Portobello Rigatoni
Ingredients: Portobello Mushrooms, Rigatoni, Pesto, Cherry Tomatoes, Olive Oil
Instructions: Cook the rigatoni according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Slice the mushrooms and saute until browned and tender, then set aside. Simmer the pesto, cherry tomatoes and olive oil in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and portobello with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed.

Recipe: Portobello and Bell Pepper Quesadilla with Cheddar
Ingredients: Portobello Mushrooms, Flour Tortillas, Cheddar Cheese, Bell Pepper, Onion, Salsa
Instructions: Slice the mushrooms and saute until browned and tender. Saute the bell pepper and onion until soft. Fill half of each flour tortilla with the portobello, vegetables and cheddar cheese, then fold over. Cook in a dry pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until crisp and the cheese melts. Serve with salsa.

Recipe: Greek Salad with Halloumi (No Cheese)
Ingredients: Halloumi, Cucumber, Tomatoes, Red Onion, Olives, Olive Oil, Oregano, Red Wine Vinegar, Romaine Lettuce
Instructions: Slice the halloumi and grill or pan-fry until golden on both sides. Chop the cucumber, tomatoes and red onion and toss with the romaine and olives. Whisk the olive oil, oregano and red wine vinegar and dress the salad. Top with the halloumi.

Recipe: Italian Beef and Quinoa Stuffed Peppers
Ingredients: Ground Beef, Quinoa, Bell Pepper, Marinara Sauce, Garlic, Basil, Mozzarella
Instructions: Brown the ground beef in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (160°F). Mix with the cooked quinoa, marinara, garlic and basil. Stuff into halved bell peppers and top with the mozzarella. Bake at 375°F for 30 minutes until the peppers are tender and the cheese is golden.

Recipe: Spicy Gochujang Tempeh Stir-Fry with Broccoli and Bell Pepper
Ingredients: Tempeh, Jasmine Rice, Broccoli, Bell Pepper, Gochujang, Soy Sauce, Garlic, Sesame Oil, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the jasmine rice according to package directions. Cube the tempeh and pan-fry until golden and crisp at the edges, then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the broccoli and bell pepper for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the tempeh to the pan, add the gochujang, soy sauce, garlic and sesame oil and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the jasmine rice.

Recipe: Salsa Verde Turkey Burrito Bowl with Pinto Beans and Cheddar Cheese
Ingredients: Ground Turkey, Brown Rice, Pinto Beans, Cheddar Cheese, Salsa Verde, Cilantro, Lime Juice
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Season the turkey with the salsa verde, cilantro and lime juice. Brown the ground turkey in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (165°F). Drain and rinse the pinto beans, then warm them through in a pan. Build the bowls with the rice, beans, turkey and cheddar cheese.

Recipe: Thai Basil Chicken Stir-Fry with Snow Peas and Carrots
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, White Rice, Snow Peas, Carrots, Fish Sauce, Oyster Sauce, Thai Basil, Dried Chilies, Garlic, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the snow peas and carrots for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the chicken to the pan, add the fish sauce, oyster sauce, thai basil, dried chilies and garlic and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the white rice.

Recipe: Italian Chicken Salad with Carrots and Corn on Arugula
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Arugula, Carrots, Corn, Italian Vinaigrette
Instructions: Season the chicken and grill or pan-sear until cooked through (165°F), then slice. Toss the arugula with the carrots and corn. Top with the chicken and drizzle with the italian vinaigrette.

Recipe: Coconut Lime Shrimp Soup with Spinach
Ingredients: Shrimp, Spinach, Coconut Milk, Fish Sauce, Lemongrass, Ginger, Lime Juice, Mushrooms, Cilantro, Vegetable Broth
Instructions: Simmer the vegetable broth with the lemongrass and ginger for 10 minutes. Add the coconut milk, mushrooms and spinach. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Season with the fish sauce and lime juice and finish with cilantro.

Recipe: Sheet-Pan Honey Dijon Cauliflower with Zucchini and Bell Pepper
Ingredients: Cauliflower, Zucchini, Bell Pepper, Dijon Mustard, Honey, Garlic, Olive Oil
Instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the zucchini and bell pepper with half of the dijon mustard, honey and garlic and olive oil on a sheet pan. Coat the cauliflower with the remaining seasoning and add to the pan. Roast until the protein is cooked through (165°F for poultry, 145°F for pork and fish) and the vegetables are tender and browned.

Recipe: Turkey Breakfast Hash with Kale and Onion
Ingredients: Ground Turkey, Potatoes, Eggs, Kale, Onion, Olive Oil
Instructions: Cook the diced potatoes in the oil until golden. Brown the ground turkey in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (165°F). Add the kale and onion and cook until tender. Make wells and crack in the eggs, then cover and cook until the whites are fully set.

Recipe: Tofu Lo Mein with Cabbage and Carrots
Ingredients: Tofu, Egg Noodles, Soy Sauce, Sesame Oil, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking Oil, Cabbage, Carrots
Instructions: Cook the noodles, drain, and toss with a little oil. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides, then set aside. Stir-fry the cabbage and carrots until tender-crisp. Add the noodles and the soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic and ginger, return the tofu, and toss until everything is coated and hot.

Recipe: Puttanesca-Style Tuna Linguine
Ingredients: Tuna Steak, Linguine, Crushed Tomatoes, Olives, Capers, Anchovy Fillets, Garlic, Chili Flakes
Instructions: Cook the linguine according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Sear the tuna on all sides until cooked through (145°F), then cut into cubes, then set aside. Simmer the crushed tomatoes, olives, capers and anchovy fillets in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and tuna with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed.

Recipe: Thai Coconut-Lime Tofu Rice Bowl with Edamame
Ingredients: Tofu, Brown Rice, Coconut Milk, Fish Sauce, Lime Juice, Cilantro, Bell Pepper, Peanuts, Edamame
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Add the coconut milk, fish sauce and lime juice and simmer for 5 minutes. Stir in the bell pepper and cook until just tender. Serve over the rice topped with the peanuts, cilantro and edamame.

Recipe: Teriyaki Shrimp Rice Bowl with Mango
Ingredients: Shrimp, White Rice, Teriyaki Sauce, Garlic, Ginger, Broccoli, Carrots, Green Onions, Mango
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Add the teriyaki sauce, garlic and ginger and simmer until glazed. Steam the broccoli and carrots until tender-crisp. Serve over the rice with mango.

Recipe: Spiced Tofu Kathi Roll with Garlic
Ingredients: Tofu, Flour Tortillas, Garlic Yogurt Sauce, Red Onion, Cucumber, Cilantro, Garam Masala, Lemon Juice, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Toss the tofu with the garam masala and lemon juice. Press the tofu, cube it, and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Warm the tortillas. Fill with the tofu, red onion, cucumber and cilantro and drizzle with the garlic yogurt sauce.

Recipe: Thai Basil Pork Stir-Fry with Broccoli and Carrots
Ingredients: Pork Tenderloin, Brown Rice, Broccoli, Carrots, Fish Sauce, Oyster Sauce, Thai Basil, Dried Chilies, Garlic, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Slice the pork into thin pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (145°F), then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the broccoli and carrots for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the pork to the pan, add the fish sauce, oyster sauce, thai basil, dried chilies and garlic and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the brown rice.

Recipe: Banh Mi-Style Pork Sandwich with Mint
Ingredients: Pork Tenderloin, Hoagie Roll, Mayonnaise, Soy Sauce, Garlic, Carrots, Cucumber, Mint, Rice Vinegar
Instructions: Marinate the pork in soy sauce and garlic for at least 15 minutes. Slice the pork into thin pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (145°F). Toast the hoagie roll and spread with the mayonnaise. Fill with the pork, quick-pickled carrots, cucumber and mint.

Recipe: Eggplant Parmesan-Style Bake with Zucchini
Ingredients: Eggplant, Flour, Eggs, Breadcrumbs, Olive Oil, Marinara Sauce, Mozzarella, Parmesan, Basil, Zucchini
Instructions: Slice the eggplant into 1/2-inch rounds. Dredge in the flour, dip in the beaten eggs, then coat in the breadcrumbs. Pan-fry in the olive oil until golden. Top with the marinara and mozzarella and bake at 400°F until tender and bubbling. Finish with the parmesan and basil and serve with zucchini.

Recipe: Baked Pork Rigatoni with Ricotta
Ingredients: Ground Pork, Rigatoni, Marinara Sauce, Garlic, Basil, Ricotta, Parmesan, Mozzarella
Instructions: Cook the rigatoni until just shy of tender and drain. Brown the ground pork in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (160°F). Stir the marinara sauce, garlic and basil into the pan. Combine with the pasta and half the ricotta and transfer to a baking dish. Top with the remaining ricotta and the parmesan and bake at 375°F for 20 to 25 minutes until bubbling.

Recipe: Lemon Olive Oil Tuna Salad with Strawberries and Pecans on Mixed Greens
Ingredients: Canned Tuna, Mixed Greens, Strawberries, Pecans, Lemon Olive Oil Dressing
Instructions: Flake the canned tuna. Toss the mixed greens with the strawberries and pecans. Top with the tuna and drizzle with the lemon olive oil dressing.

Recipe: Black Bean Tortilla Soup with Pico de Gallo
Ingredients: Black Beans, Vegetable Broth, Corn Tortillas, Diced Tomatoes, Onion, Garlic, Cumin, Chili Powder, Lime Juice, Cilantro, Pico de Gallo
Instructions: Bake or toast the corn tortilla strips until crisp. Saute the onion and garlic, then add the cumin, chili powder and diced tomatoes. Add the vegetable broth and simmer for 15 minutes. Drain and rinse the black beans, then warm them through in a pan. Ladle into bowls and top with the tortilla strips, pico de gallo, cilantro and lime juice.

Recipe: Paneer Biryani-Style Rice with Peas
Ingredients: Paneer, Basmati Rice, Greek Yogurt, Onion, Garam Masala, Turmeric, Garlic, Ginger, Cilantro, Peas, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Marinate the paneer in the yogurt and half the spices for at least 30 minutes. Cook the onion in the oil until deep golden. Cube the paneer and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Layer with the partly cooked basmati rice and the peas, cover tightly, and steam on low heat for 15 to 20 minutes. Fluff and top with cilantro.

Recipe: Garlic Chicken Fried Rice (Brown Rice)
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Brown Rice, Eggs, Soy Sauce, Garlic, Green Onions, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Use day-old cold cooked brown rice for the best texture. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Heat the oil in a large pan and stir-fry the aromatics and vegetables for 2 minutes. Add the rice and the soy sauce and stir-fry until the rice is hot and lightly toasted. Fold in the chicken and eggs and cook until everything is heated through.

Recipe: Chipotle Steak Burrito Bowl with Black Beans and Cheddar Cheese
Ingredients: Flank Steak, White Rice, Black Beans, Cheddar Cheese, Chipotle Peppers in Adobo, Garlic, Lime Juice, Olive Oil
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Season the steak with the chipotle peppers in adobo, garlic and lime juice. Slice the steak thinly against the grain and sear in a hot pan until browned (at least 145°F). Drain and rinse the black beans, then warm them through in a pan. Build the bowls with the rice, beans, steak and cheddar cheese.

Recipe: Poke-Style Tuna Rice Bowl with Carrots
Ingredients: Tuna Steak, Jasmine Rice, Soy Sauce, Sesame Oil, Sesame Seeds, Rice Vinegar, Avocado, Cucumber, Edamame, Green Onions, Carrots
Instructions: Cook the jasmine rice according to package directions and season with the rice vinegar. Sear the tuna on all sides until cooked through (145°F), then cut into cubes, then let cool slightly. Toss the tuna with the soy sauce and sesame oil. Top the rice with the tuna, avocado, cucumber, edamame, sesame seeds and carrots.

Recipe: Salsa Verde Chicken Burrito Bowl with Pinto Beans and Romaine Lettuce
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Brown Rice, Pinto Beans, Romaine Lettuce, Salsa Verde, Cilantro, Lime Juice
Instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. Season the chicken with the salsa verde, cilantro and lime juice. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Drain and rinse the pinto beans, then warm them through in a pan. Build the bowls with the rice, beans, chicken and romaine lettuce.

Recipe: Garlic Herb Tofu Pita with Tahini Lemon Sauce
Ingredients: Tofu, Pita Bread, Cucumber, Lettuce, Garlic, Parsley, Thyme, Olive Oil, Tahini, Lemon Juice
Instructions: Toss the tofu with the garlic, parsley and thyme and olive oil. Press the tofu, slice it, and pan-fry or bake until golden and firm. Warm the pita bread. Stuff the pita with the tofu, cucumber and lettuce and spoon over the tahini lemon sauce.

Recipe: Greek Salad with Shrimp (No Cheese)
Ingredients: Shrimp, Cucumber, Tomatoes, Red Onion, Olives, Olive Oil, Oregano, Red Wine Vinegar, Romaine Lettuce
Instructions: Season the shrimp and cook in a hot pan or on the grill for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Chop the cucumber, tomatoes and red onion and toss with the romaine and olives. Whisk the olive oil, oregano and red wine vinegar and dress the salad. Top with the shrimp.

Recipe: Mango and Sunflower Butter Snack with Chia Seeds
Ingredients: Mango, Sunflower Seed Butter, Chia Seeds
Instructions: Slice the mango. Spread or dip with the sunflower seed butter. Sprinkle with chia seeds.

Recipe: Braised Chicken Polenta Bowl (Dairy-Free)
Ingredients: Polenta, Vegetable Broth, Chicken Thighs, Marinara Sauce, Onion
Instructions: Whisk the polenta into the simmering vegetable broth and cook, stirring often, until thick and creamy (about 20 minutes). Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F). Cook the remaining toppings in a pan until tender and combined. Spoon the polenta into bowls and top with the braised chicken.

Recipe: Sesame Ginger Tofu Salad with Feta Cheese and Sunflower Seeds on Arugula
Ingredients: Tofu, Arugula, Feta Cheese, Sunflower Seeds, Sesame Ginger Dressing
Instructions: Press the tofu, slice it, and pan-fry or bake until golden and firm. Toss the arugula with the feta cheese and sunflower seeds. Top with the tofu and drizzle with the sesame ginger dressing.

Recipe: Carrot Ginger Soup with Black Pepper
Ingredients: Carrots, Ginger, Coconut Milk, Onion, Vegetable Broth, Black Pepper
Instructions: Saute the aromatics in butter or oil until soft. Add the main vegetables or proteins, then the broth or milk, and simmer until tender. Blend until smooth or leave chunky, depending on the soup. Season to taste and top with black pepper.

Recipe: Egg Drop Soup with Shrimp and Corn
Ingredients: Shrimp, Corn, Eggs, Cornstarch, Green Onions, Ginger, Soy Sauce, Vegetable Broth
Instructions: Bring the vegetable broth to a simmer with the ginger and soy sauce. Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Add the corn and thicken lightly with cornstarch mixed with water. Drizzle in the beaten eggs while stirring to make ribbons and top with green onions.

Recipe: Black Bean Enchiladas with Monterey and Cilantro
Ingredients: Black Beans, Corn Tortillas, Monterey Jack Cheese, Crushed Tomatoes, Chili Powder, Cumin, Garlic, Onion, Cilantro
Instructions: Drain and rinse the black beans, then warm them through in a pan. Simmer the crushed tomatoes with the chili powder, cumin, garlic and onion for 10 minutes to make a flour-free sauce. Fill the corn tortillas with the black beans and some of the monterey jack cheese, roll, and place seam-side down in a baking dish. Pour the sauce over the top, sprinkle with the remaining cheese, and bake at 375°F for 20 minutes until bubbly.

Recipe: Pork Yakisoba-Style Noodles with Bell Pepper and Cabbage
Ingredients: Pork Tenderloin, Ramen Noodles, Soy Sauce, Ketchup, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking Oil, Bell Pepper, Cabbage
Instructions: Cook the noodles according to package directions and drain. Slice the pork into thin pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (145°F), then set aside. Stir-fry the bell pepper and cabbage until tender-crisp. Add the noodles, pork, soy sauce and ketchup and toss until glazed and hot.

Recipe: Chicken Lo Mein with Cabbage and Carrots
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Egg Noodles, Soy Sauce, Sesame Oil, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking Oil, Cabbage, Carrots
Instructions: Cook the noodles, drain, and toss with a little oil. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (165°F), then set aside. Stir-fry the cabbage and carrots until tender-crisp. Add the noodles and the soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic and ginger, return the chicken, and toss until everything is coated and hot.

Recipe: Pesto Portobello Linguine
Ingredients: Portobello Mushrooms, Linguine, Pesto, Cherry Tomatoes, Olive Oil
Instructions: Cook the linguine according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Slice the mushrooms and saute until browned and tender, then set aside. Simmer the pesto, cherry tomatoes and olive oil in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and portobello with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed.

Recipe: Beef Udon Stir-Fry with Cabbage and Mushrooms
Ingredients: Beef Sirloin Strips, Udon Noodles, Soy Sauce, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking Oil, Cabbage, Mushrooms
Instructions: Cook the udon noodles according to package directions and drain. Sear the beef strips in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (at least 145°F), then set aside. Stir-fry the cabbage and mushrooms with the garlic and ginger until tender-crisp. Add the noodles, soy sauce and beef and toss until heated through.

Recipe: Turkey and White Soup with Green Beans
Ingredients: Turkey Breast, White Rice, Green Beans, Chicken Broth, Onion, Carrots, Celery, Garlic, Thyme, Cooking Oil, Black Pepper
Instructions: Saute the onion, carrots and celery in the oil. Add the chicken broth, garlic and thyme and bring to a simmer. Cut the turkey into bite-sized pieces and cook in a hot pan until cooked through (165°F). Add the white rice and cook until tender. Stir in the green beans and season with salt and black pepper.

Recipe: Grilled Halloumi Sandwich on Gluten-Free Bread with Honey Mustard and Swiss-Style Gruyere
Ingredients: Halloumi, Gluten-Free Bread, Dijon Mustard, Honey, Gruyere, Tomatoes
Instructions: Slice the halloumi and grill or pan-fry until golden on both sides. Toast the bread or warm the tortilla. Spread with the dijon mustard and honey. Layer the grilled halloumi with the gruyere and tomatoes.

Recipe: Pumpkin Soup with Thyme
Ingredients: Pumpkin, Coconut Milk, Onion, Garlic, Vegetable Broth, Cinnamon, Thyme
Instructions: Saute the aromatics in butter or oil until soft. Add the main vegetables or proteins, then the broth or milk, and simmer until tender. Blend until smooth or leave chunky, depending on the soup. Season to taste and top with thyme.

Recipe: Kung Pao-Style Steak Stir-Fry with Cabbage and Carrots
Ingredients: Flank Steak, Jasmine Rice, Cabbage, Carrots, Soy Sauce, Peanuts, Dried Chilies, Rice Vinegar, Garlic, Cooking Oil
Instructions: Cook the jasmine rice according to package directions. Slice the steak thinly against the grain and sear in a hot pan until browned (at least 145°F), then set aside. Heat the cooking oil in the pan and stir-fry the cabbage and carrots for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Return the steak to the pan, add the soy sauce, peanuts, dried chilies, rice vinegar and garlic and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed and heated through. Serve over the jasmine rice.

Recipe: Black Bean Taco Salad with Cheddar and Lime Crema
Ingredients: Black Beans, Romaine Lettuce, Corn, Cherry Tomatoes, Cheddar Cheese, Tortilla Chips, Taco Seasoning, Lime Crema
Instructions: Season the black beans with the taco seasoning. Drain and rinse the black beans, then warm them through in a pan. Toss the romaine, corn, black beans and tomatoes in a large bowl. Top with the black beans, cheddar cheese and crushed tortilla chips and drizzle with the lime crema.

Recipe: Lemon Butter Cod Penne
Ingredients: Cod Fillet, Penne, Butter, Lemon Juice, Parsley, Garlic, Parmesan
Instructions: Cook the penne according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Cut the cod into chunks and gently cook in a pan until opaque and flaky (145°F), then set aside. Simmer the butter, lemon juice, parsley and garlic in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and cod with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed, and finish with parmesan.

Recipe: Lemon Oregano Salmon White Rice Bowl with Tahini Lemon Sauce
Ingredients: Salmon Fillet, White Rice, Roasted Red Peppers, Spinach, Lemon Juice, Oregano, Garlic, Olive Oil, Tahini
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Toss the salmon with the lemon juice, oregano and garlic and olive oil. Cut the salmon into chunks and gently cook in a pan until opaque and flaky (145°F). Fill the bowls with the white rice, roasted red peppers and spinach. Top with the salmon and drizzle with the tahini lemon sauce.

Recipe: Bibimbap-Style Pork Rice Bowl with Pineapple
Ingredients: Pork Tenderloin, White Rice, Gochujang, Sesame Oil, Soy Sauce, Spinach, Carrots, Zucchini, Mushrooms, Eggs, Pineapple
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Slice the pork into thin pieces and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through (145°F). Saute the spinach, carrots, zucchini and mushrooms separately until tender, seasoning with a little soy sauce and sesame oil. Fry the eggs until the whites are fully set. Assemble over the rice with the pork, vegetables and pineapple, and serve with the gochujang.

Recipe: Spicy Arrabbiata White Bean Fettuccine
Ingredients: White Beans, Fettuccine, Crushed Tomatoes, Chili Flakes, Garlic, Olive Oil, Basil
Instructions: Cook the fettuccine according to package directions, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Drain and rinse the white beans, then warm them through in a pan, then set aside. Simmer the crushed tomatoes, chili flakes, garlic and olive oil in the pan for 5 to 8 minutes. Toss the pasta and white bean with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed.

Recipe: Cumin Coriander Tofu Pita with Roasted Red Pepper Sauce
Ingredients: Tofu, Pita Bread, Tomatoes, Red Onion, Cumin, Coriander, Paprika, Garlic, Olive Oil, Roasted Red Peppers
Instructions: Toss the tofu with the cumin, coriander, paprika and garlic and olive oil. Press the tofu, slice it, and pan-fry or bake until golden and firm. Warm the pita bread. Stuff the pita with the tofu, tomatoes and red onion and spoon over the roasted red pepper sauce.

Recipe: Honey Mustard Steak Salad with Corn and Black Beans on Arugula
Ingredients: Flank Steak, Arugula, Corn, Black Beans, Honey Mustard Vinaigrette
Instructions: Season the steak and grill or sear to at least 145°F, rest for 5 minutes, then slice against the grain. Toss the arugula with the corn and black beans. Top with the steak and drizzle with the honey mustard vinaigrette.

Recipe: Grilled Chicken Sandwich on Gluten-Free Bread with Avocado and Swiss-Style Gruyere
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Gluten-Free Bread, Avocado, Gruyere, Tomatoes
Instructions: Season the chicken and grill or pan-sear until cooked through (165°F), then slice. Toast the bread or warm the tortilla. Spread with the avocado. Layer the grilled chicken with the gruyere and tomatoes.

Recipe: Salsa Verde Beef Burrito Bowl with Pinto Beans and Romaine Lettuce
Ingredients: Ground Beef, White Rice, Pinto Beans, Romaine Lettuce, Salsa Verde, Cilantro, Lime Juice
Instructions: Cook the white rice according to package directions. Season the beef with the salsa verde, cilantro and lime juice. Brown the ground beef in a pan, breaking it up, until cooked through (160°F). Drain and rinse the pinto beans, then warm them through in a pan. Build the bowls with the rice, beans, beef and romaine lettuce.

Recipe: Shrimp and Lemon Risotto with Butter
Ingredients: Shrimp, Lemon Juice, Arborio Rice, Onion, Garlic, Olive Oil, Vegetable Broth, Parmesan, Butter
Instructions: Saute the onion and garlic in the olive oil until soft. Add the arborio rice and stir for 1 minute until lightly toasted. Add the warm vegetable broth one ladleful at a time, stirring until each is absorbed (about 20 minutes). Cook the shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Stir in the lemon juice and cook until tender. Stir in the parmesan and butter and serve immediately.

Recipe: Garlic-Cumin Tilapia Tacos with Guacamole and Pico de Gallo
Ingredients: Tilapia Fillet, Corn Tortillas, Garlic, Cumin, Oregano, Lime Juice, Guacamole, Pico de Gallo
Instructions: Season the tilapia with the garlic, cumin, oregano and lime juice. Cut the tilapia into chunks and gently cook in a pan until opaque and flaky (145°F). Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable. Fill the tortillas with the tilapia and top with guacamole and pico de gallo.
